tei:div.tei:p: "#& "$ ༄/ dzñānawarṣatiswayaṃmuktinirabhogamahāsukhapradzwalanirarthasarasyagarbhaparamasidhābhikārasyashīghraṃpanthāmātsapaparaṃparyagurūṇībadzrasyaswaranāmāsti/

༄// mchog ga &!"#$%&ི dngos grub mngon du byed pa'i myur lam bka' brgyud bla ma rnams kyi rdo rje'i mgur dbyangs ye shes char 'bebs rang grol lhun grub bde chen rab 'bar nges don rgya mtsho'i snying po zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ma nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad bla ma sangs rgyas rin po che la gsol ba 'debs so// ma nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad bla ma kun khyab chos kyi sku la gsol ba 'debs so// ma nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad bla ma bde chen longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku la gsol ba 'debs so// ma nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad bla ma thugs rje sprul pa'i sku la gsol ba 'debs so// ma nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug sangs rgyas mnyan pa chen po'i go 'phang thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po dang 'bral ba med pa'i mchog gi dngos grub stsol zhig /bka' brgyud rdo rje 'chang nas bzung ste rgyal dbang rig pa'i rdo rje'i bar du byon pa'i dkon mchog gsum po de dag rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang gi skur gsal ba la phyogs bcu'i zhing rab 'byams kyi sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs dang bcas pas bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkha'i gnas su badzra sa mā dzaḥ bcom ldan 'dir ni byon pa legs// bdag cag bsod nams phyag rgya che// bdag gi ye shes spel slad phyir// rten 'di nyid du dbyer med gsol// mchod pa thams cad yongs spangs nas// bla ma mchod pa brtsam par bya// gang tshe mchod yul ma dmigs shing*// mchod byed mchod pa ma grub pa// de tshe mchod pa bla na med// rin chen sems de bzung bar bya ba'i phyir// zhes sogs nas maṇḍal dang*/ rnyed bkur chos brgyad grags pa'i ro rnams la// zhes sogs kyi bstod pa rnams kyis bstod nas// dang por bka' brgyud rdo rje 'chang gi mgur nas bzung ste kho bo'i mgur gyi bar dbyangs snyan pos 'don par bya ste/

de yang tshig lhad ma zhugs shing dbyangs snyan pos 'don pa dang*/ yid la de dag gi don legs par bsgom zhing rgyud la ci 'dre 'dre byed/ lhag par dus bzang bzhi la sangs rgyas mnyan pa'i sku 'bag gi mdun du theg pa chen po'i gso sbyong blangs te mgur ma bya zhing*/ gzhan yang nyi shu dgu'i dus su sangs rgyas mnyan pa'i dus chen la mgur gra legs par sgrig pa dang*/ gzhan yang nad yams dang 'gal rkyen sogs mi mthun pas gtses pa dang*/ gshin po la sogs pa rnams kyi don du mgur gra legs par sgrig par zhu/ ༈ na mo gu ru/ gsang ba'i dgyes pa sdom mdzad pa// shrī he ru ka la gsol ba 'debs// 'od dga' ba brtse ba'i dur khrod na// yum ye shes mkha' 'gror gsol ba 'debs// gnas o rgyan gsang ba'i bha ga na// dpal tai lo sangs rgyas= yum ye shes mkha' 'gro'i spyod yul na// grub chen nā ro paṇa chen la= bdag med lha mo'i tshogs 'khor pa'i// rje lho pa yab sras la= mkha' spyod btsun mo'i nang rol na// rje ras pa che chung la= bka' phyag rgya chen po'i don rgyud pa// rje lha rje khu dbon la= 'od gsal gyi rdzu 'phrul ston mdzad pa// rje dus gsum mkhyen pa la= gdul dka' tshar gcod kyi phrin las pa// rje sangs rgyas ras chen la = snang srid zil gnon gyi rang dbang can// rje spom brag chen po la= shar kang po gangs ra'i sgrub brgyud pa// rje karma pa la= gnad pho nya mu dra'i bdag nyid can// rje grub thob chen po la= rgyud bde ba'i mkhyen pa spel mdzad pa// rje rang byung rdo rje la= 'od rdo rje dwangs ma'i gzhal yas na// rgyal ba g.yung ston zhig po la= lha dkyil 'khor 'dus pa'i dam tshig can// rje rol pa'i rdo rje la= glu 'dod chen 'bar ba'i snyan dngags na// rje mkha' spyod dbang po la= dpal mi pham rnal 'byor cod pan na// rje de bzhin gshegs pa la= sems bde rlung gi ro chen myong mdzad pa// rje chos dpal ye shes la=

drag chen gyi thig le gdal ba po// rje ratna bha dra la= mkha' khyab tu bde ba'i ku co can// rje mthong ba don ldan la= 'jam dbyangs kyi dga' bas cher myos pa'i// rje ban sgar kun mkhyen la= zab gsal gyi rtogs pa don byed pa// rje go shri chen po la= spros bral gyi lta stangs grub pa'i ro// rje chos grags rgya mtsho la= mchog kha sbyor gyi yan lag rdzogs pa'i thugs// rje sangs rgyas mnyan pa la= bu rjes 'jug la mngon sum zhal ston pa// rje mi bskyod rdo rje la= mkha' khyab kyi 'gro la bde stsol ba// dpal dkon mchog yan lag la= thugs snying rje ldan pa sprul pa'i sku// rje dbang phyug rdo rje la= rlung dhu tir dag pa'i pho brang na// rje chos kyi dbang phyug la= gnas gtsug gtor tshangs pa'i yul sa na// rje chos dbyings rdo rje la= gnas zab gsal lha yi pho brang na// rje grags pa mchog dbyangs la= gnas dbyings dang ye shes pho brang na// dpal ye shes snying po la= gnas gru 'dzin lha yi ba gam na// rje ye shes rdo rje la= zab gsal gyi mkhyen pa rmad byung ba// rje chos kyi don grub la= mchog 'jigs med don kun grub pa na// rje byang chub rdo rje la= mkhyen gnyis kyi bstan pa'i nyi 'od brdal// rje chos kyi 'byung gnas la= bde chen kyi 'khor lor rtag rol ba// rje bdud 'dul rdo rje la= snang srid kun sgyu ma'i ngang tshul can// rje chos grub rgya mtsho la= don 'gyur med chos sku'i pho brang nas// rje padma nyin byed la= 'brel tshad kun phyir mi ldog la bkod// rje theg mchog rdo rje la= mchog bde stong sgyu ma'i rol mo mkhan// rje blo gros mtha' yas la= mtshan thos tshad thar pa'i lam la dkri// rje mkha' khyab rdo rje la= dpal bdud bzhi'i dpung rnams 'joms mdzad mkhan// rje padma dbang mchog la= dug ma rig gnyis 'dzin 'grol mdzad mkhan// rje 'jam mgon bla mar=

dus gsum sangs rgyas kyi 'phrin las pa// khyab bdag rig pa'i rdo rje la gsol ba 'debs// chos bden gnyis kyi tha snyad grol ba dang*// lam zang thal gyi re dogs spangs pa yi// don tha mal gyi shes pa rjen pa la// sangs rgyas la lag gtad byed par shog// / ༈ na mo gu ru/ mi las 'das pa'i skyes chen skye 'chi la rang dbang thob cing mngon par shes pa'i rdzu 'phrul rgya chen po mnga' ba/ nyon mongs pa dang nye ba'i nyon mongs pa'i gnas ngan len gyi dri ma bral ba/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsung rab mtha' dag gi dgongs pa 'grel pa la mi 'jigs pa'i spobs pa thob pa/ snyigs ma'i dus su mkhyen rab dang thugs rje thogs pa med pa/ seng ge srab med nam mkhar 'phyo ba lta bu rang snang rnam par dag nas gzhan snang bsgyur bar nus pa'i rje btsun dam pa karma pa mi bskyod rdo rje'i zhal snga nas kyis dpal ldan bla ma dkon mchog gsum gyi ngo bo bde ba nas bde bar byon pa rnams kyis sems can sdug bsngal nas sdug bsngal du 'gro ba rnams la thugs rje'i dgongs pa bskul ba'i phyir zhal gdams gsol ba 'debs pa mang dag cig gsungs pa las/ kha 'thor ba ci rigs pa zhig zin bris su byas pa ni 'di lta ste/ de yang rang lo so gnyis pa hor zla bdun pa'i gnam gang gi nub mo rmi lam du sa gzhi nam mkha' dang bcas pa bun long du byed pa la/ dmar chen dang*/ ljang chen dang*/ sngo dwangs dang*/ dkar chen du lam lam byed pa'i 'phro zhig nas nam mkha' rnam par dag pa sngo mthing gi dbus na rten med par rje dus gsum mkhyen pa de chos gos rnam gsum zhwa nag dang bcas pa phyag mnyam bzhag phyed log ge ba zhig dang*/ phyed ma skyil krung gis lam byung bas ha thal ches pa'i mi bzod pa'i nyams zhig byung bas rtog med la dar cig song bas/ rjes nas rtog pa zhig skyes tsa na rje dus gsum mkhyen pa de sku khra tshub ber song nas nam mkha' thams cad 'ja' tshon brjod mi shes pa'i 'od zer du song ba'i bar nas bdud rtsi dang me tog gi char khra chol le 'bab kyin 'dug pas/

gu ru ratna ma'i gsol 'debs la nges shes rnyed/ de nas phyi nyin gnyid sad nas kyang nyi ma phyed tsam gyi bar du snang ba zi bun ne ba la song ba zhig byung ba gzhan la mi bsgrags snyam yang de lta bu la dga' tshor blos mi bzod pa byung nas lo rgyus ye ger bris te gsol ba btab pa ni/ ༈ pha dran no de dus gsum gyis sangs rgyas dran// pha dran no de dus gsum gyi mkhyen pa dran// pha dran no de karma'i bka' brgyud dran// pha dran no de sgrub brgyud kyi ngo mtshar dran// bdag 'khor ba ru don med de tsam 'khyams// rje khyed kyi thugs rjes de tsam du bzung*// de bzung yang gti mug gis bslad ches pas// rje khyed kyi mtshan tsam ga la thos// bdag da lan mi lus tsam po thob// rje khyed kyi bstan pa'i sgo ru zhugs// rje khyed kyi bstan pa rnam dag la// zhugs nas bstan pa 'khrul med kyi// sgrub pa'i mchod pa med pa'i rjes// bstan pa bshig pa'i las ngan can// zang zing g.yo ba'i mi srun la// sku rdzu 'phrul mig la bstan mdzad nas// slar da rung rjes su 'dzin pa yi// thugs rje mtha' med mthong ba'i dus// bdag ba lang las kyang blun pa la// mi bzod mos pa gting nas skyes// a ma la skyes nas da lta'i bar// las byas pa don ldan 'di las med// 'di bsgrubs nas byung ba ma yin te// sangs rgyas kyi phrin las zab mo de// bdag tshur mthong gi spyod yul ma yin pas// blo 'das kyi rdzu 'phrul yin par go /nges shes zhig de ru skyes 'dug go /gsol ba zhig btab na de gas chog /thebs rgyu yod nges kyi rje btsun red// rje khyed kyi bstan pa rnam dag gi /khur theg pa'i nus pa yod min yang*// rje khyed la phyogs mos tsam byas nas// mgo gtad sa ma log tsam byung ba nas// byas pa don ldan la ngo sprad thob// ngo sprod de rje btsun bla ma la 'bul// bka' drin la nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam// zhes gsol ba btab pa'o// de yang rang lo sum cu so gnyis pa hor zla bcu gcig pa'i tshes bco brgyad kyi nub rmi lam na nam mkha' dri ma dang bral ba'i dbus su rin po che mnyan pa grub thob de dar dkar po'i do li'i khar rnal 'byor ma mang pos spyan drangs te 'od zer dang gzi brjid mtshungs pa med pa zhig gis shes pa brgyal thabs su song ba dang re zhig nas gnyid sad pas nam mkhar zla ba'i 'od gsal bas ri bo'i grib ma nag yor du byas pa dang snyigs dus kyi sdug bsngal gyi sems can mang du bsams nas gsol ba btab pa/

༈ rje gcig la ngo mtshar rmad byung ba// dus deng sang tsam du dran pa'i tshe// rje srid par dka' ba'i dkon mchog mchog /sngar mthong ngo 'brel ba don dang ldan// nged mgon med rnams nyon mongs gdon gyis smyo// smyo ches pas rang srog rang gis gcod// bcad zin nas ngan song gsum du lhung*// lhung zin nas thar dus med lugs sogs// da bsam blo bzod blags med pa skyes// de skyes pas ci byed gtol dang bral// yus ches pas lung pa stong pa ni// mtshan ma chod smre sngags ci yang bton// dus nam 'chi cha med sems la shar// skrag ches pas tshe mjug yud tsam 'di// don med du gtong re'i kho thag bcad// bdag dam chos rnal ma ma byung yang*// chos min gyi bya ba byed re shi// da mi lus yud tsam yod dus 'dir// 'dod yon spu gri'i sbrang rtsi la// 'khrul snang lce ldag ga la phod// skye 'chi mtha' med snying rlung ldang*// gnas 'khor ba 'di las 'bros snying 'dod// 'khor ba sha btson du shes tsa na// da tshe 'di'i bya ba ga la byed// las sdig pas bsgrubs pa'i 'bras bu dang*// de rang dbang thob pa'i bdag rkyen dang*// grub nas sdug bsngal mtha' med gsum// dus gcig tu 'dzom pa mthong ba'i dus// byas pa don med la yi mug skyes// pha mi bzod thugs rje can rnams 'bod// bsod zad rnams skyabs yul gyi dkon lugs dang*// mchod gnas rnams sdug bsngal gyi myong tshabs dang*// gnyis ka yang chags sdang gi bsam lugs gsum// dus gcig la chu la lcebs pa'i dus// bdud rgyal lo'i yid chad gting nas skyes// rang la nus pa ci yang med// ci drag 'di drag sems la gya// rgyal khams kyi mi la bde ba med// phyugs 'bu srin yan chad rang shi bral// mthong thos dmyal thag gi gcod lugs dang*// yod dgu gtan brlag gi god lugs dang*// ngal ba 'bras med kyi spyod pa sogs// dus da lta snying rlung mtha' med langs// da dam pa'i lha chos ma byung yang*// srog bsdos kyis tshe 'di sgrub re shi

/zhes gsol to// de yang rang so gsum gyi hor zla gsum pa'i tshes bco lnga'i rmi lam na/ ri bo'i ngogs rgyas pa ltar mi bzod pa zhig na 'ja' sprin gyi phung po gzhal du med pa lang ling gi bar mtshams na/ me tog kha dog sna tshogs pa che chung yang shing rta'i 'phang lo tsam gyi nang du/ res sku sked yan tsam/ res sku smad tsam/ res zhal gyi dkyil 'khor tsam ra rir gyur pa'i rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug mi la ras pa de gya gyu por snang zhing lhag par dbu skra phod ka ling nge ba de gzhan las kyang ches gnag pa'i 'od zer gyi rang bzhin gyis rang gi shes nyams la blta mi bzod pa tsam gyi 'phros la mos gus kyi shes pa btsan thabs su 'gags/ de nas gnyid sad pa dang*/ slar mos gus kyi shugs sprugs nas gsol ba btab pa ni/ ༈ rje gnas rnam dag 'og min gyi zhing khams na// sangs rgyas drug pa chos sku rdo rje 'chang*// khong sa bcu'i dbang phyug rnams la snang*// nged dad med blun po ro langs ngor// rje rnal 'byor ras pa chen por snang*// rje mi bzod thugs rjes da zungs shig /zhe thag pa nas mos gus ma chud pas// rje btsun rnams gya gyur 'ja' bzhin yal// gsung mi bzod sgra dbyangs ldan na yang*// de cha shas phra mo cung zad las// rgyud bzod med du 'khol ba'i zab gsal ba// yid rang dbang med par 'phrog byed pa'i// ngo mtshar gyi nges pa ma skyes pas// bdag mos gus kha tsam song ba la// dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas rtsal bskyed nas// pha 'gro mgon gyi sprul sku ras pa khyod// rnam thar gyi mdzad pa ngo mtshar la// yid ches kyi dad pa cung zad skyes// de rten 'brel rnam par dag pa'i mthus// gnyid 'khrul pas bslad pa'i snang ba la// bsam brjod las 'das pa'i dga' spro'i ngor// ye mthong ma myong ba'i rje btsun zhig /brda sprod mkhan med par ngang gis shes// dus de rje btsun la yi ga shor// bsam rgyu la dkon mchog khyed rang shes// bdag mi srun gyi 'dul tshul khyed rang mkhas// 'dun ma blo nyes po chos bzhin lam sna drongs// bdag 'jig rten phal pa'i bya ba sogs// tshe stong zad du 'gro ba'i spyod pa la// lag len du byed pa ga la zhig

/rmi lam du 'dod pa'ang mi 'byung ba'i// bka' drin zhig rje btsun khyed la rags// rang ma tshor chos brgyad gegs tshogs kyis// bdag snying 'di rjen zan mi byed cing*// gnyis phung gi sdig la ma 'bags par// sprang snyoms chung gi ngang la 'chi thub cig /pha rje btsun ras pas byin gyis rlobs// zhes gsol ba btab pa'o// de nas yang tha skar gyi nya ba'i zla ba yar gyi ngo rang lo so bzhi pa la/ mchil phu zhes pa'i ri sul dben pa zhig tu byang chub kyi sems sgom pa la nan tan du byed pa'i skabs zhig na/ rmi lam gyi snang ba la ri bo rab tu rgyas pa lhun stugs pa zhig gi ngos na/ me tog rab tu bkra ba'i tshal zhig tu yid du 'ong ba'i gzhon nu ma brjod du mi bra ba du ma'i dbus na/ rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug rje btsun gling rje ras pa de nyid 'od zer nyi ma 'bum phrag zil gyis gnon pa'i sku can zhig yad yud du gsal ba'i mod la mos gus kyi blo shugs dus mtha'i me ltar 'bar bas/ gnyid sad nas de'i rjes su gsol ba btab pa ni/ ༈ yang ye/ bsam shing gzhig na mi lus rin chen thob// brtags shing dpyad na 'khrul med rje btsun mjal// 'bad pas bsgrubs te bya ba ngan pa spangs// nus na dam pa'i chos las gnyer bya med// skabs der yang skyabs gnas kyi sku drin byung*// skabs der yang skyabs mchog gi karma pa// rje dus gsum mkhyen pa la gsol ba 'debs// thugs mi rtog ye shes kyis byin gyis rlobs// mda' snye mo lung pa ma gi na// mi skya ser med pa thams cad kun// zhing tha ba'i 'dul sbyong byed pa dang*// sa khang mkhar rtsig pa'i brel bas mnar// phu jo mo gangs kyi mdun rol na// 'brog sbra khyim 'dzin pa'i skya ser kun// las be'u lug 'tsho skyong brel zhing phongs// gtan mi tshe ma phyid dogs kyis sdug /bar 'di na ser mos kha bsgyur ba'i// gos gru bzhi gyon pa'i skra bregs pa// zas 'tsho ba gar phyid lta ba yi// phugs gtan 'dun yid la mi 'char ba'i// bsam med kyi lung pa stong par 'khyams// rkyen de 'dras bzod med kyi snying rje skyes// snying rje drag po zhig skyes tsa na// skyabs med mgon med kyi ma rgan la// phongs med gnyer med du dmyal ba 'dis// yid bsam du mi bzod gdung ba skyes// rje thugs rje chen po mnga' ba yi// yab dkon mchog gsum po dus der dran// de dran pas na med du gsol ba btab// btab ches na snang shas su 'gro dogs pas// mi med kyi lung stong snying la 'dod// 'khor khri phrag 'dus pa'i rjes 'jug kun// sde so sor phyogs 'dzin gzhung 'dzugs nas// sdig mi dge bcu'i gtan rgyun spel// de dar bas ma rgan gyi bde skyid 'joms// de ma bzod 'khor g.yog gi 'khri ba chod// 'khor g.yog slob med pa'i dus tshod na/

rang gcig pu'i lus ngag yid gsum de// mkha' dgung sngon yangs pa'i dkyil zhig na/ mkha' lding gi rgyal po bde ba bzhin// skyid ches kyi dga' ba snying nas tshor// nor zang zing gi 'du long rgyas pa la// chog shes med kyi rku 'phrog rtsod pa de// gnas ngan song gsum po ma gtogs pa// yul 'gro sa gzhan na med mthong nas// med thabs med kyi mkho dgu'i nor// mi nga yi yin zhes ma bzung bas// yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin chen de// ri bo yi rgyal po mchog rab tsam// mdun 'di na phyur bur bkang na yang*// de gces 'dzin med pa'i gnas skabs na// 'dod ches pa'i ser sna ga la 'ong*// gang yin pa gcig tu bskyur nas btang*// mi gtad med rang la mi lta bar// gzhan tshar chos rjes la rgyug pa de// brag g.yang sa chen po'i mtha' logs su// phye leb 'phur ba'i rjes so na// byis pa bsam med rgyug pa bzhin// rang srog 'chor ba ma gtogs pa// bde skyid phun tshogs mi 'ong bas// gzugs byad cung zad legs pa la// dbang po thams cad 'chor ba dang*// tshig sgros pa snyan dang mi snyan par// blo chags sdang drag po skye lugs sogs// mnog chung zhing ya nga'i gnas rnams la// longs spyod rgyu zhig rnyed na rang srog kyang*// ji mi snyam bzod kyi smyon pa la// 'di ci byung snyam ste yid dngangs pas// 'phral nyams mi dga' zhing nam phugs su// gtan sdug bsngal thar med myong dgos pas// zhe thag pa nas ma bzod nges 'byung skyes// de skyes pas col chung gi spyod pa la// lus ngag yid gsum ma bkol bas// sgo gsum las rung dge rtsa 'phel// de 'phel bas dkon mchog gi bka' drin thob// da tshe mjug cung zad gang yod de// don med snyoms las su ma btang bar// rang mgo rang 'don gyi dus la bab// che che snyan snyan gyi go 'phang de// lo brgya phrag tsam yang mi 'khyongs pas// ming skam mi mthong yud tsam la// blo dgos med kyi nges shes gting nas skyes// gnas 'khor ba 'di la srid rtse nas// mar dmyal ba mnar med yan chad la// dman pa sdug bsngal spyod pa las// mchog tu gyur pa ma mthong bas// rang gzhan mtho 'bring tha ma kun// dman pa'i gnas su snying re rje// sba gsang spyod lam bcos ma yis// bya bzhag gal chen sgrub rlom pas// mi tshe dal bar ma bsdad nas// 'bungs gsum bton pa'i bya ba yang*// bsam med byis pa'i rtsed mo bzhin// 'bras bu yod snyam ga la bgyid// dmu rgod bsdu ba'i dar rgyas la// rang gzhan gnyis ka'i gtan 'dun kun// gtan nas rlag byed yin pa la// pher yod can du ga la 'khrul// gzhan la bde skyid re ba yi// zhu sgo ngo 'dzin la sogs pa// sems la gdung ba 'bar ba'i rgyu// go sa chen po 'grim pa de// rnam g.yeng che la phan yon med// gcig tu dben par gnas pa na// sdig pa ngang gis 'gags pa'i phyir// smra brjod grogs 'dra'i mdza' bshes kun// nye bar smos nas chags pa yi// gdung sems sred pa ring nas spangs// mi tshe yid bde'i ngang du 'khyol// zas bsod snyoms kha lan mi dgos shing*// mi gzhan gyis rang la dam pa'i chos// 'di rnam dag spyod pa yin zhes nas// yul mi mthong med pa'i sa phyogs su// rdo rjen gyi steng gi bya byi'u bzhin// 'khor gtan 'khris bya sa med pa yi// bya ba zhig snying nas gtang bar rig

/de thong na bka' brgyud kyi byin rlabs zhugs// gsol ba na med du btab pa yis// dngos grub kyang de las gzhan du med// bdag mos gus kyi blo shugs gang mchis pa// stobs gcig tu bsgril pas khams gsum gyi// 'khor ba'i lus dang longs spyod dang*// 'khor snyan grags bcas pa bzhi po la// brten pa'i snang shas tha shal de// bdag gzhan gyi rgyud la 'gog par mdzod// ces gsol ba btab pa'o// ༈ na mo gu ru/ rtsol med kyi byin rlabs snod bcud thams cad la 'jug par nus pas gzhan sems byin gyis rlobs pa'i mthu can/ mngon par shes pa thogs pa med pas bsam pa ji lta ba bzhin du ris dang phyogs lhung med par rjes su 'dzin pa'i snying rje'i gzhan dbang du song ba/ sku'i rnam pa mthong ba tsam gyis kyang gzhan snang bsgyur te/ dad pa dang nyams rtogs shugs kyis bskyed cing*/ las dang skal bar mi ldan pa tha shal dag kyang tha mal gyi rnam rtog re zhig tu rgyun gcod par nus pa/ mkhas btsun bzang grub gyi grags pa don gnyer gyi bla ma rnams kyi rnam thar la ngan skyugs ltar gzigs nas/ mtho dman bar pa kun la rjes dang bkur sti dang khengs pa bskyungs pa'i tshul gyis nga rgyal can ma brtul bar shugs kyis thul ba/ yon tan gyi cha shas sangs rgyas kun gyis kyang brjod par dka' ba'i drin can chos kyi rje karma pa dbang phyug rdo rje'i zhal snga nas kyis mi rtag par bskul ba dang*/ brtson 'grus su bskul ba dang*/ gnas la bstod pa dang*/ chos kyi dbyings su lta ba'i rdo rje'i mgur mang dag cig gsung ba rnams kyi nang nas kha 'thor ba ci rigs pa zhig zin bris su byas pa ni 'di lta ste/ de yang rang lo nyer bdun pa la gdan sa chen po mtshur phu'i yang dben du bsdad pa'i tshe/ mched grogs 'ga' zhig gis mgur ma zhig gyis zer bar brten bka' brgyud gong ma tshos byin gyis rlabs shing zhabs kyis bcags thugs dam rtogs pa phul phyin thugs la 'khrungs pa'i gnas 'dir dge sbyor zhig byas na nyams rtogs skye nges snyam pa'i nges shes shig kyang skyes/

sngon gyi bka' brgyud gong ma'i rnam thar kyang dran/ da lta'i chos par rlom pa bdag la sogs pa rnams kyi bya spyod la'ang yid ma bde/ da bka' brgyud gong ma'i rnam thar de 'dra ba la rang gi skal bas ma grub pas dngos su da lta snyegs ma nus na'ang ma 'ongs pa na slob nus par gyur cig par smon lam btab ste de'i dus su bla ma dang gnas kyi yon tan dran zhing rang gzhan dge ba la bskul ba'i gsol 'debs gdung dbyangs 'di ltar du bton pa lags so// ༈ dpal 'jig rten dbang phyug karma pa// rje de yi sku gsung thugs rdo rje// gsang mi zad 'khor lo'i mdzod 'dzin pa// pha drin can chos rje'i zhabs la 'dud// gnas yid 'ong bkra shis lhun chags 'dir// ri spo mthon rin chen brag ri la// lha yi dam zhi khro rab 'byams bzhugs// sems rtse gcig sgrub pa'i gnas su bzang*// lho nags ma'i ri ngogs brjid chags par// shing sna tshogs spos dri ldan pa'i ngos// yum bcom ldan sgrol ma dngos su bzhugs// mchog thun mong dngos grub bde blag stsol// nub gangs dkar shel gyi mchod rten mdun// rigs rnam lnga rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor bzhugs// de mthong ba tsam gyis thogs med kyi// las nyon mongs skye ba'i sgrib pa sel// byang padma rā ga'i brag ngos la// dpal rta mgrin dbang gi rgyal po ni// lha dpa' bo rgya mtshos bskor ba yang*// don 'khor 'das kun la rang dbang sgyur// shar lha gdan jo shāka mched las sprul// rdo sra mkhreg rin chen pha wang la// dpal shākya'i rgyal po rang byon ni// bstan rnam dag yun du gnas par mdzad// dbus 'og min gnas mchog rdo rje gdan// rje dus gsum mkhyen pa la sogs pa// dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas bzhugs pa'i gnas// mtshur mdo bo sprul pa'i gtsug lag khang*// lar 'dzam gling tsam na 'gran zla bral// 'di gang gi mthong dang bgrod pa dang*// lan gcig tsam yid la dran pas kyang*// tshe bskal pa'i sdig sgrib 'dag nges shing*// bdag zang zing g.yeng bas yid 'khrugs pas// gnas jo mo gangs dang mtshur phu sogs// pha bka' brgyud rnams kyi bzhugs gnas su// rtse gcig tu sgrub pa snying la brnags// de brnags kyang gnyen po'i stobs zhan cing*// tshe 'di la 'khri ba ma chod pas// 'phral gzhan don ming du bcos pa nas// nyin mtshan med grogs sbur lta bur g.yengs// da rang la bsam bzhin snying rtsa khol// chos bya blo'i ngang du lang tsho yol// lar kha zhe mi mthun rang spyod 'di// pha bla mas mkhyen te rang la gnod// da karma'i rjes 'jug sgrub 'dod rnams// 'chi mi rtag drag pos rgyud bskul te// tshe 'di yi bya ba cog zhog la// chos sgrub pa snying por mdzod cig dang*// tshe gtan gyi 'dun ma 'grub par nges// spyir mang po'i bsams pas sems rtsa 'khrugs// blo the tshom gyi 'dun mas gar mi phyin// rten bsod snyoms phyag dar khrod kyi gos// snod lhung bzed yo byad nyi tshe dang*// zas sdig med dka' thub bcud len brten// 'phral sbyong de byung yang bogs su che// spyir bsam pa'i gtso bo byang sems sbyongs// rang gcig pu'i 'dun ma dam pas khrel// ma 'gro drug ched du snying rje yis// lam zab mo stong nyid snying rje sgoms// chos gdams ngag shlo ka gcig nas// bka' brgyad khri bzhi stong chos phung rnams// don rang rgyud nyams su ma blangs na// smra mkhas kyang ne tso'i zlos gar tsam// rje bla mas stsal ba'i gdams ngag rnams// dus dang por thos pas sgro 'dogs bcad// dus gnyis par bsam pas gtan la phab// mthar rtse gcig sems la mnyam par bzhag

/yid nyon mongs rtog pa rab zhi ste// sems mi g.yo brtan par gyur pa nas// chos kun la bdag med shes rab mchog /don yin lugs zhi lhag zung 'jug sgoms// pha bla ma yid bzhin nor bu la// nyin mtshan med gsol ba drag btab ste// blo gnyis 'dzin 'khrul ba'i snang ba 'di// bun long der gtad med hrul gyis thong*// dus snga phyi med pa'i shes pa la// lar bzo bcos kyi lhan pa don med pas// gang shar ba rig pa'i ngo bo la// dus rgyun du ma bcos lhug par zhog /sems ye nas sangs rgyas yin pa la// 'di yin la yin bzhin mdzub btsugs nas// dpal dwags po'i zhal lung gnad kyi mchog /don mngon sum ngo sprod slob dpon lags// tshig 'di la dge ba ci mchis pa// khyod gsol 'debs kyi slob bus gtso byas pa'i// mi kho bo'i rjes 'jug gdul bya rnams// dpal rdo rje 'chang dbang myur 'grub shog /ces pa 'di karma co le sogs kyis bskul ba la brten mtshur phu'i dben gnas bsam gtan yid 'ong gling gi dbang phyug phug tu bris pa bkra shis dpal 'bar 'dzam gling rgyan du shog/ na mo gu ru/ skyabs gnas bslu med dkon mchog rnam pa gsum// de dang dbyer med drin can chos kyi rje// dpal ldan bla ma'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// dus rnams kun tu byin gyis brlab tu gsol// don med rgyal khams 'grim pa'i snyom las pas// rang gi sems la cung zad phan phyir du// yid la gang dran tho chor smras pa 'di// rang gzhan dge la bskul ba'i rol mor smon// dal 'byor lus 'di yang yang thob par dka'// tshe 'di mi rtag myur du 'jig par nges// phyi ma gar skye tshe 'di'i las la rag /thar med 'khor bar 'khyams na ji ltar byed// tshe 'di'i rnyed bkur nam mkha'i glog dang 'dra// dge ba gang bsags phyi ma'i brgyags phye yin// mi dge'i bya ba rdul tsam mi byed par// da res gtan 'dun sgrub pa'i dus la bab// longs spyod stobs 'byor snyan grags 'dzom na yang*// rang nyid 'chi tshe de dag kun gyis 'bor// phyi tshis tshe 'di'i grabs gshom mi byed par// 'dod chung chog shes dben pa brten na legs// rang gi dgra la ci nus gnod skyel zhing*// gnyen la gdung sems nor la chags zhen che// lho zong byang skyel tshong khe bun bskyed dang*// rkang bzhi bran bkol 'di yang spang bar rigs// gsung rab mang po thos pa'i mkhas yus dang*// gcig pur ri la sdod pa'i sgom chen yus// dka' thub an tsam byas pa'i ltogs yus rnams// chos brgyad yin pas 'di dag spang bar bya// srog gcod byas pa'i sha yi kha zas dang*// dbang med 'byung ba lus sems 'khrul pa'i chang*// sdom pa 'phrog byed na chung mdzes ma rnams// dug ltar spang bar byas na mi legs sam// ma mthong rdzun gyi mngon shes 'chad pa dang*// mi phan bzhin du nad pa sri'u gso// mthu dang ngan byed dmag las drag sngags bzla// 'di yang chos dang rgyab 'gal ma yin nam// deng sang chos pa bzang rlom mang lags kyang*// rang skyon rang gis rig pa dka' mor gda'// de phyir bka' brgyud gong ma'i rnam thar la// mig ltos yar lta gyis la nyams su longs// dpal ldan bla ma 'bral med spyi bor sgoms// sku drin bsam zhing gsol ba yang yang thob// thugs yid gcig bsre'i mos gus phul phyin na// 'dun ma de nyid kho nas 'grub ste mchi// de phyir go ba skam po'i 'char tshul 'di// bla ma rje dang mched grogs snyan drung du// sems la gang shar dbyangs 'di mchod par 'bul/

brtse ba'i slad du dgyes pa bskyed par mdzod// ces mgur pa kha shas kyis bskul ba'i ngor dpal gyi mtshur phur thun mtshams shig la yi ger bkod pa'o// ༈ na mo gu ru/ de yang dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi mkhyen pa dang brtse ba dang nus pa'i spyi gzugs gdul bya blo gros dag pa dag gi yid mtshor rol gar bsgyur ba/ bskal pa tshad med par sems can gyi khams la rnam par brtags nas/ dmigs pa med pa'i snying rje chen po goms pa rab kyi phul du dbyung du med pa brtan pa'i brtse chen gyis srid pa dang zhi ba'i mya ngam gyi thang du dub pa mtha' dag dbugs 'byin par g.yar gyis bzhes pa bdag gir mdzad pa/ bdag cag gi dpal ldan bla ma dam pa thos grol chen po'i don gyi slad du mtshan nas smos na/ dpal karma pa chen po rje btsun rgyal ba'i dbang po chos dbyings rdo rje'i zhal snga nas rdo rje'i mgur dbyangs mang dag cig gsungs pa las kha 'thor ci rigs shig zin bris su byas pa las/ rje btsun dam pa de nyid lha chen yar lha shambho'i gangs ri'i lha zhol bod rje gnya' khri btsan pos dang por mnga' ris su bdag gir mdzad pa'i yul yar mo lung gi sa'i thig ler zhabs zung gi 'khor lo 'god par gnang skabs/ bsil ldan gangs ri'i ljongs kyi skye dgu mtha' dag nyam thag pa gzigs pas thugs skyo shas gting nas 'khrungs shing bzod blag med pa'i snying rje tshad med pas/ 'gro ba 'di dag skyob pa'i dus la bab pa'i tshe/ mchog gsum rgya mtsho'i ngo bo dpal ldan bla ma dag gi thugs rje bskul zhing*/ bdag nyid kyi bka' brgyud gong ma'i rnam thar bzhin 'khor ba'i 'du 'dzi las ring du dben pa la thugs gzhol ba'i yid dam len pa'i rdo rje'i mgur bzhengs pa ni 'di lta ste/ rje rdo rje 'chang chen man chad nas// pha dbang phyug rdo rje yan chad kyi// sangs rgyas kyi brgyud pa ma chad pa// 'gro don gyi rdzu 'phrul ston pa rnams// dus deng sang sems can bsod zad la// thugs mi bzod phrin las skyob tu gsol// mi kho bo yang lho mon mtshams su 'gro// rten khyad par can mtshan ldan rnam gnyis mjal// khyad par sprul pa'i sras mkhar bskor// 'brog la phyi gangs kyi ra bar 'gro// lho gro bo lung gi gtsug lag mjal// brag rgod tshang can la gnas mal 'cha'// rje mi la'i rdzong drug gtan yul byed// bdag gangs dkar stongs su ri tshugs 'dzin// rje mi la kho rang mi bsam re// nyi ma de ring yang snying nas gsol ba 'debs// skyo shas kyi dgos med zhe nas bskul// kha sang de ring yang na tshas dmyal thag bcad// snying nas gsol 'debs kyang blo sna brod par byung*// 'bral med du rje la gsol btab pas// na tsha yang gzhi med bun ner song*// sku drin yang 'khor thabs med par go

/dus deng sang 'gyur spyod ci 'dra na// sde phyogs ris byed pa'i chags sdang can// bsam chung kha dkar gyi bkod pa mdzad// dran rgya can brel ba che ba kun// don med du bya bzhag mang ba rnams// skyabs dam par rlom nas bde skyid 'phrog /tshe thung gi skyid thabs ga la 'tshol// phun tshogs kyang rtag par mi 'dug pas// dus da lta nyid nas e 'chi na// mi bzod skyo ba gting nas skye bar byung*// dus na ning da lo'i bsam pa la// yid bde ba skad cig ma shar bas// mchi mas gdong brlan ngu mo 'di ltar shor// kye ma 'di nas sangs rgyas ma thob par// rjes 'jug dar rgyas 'khor 'bangs longs spyod rnams// rmi lam du byung yang bdud rgyal yin// mchil ma'i thal ba lta bur gang dga' gyis// nam gzhag gtan gyi 'dun ma sgrub pa sogs// kho bo bdag la ltos pa'i rjes 'jug kun// gnyen 'dza' grogs sogs sems la ma 'khris na// dgra stobs ldan gyis zil gnon mi yong zhing*// yul gang du phyin yang pha khyim yin// mi dge bcu sogs phyogs bcur spel ba rnams// bdud bar chad yin par ngo shes nas// thal mo brdabs nas ngu mo byed pa 'di// spyir gyi dwags po bka' brgyud mtshan ldan dang*// khyad par mi mchog dus gsum mkhyen pa zhes// sgrub brgyud nyin skar tsam las dkon pa yin// ba thag ma chad tsam ni mdzad pa yin// nga karma bka' brgyud kyi sgrub brgyud 'di// dgun dus su smyu gu 'khrungs pa 'dra// mi srid pa srid pa rnyed pa'i dus// snying rus la zhe gcig da res dgos// dus deng sang snyigs ma'i spyod tshul mthong*// 'dre lha ru mchod pas bdud du bab// de bab pas mi 'dod sna tshogs byung*// bka' srung yi dam chos skyong la// log lta sgom zhing yi chad byed// khong thugs rje chung ba ma yin te// rang la mos gus ma skyes pas// de lan rang la 'khor ba yin// de 'dra'i bskal pa shar ba'i tshe// ma rabs kyis ya rabs rje rnams 'bud// rje rgyal po rnams 'bangs kyi khrod du 'khyams// ma rabs tshig sun gyis nang mi mthun// snying dmar por zos kyang mi tshim pa'i// zhe sdang gi 'thab rtsod ci yang byed// de byas pas nyes med kyi sems can rnams// ltag chad bzhin mar la 'gro gnyen 'dug

/de lhag par bsams nas spyan ras gzigs// sku zla ba lta bu'i bdud rtsi la// gsung bsil zer lta bur nyon mongs zhi// thugs nam mkha' lta bur dmigs pa med// dus de tsa na dgra gnyen gyi dbye ba med// mi bdag gis las 'bras bslu med dran// bden mi bden mngon sum 'di la ltos// skyabs dkon mchog dran shing kha na shor// de shor pa shog bu'i ngos su bris// de bris pa rjes 'jug ltad mo mdzod// ces rang lo bco brgyad la yar lha shambho'i 'dabs su bris pa'o/// /de yang mtshan brjod par dka' ba dpal ldan karma pa chen po rje btsun chos dbyings rdo rje zhes mtshan nyi zla ltar grags pa de nyid/ rje btsun dam pa chos kyi dbang phyug des thugs rje rmad du byung bas sems can gyi don dpag tu med pa mdzad nas ring por ma lon par yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa de'i sku gdung rin po che'i mchod rten bzhengs pa'i gnas skabs der bla ma rje btsun yab sras gnyis la snying khung rus pa'i gting nas mos gus can gyi sgom chen pa 'ga' zhig gzigs pas dgyes shing mnyes/ rje btsun nyid kyang mos gus tshad med pa 'khrungs/ dad pa'i yus kyis brnangs pa'i gdungs shugs des/ nyams 'bar zhing 'di yin dang 'di min gang yang med pa'i ngang du dar cig lus/ ji zhig na 'di lta bu sgrub rgyud kyi rnam thar la bslab cing*// bla ma la mos gus kyi mnyes pa sgrub pa skal ldan gzhan dag la'ang bskul ma 'debs pa'i phyir lo rgyus yi ger bris te gsol ba btab pa ni/ ༈ na mo gu ru/ 'od dpag med mgon zhwa dmar cod pan 'dzin// byang chub sems dpa' rgyal ba ma pham pa// nga yi skyabs gcig chos kyi dbang phyug la// mi phyed dad pas snying nas phyag bgyi'o// khyed kyi brtse ba'i thugs rjes rjes bzung nas// ci slad da ni dus ring btang snyoms su// bor ba'i gnas skabs 'di 'dra ji ltar phod// thugs rjes da gzigs chos kyi dbang phyug kye// a ye rigs can gsum gyi gdul bya yi// nang nas smon lam bzang po'i 'brel pa can// kho bo ma gtogs bsam rgyu med pa rnams// tshur shog tshur shog dpal ldan bla ma yi// brtse bas bskyangs pa'i bu rnams da tshur shog

/de lta dal 'byor don ldan rnyed dka' ba'i// nges don nor bu dgos 'dod kun 'byung ba// 'bad pa med par bla mas dus 'di ru// yu bu'i lag tu byin na de las ci// da dung 'ching bu'i dum bus ci zhig byed// da 'du 'dzi'i nang du bag phab nas// gtam grags pa 'khor 'bangs skyong ba yi// tshe 'di yi bya ba'i 'dun gros mkhan// 'khor ba ru yang yang rang gzhan kun// thog med kyi dus nas dmyal thag bcad// de bcad kyang rtsi la sbrang ma bzhin// 'khrul pa 'dis da rung bslu ba 'dra// mi rtag mi rtag 'dus byas rnams mi rtag /sgyu ma mkhan gyi sgyu ma ji lta bur// sgyu lus mi rtag nges par 'jig pa nyid// zhag re song bzhin 'chi dang nye bar gda'// bzang ngan gyi gdags gzhi mang ba dang*// tshul 'chos ngo srung gi bslu brid dang*// rang snang ma dag pa'i kun slong dang*// rnam rtog 'dis da dung bslu ba 'dra// ma yengs ma yengs bya ra gyis// dus de ring nas ri sul shing drung dang*// nges med bas mtha'i gnas mal bsten// dus de ring nas kha zas bsod snyoms dang*// gos phyag dar khrod kyi ngan ngon tsam// chog shes kyi 'tsho chas de kas chog /rgyal khams phyogs med 'grim dus su// chos brgyad rnam g.yeng byis pa yi// nyes pa'i dri mas ma gos par// rdul gyi nang du dngul chu bzhin// ma rgan rnams smyo tshabs che ba dang*// dad med mthar skyel gyi gding tshan can// rang sems bskyed kyi 'khos ka chung ba 'dis// de mthong yang bya thabs ye ma rnyed// sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa 'dul ba yi// bslab pa rnam dag la gces spras dgos// sngon rol gyi bskal pa grangs med du// 'khor ba ru lan cig ma yin par// las nyon gyi dbang gis de tsam 'khor// ngan 'gro'i sdug bsngal de tsam myong*// dge ba la cung zad 'brel thogs pas// dus da lta lha las ches lhag pa'i// dal 'byor 'di thob pa'i gnas skabs 'dir// byang chub kyi ched du 'bad stsol 'ga'// byed rgyu yang yod la byed rin chog

/gzhan lab lab mang po ngas mi shes// mi rtag rmi lam tsam gyi tshe 'di yi// bya ba 'ga' yang byed long ga la yod// bu bcos min gyi mos gus skyes tsam na// bla ma yang de kas mnyes pa yin// de mnyes pa'i thugs rje'i sprin chen las// byin rlabs kyi char pa rgyun du 'bab// de bab pas mos gus kyi myu gu skyes// de skyes pas byang chub kyi 'bras bu smin// de smin pas ma rgan kun gyis zos// de zos pas bde chen gyi ro mchog myong*// de'i nus bcud kyis rang rig lam gyis mthong*// de mthong ba'ang bla ma'i bka' drin yin// 'chi bas bral bar ma gyur na// bu da dung nga yi gam du shog /a la la sgrub brgyud kyi byin rlabs la// a la la bu yi mos gus la// 'bral med du thugs yid gcig 'dres shog /a la la bla ma'i thugs rje la// lar thams cad thams cad bla ma'i drin// dus da lta byis pa'i snang ngo ru// go ra la chud pa'i ri dwags bzhin// 'di rgyun du rtsa bzhin mthong snyam yang*// snying rje'i dbang gis spyan ras gzigs// zhwa mthon mthing gi cod pan 'dzin pa bcu'i// grangs su bla mar 'dren pa nga*// lar skye ba 'di kas tha ma yin// bu mos gus shig byed na byed re ran// gsol ba zhig 'debs pa'i dus la bab// zur bstan pas da ni chog tshod yin// ldebs shig bstan na ran nas 'dug /de go'am ma rgan sems can rnams// de go'am ma rgan gding tshan can// de go'am ma rgan dad med po// de go'am ma rgan dred po rnams// khyod da dung sems la bskor ldab gyis// ka ye nam mkha' la ni nam mkha' bzhin// zab zhi spros bral rmad byung bdud rtsi'i gsang*// rang rig rang gis gsal ba de kho na// bde chen lhan skyes phyag rgya che brnyes shog /su la'ang 'di lta bu mi smra snyam yang*/ da dung sgrub brgyud gong ma dang*/ kho bo la zhe thag pa nas mnyes tshor che ba'i sgom chen mos gus can 'ga' re mthong bas de la kho bo mos gus skyes dga' ba tshad med pa byung mang po zhig dus 'di yin 'di min ye med par dar cig lus/

rang gi gang snyam gyi glu 'di byang chub sems dpa' chos kyi dbang phyug dang thugs yid gcig tu 'dres pa shākya'i dge slong bas mtha' la dga' ba chos dbyings rdo rje phrin las mngon par mtho ba'i dpal gyis ri bo spos ngad ldan pa bya dang ri dwags du ma bag yangs su rgyu ba me tog rgyas pa'i nags tshal dang nye ba'i grub pa'i gnas mchog 'og min mtshur phu'i gzhal med khang chen po nas bris pa'o// ༈ de yang snyigs ma'i dus 'dir mtshan tsam thos pas 'khor ba mtha' can du byed pa'i/ rje btsun thugs rje'i bdag nyid rgyal mchog karma pa chos dbyings rdo rje de nyid dus kyi 'gyur ba zing zing pos thugs phyung zhing*/ rje bla ma thams cad mkhyen pa'i bka' drin dran pas/ sprul pa'i sku'i zhal lta ba dang*/ bdag nyid dben pa la thugs gzhol ba de'i phyir re zhig mdo khams shar gyi phyogs su phebs par dgongs pa'i tshe dbus gtsang gi chos mdzad rjes 'jug rnams la zhal gdams phyi 'phrin gyi tshul du bstsal ba'i rdo rje'i mgur dbyangs ni 'di ltar lags so// skyabs bka' drin can la gsol ba 'debs// sprang ri khrod zin par byin gyis rlobs// da nas nges med kyi ri la sdod// yul la nges med rgyal khams bskor// zin pa med pa'i brel ba can// byis pa'i thal ba'i rtsed mo 'dra// sngon chad byas pa don med yin// da byed na dge ba'i bya ba gyis// khyod sngon chad gnyis 'dzin 'khrul pa'i dbang*// mi lus rin chen thob pa 'di// don med 'khor ba'i 'dam du bor// phyis btsal bas rnyed pa ma yin pas// dus da lta don chen sgrub re ran// khyod sngon chad 'dza' bshes 'dris yod pa// nye du'i tshogs kyis mi stongs te// 'jig rten pha rol 'gro ba na// rgyus yod yul 'khor yod dam ci// skyabs skyel ma 'tshol na da lta tshol// dus 'gyur ba mi rtag ston gyi dus// spang me tog sna tshogs mdangs gsal ba// dus kha sang yod pa da nang nyams// 'di mi rtag sgyu ma'i slob dpon yin// khyod de phyir bsam bzhin dben pa snyogs// lus bkres skom nyin re mi bzod pa// 'di gces par bzung yang mthar 'bral ba// 'byung bzhi dus kyis 'gro ba dang*// rnam shes brtan pa med pa 'di// sgyu ma mkhan gyi grong khyer 'dra// yun ring sdod pa'i longs med par// de go na dam pa'i lha chos gyis// nor yod dgu sbyin yang mi mgu ste// tshig snyan pas rna ba mi khug cing*// stobs drag shul las kyis mi bzlog pa// 'chi ba bya ba'i sgra bo che// 'dis sngon chad dgra gnyen phye ma myong*// 'di nam yong nges pa med par yong*// 'di bsam na cis kyang dgos pa med// bar do'i lam 'phrang mun pa nag

/khyod chu bur mig gis mi mthong bas// nang 'od gsal sgron me'i grabs shom gyis// sang shi yang 'gyod pa med pa dgos// long yod kyi go skabs mi rnyed de// laung med kyi blo sna bzung re ran// gsog 'jog gi a 'thas ma re bar// 'tsho ba bya 'tshol gyi 'tsho ba bzang*// gos dar zab 'jam por mi re bar// hral hrul gyi gos rnying lus la dro// khyod de phyir bsam bzhin ri la 'dug /yang mkha' la 'phur ba'i 'dab chags de// kho gar 'gro rang dbang che na yang*// zas sa la 'tshol dus bag yod dgos// snyi dam pos zin na ji ltar bya// khyod gar 'gro rang dbang che na yang*// phyogs 'dzin gyi yul la rgyu ba na// byis pa'i skye bo'i blo brid kyi// 'du 'dzi'i rgya la bag yod dgos// 'dis zin na nam phug blo re 'gyod// de bsam zhing dben pa'i ri la 'dug /ces mkha' 'gro'i gnas mchog mtsho dkar sprul pa'i pho brang du blangs so// de yang rtogs ldan chen po zhwa dmar cod pan 'dzin pa mkha' spyod dbang po zhes bya ba de nyid rje btsun ri khrod pa bde bar gshegs pa'i gdan sa mtshur phu gnas nang du bzhugs par gsol bas/ 'khor slob mtshan cig mi dad cing skur zhus sna tshogs byung ba la brten nas yul phyogs 'di lta bur bsdad pas bla ma'i gdan sa mi zin cing gzhan don du mi 'gyur ba'i khar sdig chen po gsog par 'gyur du 'ong dgongs te/ gnam lha brgyad gangs kyi ra ba la sogs par gshegs pa'i tshe/ zhal slob rnams la zhal bkod phyi 'phrin du gsol ba ni 'di lta ste/ ༈ na ma utta re bhyaḥ sde rigs mthun pa'i ming ni dpal ye shes// me tog phog pa'i ming ni mi bskyod rgyal// bla mas gnang ba'i ming ni mi pham pa// lha yis btags pa'i ming ni dri ma med// ḍā kis glur blangs ming ni mkha' la spyod// 'phags ma dgyes pa'i ming ni tsaṇḍi pa// don med mi mang ldan pa'i sprang po khyod// byang chub lam gyi glu 'di nyan par mdzod// lto gos brang breng tsam zhig gang byas phyid// mi lus yi dwags spyod pas ci zhig byed// zas nor sgrub pa'i rtsol ba rgyab tu skyur// zhen pa rang log 'di ni byang chub lam// bya btang skyes bu gang du phyin yang skyid// rtsod pa'i sa yul bzung nas ci zhig byed// yun du sa gcig sdod blo ring du spongs// yul la nges med 'di ni byang chub lam// rang snang dag na su yang mthun pa'i grogs// sdug bsngal sna thag sbrel nas ci zhig byed// nye 'brel 'khor ba'i shal thag rbad kyis chod// dgra med bshes med 'di ni byang chub lam// chos dang mthun na 'dun ma lha yis sgrub// legs nyes brtsi bgrang mang pos ci zhig byed// tshe 'di'i bya bzhag thams cad lings kyis bor// byar med rang ga 'di ni byang chub lam// rang sems rang ngo shes na sangs rgyas rang*// tha snyad thos bsam mang pos ci zhig byed/

gzhung tshig rtog pa'i ri mo yal du chug /gcer mthong rang grol 'di ni byang chub lam// 'phral snang rmi lam tsam 'di gang byas rung// rang gis rang nyid bcings nas ci zhig byed// gtad med chal ba'i ngang du lhod kyis zhog /ma bcos lhug pa 'di ni byang chub lam// thabs dang ldan na dug kyang bdud rtsi'i mchog /'gal mthun spong sgyur mang pos ci zhig byed// gnad kyi gdams pas nyon mongs grogs su khyer// srog thig zab gnad 'di ni byang chub lam// e ma nor bu rin chen rang la yod// don med 'khor bar 'khor nas ci zhig byed// lhun grub bde chen ngang du rtsen gyis zhogs// dgos 'dod 'bad med grub 'di byang chub lam// byang chub lam brgyad gcig tu dril ba'i glu// sngon rabs dran pas skyo bas bskul ba'i tshig /tho rangs thun mtshams gseng ba'i rol mor blangs// don bzhin spyod dam phyi rabs grogs po rnams// byang chub lam yang bdag gis rnyed// 'dong ngo skal ldan grogs po rnams// byang chub lam la mi 'gro ba'i// chos pa'i gzugs kyis ci zhig byed// byang chub lam la 'gro 'dod na// 'jig rten bya ba rgyab tu skyur// 'khor ba'i gnas la phyi phyag 'tshol// dpal ldan bla ma'i rjes bzhin 'brangs// tshe phyi ma'i brgyags grabs gyis shig dang*// gtan gyi 'dun ma legs nas 'ong*// rnal 'byor bde spyod bzang po yi// byang chub lam glu de skad lo// de yang rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug zhwa dmar cod pan 'dzin pa mkha' spyod dbang po zhes bya ba de nyid kyis chos thams cad kyi gnas snang 'khrul pa med par gzigs nas rtog ge mkhan gyis bden pa gnyis la sgro skur byas pa de thams cad kyi mtshang phyar nas chos can dang chos nyid thams cad sbun lkogs ltar grol bar gyur pa ni 'di lta ste/ ༈ na maḥshrī gu ru we/ dus da lta'i snang rig gsal tsam 'di// chos kun rdzob bden pa'i rang ngo yin// 'di ma bcos rang ga'i gnad shes na// don dam pa'i bden pa'ang de kho na// gzhung tha snyad mkhan gyi bden gnyis de// lung rigs pa mang yang gnad ma go

/gnyis tha dad du bzung bas gnyis med nyams// blo spang blang gi 'khrul 'khor rgyun mi 'chad// nged man ngag gnad kyi bden gnyis 'di// 'phral mngon sum mdzub tshugs lam du byed// dpal rdo rje 'chang dngos bla ma yi// thugs dgongs pa'i snying po rgyun mi 'chad// rten thabs shes zung 'jug rdo rje'i lus// gnad rnam bzhi gcig tu tshogs pa de// don kun rdzob bden pa gsang ba'i gsang// de spyod pa'i ye shes don dam nyid// nang sku bzhi'i 'khor lo las 'ongs pa// mchog gsang chen 'khor lo'i rtser smin te// yul yang dag 'khor los brgyan pa dang*// lam bsam gtan bzhi yi rtse mos rnyed// rgyud zab mo gnad kyi bden gnyis la// phyi ma gtogs nang gsang don gsum po// rje bla ma zhal la gnas pa yang*// dus de ring rang dran gso phyir brjod// bdag bla ma'i zhal gdams rdzogs pa'i bu// nyams rab 'bar sna kha ma bskyil bar// gnad ma sbas glu ru blangs pa la// thugs dgyes par mdzod cig ḍā ki'i tshogs// de yang rnal 'byor dbang phyug zhwa dmar cod pan 'dzin pa lnga pa dpal dkon mchog shākya mchog gi gtso bo'i 'bangs rab tu tshes pa'i zhal snga nas de nyid kyi gsung rdo rje'i glur bzhengs pa ji snyed pa las/ yongs 'dzin dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang bka' brgyud 'khrul bral gyi gsung la nges shes bslu med 'khrungs/ 'phral snang rang gzhan gyi 'dun ma bya bzhag skyid sdug gi gnas skabs yul dus thams cad sgyu ma dang rmi lam ltar bun long du gzigs/ dpon slob mchod yon grogs bshes kyi 'brel ba thos bsam sgom pa'i bya ba sogs kun rdzob rten 'brel gyi snang ba de thams cad kyang rtogs na nges don gnas lugs kyi mtshang rjen par ston pa'i brda don du 'dug par mkhyen/ des na ma bcos gnyug ma tha mal 'dzin med bcings med grol med kyi gnas lugs nam zhod dus kyis dros pa ltar myong ba nang nas shar ba'i dgongs pa 'khrungs te de dag skal ldan slob ma la gdams pa man ngag tu dril te ston par bzhed pa'i tshe rdo rje'i mgur bzhengs pa ni 'di lta ste/

༈ bsam blo btang na bka' drin che ba de// rje btsun thugs rje can gyi mi bskyod rgyal// rgyu rkyen dmigs pa'i gtad so ma mchis kyang*// theg gsum chos kyi go rtogs nang nas shar// 'dir ltos bya ba'i mig khrid ngan pa yang*// gtan gyi 'dun ma'i grabs shom bzang por song*// dang por tshe 'di'i re ltos bcas pa yang*// thugs rje'i thabs kyis phyi ma'i don du gyur// chung ngu'i dus nas bshes gnyen bsten pa yang*// da lta lang tsho yol tshe 'dun ma grub// tha snyad tshig mtha' sbyang ba'i thob thob kyang*// myong ba rgyud la skyes pa'i gnad gsang rig /bla ma'i dkor la 'bags pa'i log 'tsho yang*// rang gzhan rnam par grol ba'i dge tshogs gyur// yun ring rtag tu bsten pa'i grogs 'dun yang*// da ni gtan gyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen nyid// rang la ltos pa bcas pa'i bu slob kyang*// rdzun dang g.yo sgyus mgo bo ma bskor tsam// thos bsam don du gnyer ba'i grwa pa yang*// mtho ris thar pa'i rgyu tshogs nyid la 'god// yang dag 'jog la mos pa'i sgom chen yang*// lhag pa shes rab bslab par dkri tshul shes// nam mkha'i dkyil nas gnam lcags lhung ba ltar// dmigs med thugs rje'i dkyil nas byin rlabs babs// a 'thas mtshan ma'i ljon shing rtsad nas chod// snang ba thams cad na bun lta bur gyur// ched du rtsol sgrub byas pa ma yin kyang*// rten 'brel thugs rje'i rol gar bsam mi khyab// pha rgan bka' brgyud rnams kyi thugs rjer go /yang sgos bka' drin can gyi thugs rjer go /thog ma kho nar mi rtag sdug bsngal gyi// gnas snang shes kyang de la dogs pa med// de las bar du mtho ris thar pa yi// phan yon shes kyang de la re ba med// mtha' mar ma rgan sems can zad med kyang*// 'gro don sgrub pa'i blo la zhum pa med// ma go ma rig 'khrul pa'i mtshang rig pas// 'khrul grol mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes shar// phyi nang yo byad gang la'ang 'dzin med pas// ma chags yongs su gtong ba'i sbyin pa rdzogs// kun nas 'khrugs pa'i khong khro ma dmigs pas// tshul ldan bzod pa'i phar phyin ngang gis tshang*// sgom med yengs med ngang du gnas pa'i phyir// le lo'i go skabs med pa'i brtson 'grus yin// yang dag don la dmigs pa mi yol bas// bsam gtan la brten shes rab rnam par dag

/nyon mongs ngo bo gzod nas ma dmigs shing*// chos dbyings gdod nas rnam par dag mthong bas// byang chub phyogs chos bral dang rnam smin gyi// yon tan thams cad lhun gyis grub par go /dpag bsam shing dang bum pa bzang po ltar// gzhi'i yon tan 'bras bur ma 'bad grub// 'bras bu'i phrin las rtog med 'gro tshogs la// gang 'dul zad pa med par 'byung ba nyid// skyes pa mtha' 'khob klo mon phyogs su skyes// rgas pa phyogs ris med pa'i yul du rgas// 'chi ba sa phyogs gar 'byung gtol ma mchis// dkon mchog yan lag ces bya'i rgan po bdag /kun rdzob rten 'brel bsam na gting nas skyo// 'das pa'i bya bzhag thams cad rmi lam 'dra// da lta'i sems snang 'di yang glog 'gyu tsam// ma 'ongs 'dun ma g.yang sar mig btsum 'dra// de 'dra'i 'dun gros kun la gzhig tsam na// ci bya'i gtol dang bral te bsam pa stor// 'on kyang bsam gyis mi khyab sems kyi gsang*// 'khor 'das kun gyi gnas tshul yin par go /da ni bsam gzhig mang pos ci zhig bya// byar med lhug pa'i ngang du lus sems glod// bsam brjod bral ba'i rang sems so ma 'di// dus gsum rgyal ba'i yum mchog pha rol phyin// ming brgyas mtshon pa'i don kyi gnas tshul gcig /brda brgyas bstan pa'i snying po'i ngo bo yin// thabs brgyas bkri ba'i nyams len rmad du byung*// lam brgyas bgrod kyang 'di nyid snyegs par zad// sems kyi nor bu rang la gnas pa de// bla ma'i drin gyis rang ngo rang la 'phrod// theg mchog snying po'i don la mos pa rgyas// mdor na thams cad bla ma'i bka' drin yin// bka' drin gzhal bar lang ba ma yin kyang*// mos pa'i blo yi bdag gzhan lus longs spyod// kun nas 'dod pa'i yon tan mi dman pa// zag med mchod pa'i sprin du mchod par bzhes// bzhes nas mar gyur 'gro ba ma lus pa// mngon par dga' ba chos dbyings zhing khams su// mi bskyod rdo rjer ro gcig gyur nas kyang*// 'gro don phyogs med 'grub par gyin gyis rlobs// zhes so//

༈ na mo gu ru/ byams dang snying rje byang chub sems kyi snying stobs bla na ma mchis pas sems can gang dag 'khor ba'i btson rar sdug bsngal gyis gzir ba kun la thugs rje'i 'jug pa dus las yol ba med pa/ zab pa dang rgya che ba'i theg tshul rgya mtsho lta bu'i dgongs don gyi nor bus thugs kyi bang mdzod yongs su bltams pa/ rab 'byams shes bya'i tshul ji snyed pa kun sgrib med ji lta bar mkhyen pa'i ye shes mnga' ba/ bde ldan zhing gi mgon po 'od dpag tu med pa'i sgyu 'phrul gyi rnam rol/ zhwa dmar cod pan 'dzin pa drug pa dpal ldan gar dbang chos kyi dbang phyug gi zhal snga nas/ gdul bya'i mos khams dang mtshams par zab gsang rdo rje'i mdzod sgo brgya phrag du ma phye ba las kha 'thor ba 'ga' zhig res zeg tu bkod pa ni 'di lta ste/ de yang zhwa dmar cod pan 'dzin pa'i mtshan gyi byin gyis brlabs pa ming chos kyi dbang phyug tu 'bod pa bdag rang lo bcu gsum pa'i dus/ rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po bzhad pa rdo rje'i dben gnas gnya' gnya'i ri khrod du stan chags pa'i tshe/ bdag cag gi lus dang ngag dang yid kyi skyon gsum bsal nas dad pa'i lam la dkri ba'i bka' drin can/ sems ngo lag bcang du gtod pa/ bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhi dang mi 'jigs pa bzhi sogs sangs rgyas kyi yon tan dang ldan pa karma pa dbang phyug rdo rje'i zhal dkyil yang dang yang du dran pa'i mthus/ slar mos pa cher bskyed nas gsol ba btab pa ni 'di lta ste/ ༈ na mo badzre shwa rā ya/ bla mas byin gyis brlabs pa'i rnal 'byor nga*// dus de ring skyid pa'i glu zhig len// dus de ring dga' ba'i glu zhig len// dpal rdo rje 'chang la gsol ba 'debs// pha mar pa rje yis byin gyis rlobs// gung thang pa la gsol ba 'debs// dbang phyug rdo rjes byin gyis rlobs// gong na dpon med kyi sprang po zhig nga re 'dod// 'og na g.yog med kyi bya btang zhig nga re 'dod// tshe mi rtag rlung nang gi mar me 'dra// de rtag 'dzin mkhan rnams snying nas 'khrul// las rgyu 'bras bslu med kyi rang bzhin la// blo dge chos la mi 'bungs snying re rje// bka' brgyud kyi bstan pa 'dzin mkhan nga*// pha mi la ras pa'i rnam thar skyong*// pha mi la ras par gsol ba 'debs// lar chos nyid stong pa ru rtogs pa la// phyi lha 'dre'i cho 'phrul ga nas 'ong*// rang sems bla ma ru shes pa la// bcos ma'i mos gus su la byed// chos kun spros dang bral ba la// blos byas kyi bsgom rgyu ga nas 'ong*// snang srid bde stong du shar ba la// pha yul logs su ga nas dgos// tshe phyi ma'i 'dun ma ma gtogs pa// gtan gyi gros 'debs logs su med// grogs mched kun thugs la de ltar zhog

/ces zhwa dmar drug pas rang lo bcu bzhi'i thog tu rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug bzhad pa rdo rjes byin gyis brlabs pa'i dben gnas gnya' gnya'i ri sul du bcad rgya'i khongs su blangs pa'i dge bas 'dzam gling bde bar gyur cig/ ༈ na mo gu ru/ de yang rang lo bcu drug pa hor zla dgu pa rjes ma'i tshes bco brgyad kyi skar tshogs 'dus pa'i dus su/ shar phyogs nas shar phyogs su bltas pa na dag pa'i snang ba la/ shar phyogs su shar gyi nam mkha' khyab pa lta bu'i sku mnga' ba'i gzi brjid can gyi rje btsun mi bskyod rdo rje de nyid phyag g.yas pa oṃ dang hūm̐ sbyar ba'i gar stabs kyi 'chi med bum pa'i nang nas bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs te rang gi lus la zhugs pa'i snang ba'i ngang nas sku de yang cung zad tsam na yal ba'i snang ba shar ba'i mod la gsol ba btab pa ni/ rje mi bskyod zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// spyir snang ba la nges pa mi 'dug kyang*// pha bla ma byon pa ngo mtshar bas// yang gsol 'debs kyi gdung shugs 'di ltar lags// rang sems chos dbyings kyi nam mkha' la// nyams sna tshogs kyi rgyu skar 'bum phrag rgyas// rang sems kyi ngo bor bzhugs pa yi// rje bla ma de sangs rgyas kyi ngo bor bzhugs// rang dad pa byed na de la byed// gsol ba zhig 'debs na de la 'debs// phyi snod kyi 'jig rten zhing khams na// nang bcud kyi sems can skar tshogs bkra// sems nyid kyi rgyu ba mang lags kyang*// rje bla ma'i ye shes rol par shar// rang dad pa byed na de la byed// gsol ba zhig 'debs na de la 'debs// rje thugs rje mnga' ba'i karma pa// nga rgyal gyi dong du lhung ba yi// mgon med kyi dred po bdag 'dra la// thugs rje'i mthu nus ma chung bar// byin rlabs kyi snang ba stsal du gsol// mi nga mdo rgyud la sbyangs pa'i dgos pa ni// sang mtha' ru 'khyol bar thugs rjes zungs// rje bla ma 'byon pa'i rtags mtshan 'dis// nga yi bsam pa 'di 'grub par the tshom med// byin rlabs kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol// zhes gsol 'debs su pa nam du bris/

sarba maṅga laṃ/ ༈ de yang thams cad mkhyen pa gar dbang ye shes snying po zhi ba sgra dbyangs kyi rgyal po de nyid lo gsum gyi bcad rgyar bzhugs pa'i tshe/ rgyal dbang chos dbyings rdo rje'i sku drin bzod med du dran nas gdung dbyangs kyis gsol ba btab pa ni 'di lta ste/ dpal mi 'gyur byang chub rdo rje'i gdan// rje sangs rgyas 'dus pa'i ngo bo nyid// khong mda' bsnun rgyal po'i skur snang ba// zhabs padmo'i drwa bar mgos phyag 'tshal// yul byang phyogs lha ldan pakṣu'i 'gram// mtshur mdo bo lung gi dgon pa na// dpal 'jig rten dbang phyug spyan ras gzigs// rje dus gsum mkhyen pa sprul pa'i sku// drin 'khor med chos dbyings rdo rje des// snyigs dus kyi 'gro la lhag brtse ba'i// thugs mi bzod snying rje'i 'od snang can// blo ma rig pa'i sgrib tshogs kun nas bsal// de bsal bas gnyis med kyi ye shes rgyas// de rgyas pas bral smin gyi yon tan smin// de smin pas don gnyis lhun gyis grub// de grub pas lung rtogs kyi snying po mchog /chos phyag rgya che la dbang bsgyur mkhan// thabs kā ru ṇi ka'i 'dzum mdangs can// chos zab mo'i 'od zer kun nas 'phros// mi kho bo'i snying gi mun pa bsal// drin 'khor thabs med pa'i nges shes skyes// don rang byung rig pa'i ye shes dang*// dpal badzra dharma dhā tu'i thugs// sems lhan cig skyes pa'i ngo bor 'dres// chos zad sar 'khyol ba'i dge 'bras rnams// 'gro drug gi rgyud la smin gyur cig /ces so// de yang rgyal mchog dam pa ye shes rdo rje de nyid gzhan don du dgongs sngas/ nged rang byis pa chung ngu'i na tshod du lus/ snyigs dus kyi spyod 'gros la skyo ba skyes/ nged rang gi grwa bu slob tu gtogs pa rnams kyang rang snang ma dag pa'i kun slong gis bcings te sdom gsum gyi rnam dbye skad cig kyang mi dran par bag med kyi spyod pas dus 'da' bar mthong ste yid lhag par skyo bas rgyud bskul te brgyud pa'i bla ma yi dam chos skyong gzhi bdag rnams la 'dod don myur 'grub kyi gsol ba btab pa ni 'di skad do//

dpal rdo rje 'chang dang rnal 'byor ma// rje bka' babs rnams dang tai lo pa// dpal nā ro mai tri la sogs pa'i// khyed byin rlabs brgyud pa dgongs su gsol// lha yi dam chos skyong dkon mchog gsum// kun gcig bsdus ye shes rdo rje nyid// rje byang chub rdo rje'i skur snang ba// dus da res thugs rjes bskyab tu gsol// gnas 'og min grub pa'i pho brang 'dir// phyi so sor thar pa'i tshul khrims dang*// nang byang chub sems dpa'i lhag bsam dang*// gsang bde stong ye shes skyong ba yi// chos sgrub brgyud kyi bstan pa spel ba sogs// yid 'dod don 'grub par byin gyis rlobs// bgegs rigs kyi bar chad bzlog tu gsol// dge legs kyi rgyal mtshan bsgreng du gsol// dpal rang byung rgyal mo la sogs pa// 'dir gnas pa'i gzhi bdag thams cad kyang*// mthun rkyen gyi phrin las mdzad du gsol// bdag dge sbyong chos kyi don grub la// 'dod don gyi dngos po yod do cog /rang 'khris kyi dri ma med lags pas// gzhan don du 'grub pa'i bkra shis stsol// ces pa 'di zhwa dmar cod pan 'dzin pa brgyad pas 'og min dpal gyi mtshur phur mi zad pa'i lo mchu zla'i yar tshes gang ba gnyis pa'i mtshan thun dang por gnang ba'o// rje btsun bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// snyigs dus 'gro la lhag par rjes 'dzin pa'i// byang chub rdo rje'i mtshan can bla ma rje'i// sku gsung thugs kyi mdzad pa ji snyed la// rnam kun mi phyed dad pas phyag bgyi'o// zhes rje btsun bla ma de nyid lho phyogs mon yul du bzhugs skabs 'khor ba'i chos nyid la thugs skyo ba'i tshul du gsung rdo rje'i glur bzhengs pa 'di nyid zin tho rtogs dka' ba zhig snang bas phyis ma ra da ma ka badzras gsal bar bris pa 'di lta ste/ ༈ na mo gu ru/ rje skyabs gnas dkon mchog thams cad kyi// gsang spyi gzugs bla ma mchog la 'dud// ljongs kha ba can gyi lho yi phyogs// nags tshang tshing 'khrigs pa'i dben sa na// mi snyoms las chos ltar bcos pa yi// sems kun gzhi'i mkha' sngon dwangs pa la// yul sna tshogs rtog pa'i chu 'dzin shar// de col chung yi ge'i ris su bris// btson mtha' med rnams kyi sdug bsngal la// gtan thar med 'khor bar rab 'khor ba// 'di bsam gyin bzod med yid rtsa khol// kun thar bar 'dod pa'i blo skyes kyang*// rang sems bskyed rgya khyon chung ba yis// 'gror phan pa'i bgyi ba rngo ma thog

/dus snyigs ma'i spyod 'gros mngon gyur tshe// bstan 'dzin par snyam pa'i blo'i bum pa// spangs rtogs kyi bcud kyis stongs par shar// da sgrub brgyud rnams kyi rjes 'jug pa// mgyogs byed kyi gral du nor skyong bzhin// bdag mi srun rang rgyud ma thul ba// 'di dug la bdud rtsir bsgyur ba bzhin// skyabs bslu med lha tshogs rnams kyi mthus// pha rjes su bu yis slebs pa yi// thugs rje'i zer 'phreng spro bar mdzod// rje bka' brgyud gong ma'i rnam thar la// rmongs bdag kyang lus g.yo mchi ma 'khrugs// chos kun rdzob snang ba phyi'i sgyu ma// gnad ma hā mu dra'i gsang zab mo// 'bad rtsol bral yongs grol don dam pa// mchog mi 'gyur bde chen gzhal yas rtser// don rnam kun mchog ldan bde stong gar// dpal rdo rje 'dzin pa'i rgyal srid che// bdag 'gro ba kun gyis myur 'grub shog /ces lho phyogs bum thang ljon pa'i tshal gyi yang dben du g.yar khral du bris pa dge legs kyi dngos po thams cad kun tu 'byung bar gyur cig/ ༈ bdag cag rnams kyi skyabs gcig rgyal ba'i dbang po dpal karma pa bdud tshogs 'dul ba'i rdo rje'i zhal snga nas slob ma rnams chos la bskul ba'i rdo rje'i mgur bzhengs pa ni/ skyabs dkon mchog gsum la gsol ba 'debs// 'khrul ba'i gnas khang stong nyid la// zhen pa rdo la ri mo bzhin// 'gyur nas sems dbus rgyas btab pa'i// col chung 'gron rnams tshur gson dang*// las 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal bsam mi khyab// de bsam zhing bsam zhing mchi ma 'khrugs// steng lha yul sum cu rtsa gsum na// lha yi bu dang bu mo'i tshogs// 'dod yon rtsed 'jo rgyas lags kyang*// zhag bdun gong gi sngon rol na// 'chi'o zhes pa'i sgra thos tshe// yid la mya ngan dbyug gus bsnun// rang sems sangs rgyas ma rtogs pas// srid pa'i rgya mtshor lhung lags na// rang res lha chos mdzad re ran// bar pa 'dzam gling zhing mchog na// sngon tshe rgyal bstan phyogs bcur rgyas// 'gro mang smin grol thar lam bkod// rdzogs ldan bstan pa dar lags kyang*// deng sang snyigs ma lnga yi dus// dam chos blta ba'i gzhung lugs bor// lag na mgo bskor bre srang thogs// grong yul 'grim pa'i dge bshes kyang*// 'dus byas rang mtshang ston pa'i tshe// 'khor ba'i gnas su 'o re brgyal// rang res lha chos mdzad re ran// 'og phyogs dmyal khams bco brgyad na// tsha grang sdug bsngal bsam las 'das// bskal pa chen po grangs med myong*// rnam par smin pa'i 'bras bu lags// rang res lha chos mdzad re ran// dgos skye rga na 'chi'i sdug bsngal 'di// kun la yod kyang nyam nga med// u dum wa ra'i me tog 'di// rdzogs sangs drung du ma phul na// rang sar yal ba yi re mug

/dal 'byor bco brgyad thob dus 'dir// dam chos mi mdzad shin tu glen// 'chi bdag gshin rje'i pho nya dang*// dus kyi sbrang char zim bu gnyis// nam du 'ong ba cha med pas// dus la bab tshe lha chos kyang*// phyis par nges so rigs kyi bu// lar chos med snyoms las mkhan po 'di// mi tshe yad yud 'gro lags kyang*// sems kyis ma tshor rgan por song*// da dung sdod pa'i cha 'ding zhing*// nang du mkho ba'i chas legs rnams// ba gam phyur bur spungs nas kyang*// nyon mongs dug lnga me bzhin du// phyogs bcur g.yos pas dge ba yi// byang chub shing mchog kun bsregs shing*// nyam thag dmyal ba'i gting rdo la// rings pa bzhin du rgyug pa 'di// kho bo gting nas snying rlung ldang*// lar snying nas dam chos mdzad dgongs na// sngon rdzogs sangs rgyas kyis bka' stsal ba// mdo dam chos dran pa nyer bzhag sogs// las rgyu 'bras kyi 'bras bu yid la soms// thams cad stong nyid rang mdangs la// bdag tu 'dzin pa'i sems nyid 'di// chos sku'i rang zhal ma mthong na// bde ba'i go skabs skad cig med// de phyir gtan gyi go 'phang mchog /myur lam mngon du byed pa yi// ma hā mu dra'i don chen po// gnas lugs mngon du rtogs gyur nas// phun sum tshogs pa nyid gyur cig /ces so// ༈ si tu chos kyi 'byung gnas kyi gsung mgur ni/ ༈ na maḥshrī gu ra we/ skyabs 'khor lo'i mgon po karma pa// rgyal kun las lhag pa'i 'dren pa khyod// bdag dkor zan dred po khyu gcig la// dus da tsam gzigs pa'i skabs yod dam// snyigs ma las snyigs mar gyur pa'i dus// nged 'khor ba rnams kyi spyod tshul 'di// khyed bka' brgyud rnams kyis dgongs srid na// las ngan gyi g.yang las mi srung bar// thugs rje che zhes brdzun du gda'// kye ma 'khor ba'i chos la snying po med// sgos su snyigs ma'i spyod pa la snying po med// khyad par tshul 'chos kyi chos pa la snying po med// yang sgos zob rkyal gyi bla ma la snying po med// ngas sngon chad snying por bzung bas bslus// khyed rnams kyis kyang snying por bzung ba 'khrul// dus deng sang gi 'dul ba 'dzin pa rnams// 'bras spungs dam 'bag pa'i kha dpe ltar// chab len dang lh+wam phud byin len sogs// srog ltar gces pa'i g.yo brdzun gyis// pham pa bzhi 'jol nyog tu spyod pa bsgribs// bsgribs ches pas gzhan mgo gdugs ltar 'khor// 'khor ches pas de 'dra la skyabs su mchi// rje shākya'i dbang po khyed bden na// las de 'dra'i tha ma ci zhig 'gyur// dus deng sang gi byang chub sems dpa' 'ga'// mi drag zhan thams cad 'dzum gyis bsu// stobs 'byor can thams cad chas kas brngan// 'khor sran can thams cad g.yo sgyus 'dul// dga' sdug dang chags sdang med do skad// phyogs med kyi mchod sbyin byed do skad// skad de 'dra'i skad rgyang che drags pas// mi shes shes brdzu byed pa dang gcig

/ma grub grub brdzu byed pa dang gnyis// blo phugs nor la gtad pa dang gsum// gzhogs slong thob 'jal byed pa dang bzhi// chags sdang me ltar 'bar ba dang lnga// hril gyis g.yogs nas sbas pa de// mi grung po rnams kyis kyang ma mthong bar// zang zing gi lcags kyus yid drangs pas// sgo gsum thal bar brlag lugs kyis// rje shākya'i dbang po khyed bden na// las 'di 'dra'i tha ma ci zhig 'gyur// dus deng sang gi gsang sngags 'dzin pa 'ga'// dbang bskur 'chad nyan byed do skad// bsnyen sgrub bcad rgya byas so skad// rlung nus grub rtags thon no skad// rtogs pa nam mkha' dang mnyam mo skad// bstan 'gro'i don chen 'grub bo skad// skad de 'dra'i skad rgyang che grags pas// gzhan bslu mkhan yin par 'phrigs ma tshud// bskyed rdzogs kyi gnad gsang mi shes bzhin// la las bskyed rim bskyed rim zer// la las rdzogs rim rdzogs rim zer// bskyed rdzogs gnyis la rtsod pa shor// don med du dmyal ba'i sa bon thebs// smin pa dang grol tshul mi shes pa'am// shes rkyang du chos la dbang za bas// mig tshum tshum dril bu sil sil dang*// nas thor thor zhal lce bde bde yis// blo bshar rgyugs sprod kyi dbang khrid byas// glo bur du dam nyams khyu gcig bzos// zhen log dang nges 'byung mos gus rnams// rgyang ring du dor nas rtsa rlung dang*// stong pa nyid la sbar zin byas// dge med sdig med kyi lta ba rtogs// rtsa ltung bcu bzhi'i dngos grub thob// byi phrug mang po'i grub rtags thon// bstan pa gcig la mang por phyes// rang phyogs bsrung bar bya ba'am// gzhan phyogs 'joms par bya ba'i phyir// sdig pa la tsham tshom med par 'jug /bstan chus kyi bstan bshigs de ru byung*// na dogs shi dogs kyi rang don dad// so bsod lkog nyal gyi mtshams sgrub byas// chags sdang rmongs gsum gyi 'dun ma la// yid bzlas dang ting 'dzin dus gcig grub// rje shākya'i dbang po khyed bden na// las 'di 'dra'i tha ma ci zhig 'gyur// lar bsams bzhin du karma'i bka' brgyud dran// bsams bzhin du mtshungs med chos rje dran// bdag byis pa chung ngu'i dus nas kyang*// tshul de 'dra la yid smon ma byas shing*// tshe blos btang gi sgrub pa la yid smon kyang*// snyigs dus kyi gzhan dbang bzlog dka' bas// bsam pa bzhin thog tu ma khel mod// de sna thag rang gi mgor dkri ba'i// rang thag rang gis ma chod phyir// rang nyid rul ba ma gtogs pa// le lan gzhan la mi 'dod do// da tshe yi lhag ma ci yod pa// bla ma dkon mchog la blo bkal ba'i// ci yong gang yong sgug pa las// gtan chis kyi grub yul mi 'ding ngo*// lar snang ba sgyu ma lta bu la// sems rtsa bral gyis gnyer kha ma shor bas// blo a 'thas kyi mdud pa mi dam pa// 'di bka' brgyud rnams kyi byin rlabs yin// dngos bstan 'gro'i don chen ma grub kyang*// las dge ba cung zad bsam pa kun// bstan 'gro la phan phyir bsngo smon bgyid// 'di kha tsam tshig tsam ma yin pas// rje rgyal ba rnams kyis dgongs sam snyam// 'khor zog po 'dus pa'i khyu nang du// brdzun rgyab brdzun gyis skyor bzhin du// zol zog gi phreng ba ma spel bas// 'phral g.yeng gi ltad mor mi che na'ang*// las ngan gyi khur po cung zad yang*// tshul 'di yang bla ma rje yi dran// spyir gnas lugs kyi don la blo phyogs pas// bden gnyis kyi gnas tshul cung zad shes// shes rkyang gis 'tsheng par mi 'dug pas// da nyams su longs shig si tu pa// zhes yid la gang shar gyi smyo glu thol byung ma'o//

༈ padma nyin byed dbang po'i gsung mgur ni/ bka' brgyud grub thob rgya mtsho'i thugs rje bskul dbyangs byin rlabs sprin phung zhes bya ba bzhugs so// na mo gu ru padma ka rā ya/ dpal rigs kun bdag po bcom ldan 'das// mchog kha sbyor yan lag bdun ldan sku// rdo rje 'chang dngos su snang ba can// rje bdud 'dul rdo rje'i zhabs la 'dud// rtsod ldan gyi snyigs ma lnga bdo ba'i// dus bskal pa'i rang mdangs ngoms pa'i mthus// bslu chos dang smon lam gom pa yis// phyi ltar snang bzang po'i ngang tshul can// rgyal khams kun 'gengs shing bstan pa spel// chos grub mtha' tha snyad nga rgyal rlom/ ris mthun gyi che dgus skyabs su bsten// 'phral blo sna chos la bsgyur ro skad// phug smon 'brel gyis thar pa'i lam dogs nas// yang srid kyi gnas ngan 'khor mo yug /tshul de 'dra'i g.yang sar ma lhung ba'i// skal ldan rnams las kyi 'phro ldan snyam// sngon sangs rgyas kyi drang nges zab mo'i don// tshul ji bzhin rtogs pa'i gdeng thob pas// rdzu 'phrul gyi bkod pa bsam las 'das// bka' brgyud pa che bzhi chung brgyad dang*// khyad par du 'phags pa sgrub pa'i brgyud// don nges pa karma kaṃ tshang gi /chos brgyud pa'i ring lugs gral chud 'di// sngon dkar po dge ba'i sa bon smin// thob dka' ba'i dal 'byor phun tshogs ldan// mjal dka' ba'i mtshan ldan rin po che// mthing dbang gi cod pan 'chang zhabs bsnyen// dpal 'jig rten dbang dang 'od dpag med// mchog gnyis su med pa'i rang bzhin ni// rgyal shāka thub padma 'byung sogs kyis// mdo sngags rgyud kun tu gsal bar bstan// rje sangs rgyas dngos snang rang gzugs kyi// sku'i dkyil 'khor mjal zhing gsung bdud rtsi// thugs ye shes rdo rje'i byin rlabs thob// skal can las skal par ldan par byas// gsang sngags kyi theg pa'i yang rtse mchog

/dpal nā ro mai tri'i bzhed pa'i gzhung*// chos zab mo gaṅgā'i rgyun bzang po// rje mnga' bdag lo tsā chen po des// blo gros kyi bum par bltams pa yi// lam mthar thug don gyi brgyud pa mchog /rje ras pa chen po nas bzung ste// bdud 'dul ba'i rdo rje'i bar byon pa'i// grub brnyes kyi brgyud pa bar ma chad// chos brgyud pa nye ring bsgrang ma dgos// skal ldan kun dad brtson shes rab kyi// sems mos gus zhen log nges 'byung blos// byams snying rje tshad med mkha' khyab kyi// 'gro ba kun rnam grol sar bkod pa'i// dmigs med kyi ngang du nyams len skyongs// rang dbang de rang la yod dus 'dir// chos brgyad las blo sgyur dben sa bzung*// dam tshig la gces spras 'du 'dzi spong*// nyams len gyi sa bon thebs gyur na// dus nam zhig 'dus byas yal ba'i tshe// chos dbyings kyi mkha' khyab yangs pa ru// bde chen gyi longs spyod rdzogs sku thob// 'gag med kyi sprul sgyur ston nus pa// bka' zab chos byin rlabs drin re che// las nyon mongs drag po'i rlung shugs kyis// zad med kyi rnam g.yeng chu ris ltar// 'khor ba ru yang 'khor bdag 'dzin dbang*// yid byed kyi cho 'phrul dwangs dus med// rje rgyal ba'i thugs rje yol min kyang*// rtag 'dzin gyi rnyed bkur bdud bzhi yi// khri mun gyi dpung gis non lags na// mchog byin rlabs 'od snang bstan du gsol// lus ngag yid nyon mongs dbang gyur na// gnyan po rgyud thog tu khel bar byin gyis rlobs// rten 'brel kun lus la 'grigs par byin gyis rlobs// nyams rtogs pa sems la 'char bar byin gyis rlobs// 'gro don phyogs med du 'grub par byin gyis rlobs// sa lam gyi yon tan 'phel bar byin gyis rlobs// tshe gcig la sangs rgyas thob par byin gyis rlobs// sku bzhi yi rgyal sa zin par byin gyis rlobs// bsam don kun lhun gyis grub par byin gyis rlobs// zhes pa'ang sgrub sde'i bla ma kun spangs pa ā nanta bha dras gser gyi maṇḍal dang bcas 'di ltar bskul ngor/

si tu padma nyin byed dbang pos sa zla'i dkar phyogs gang ba'i dus dge bar spel/ ༈ rgyal ba'i dbang po dpal ldan karma pa theg pa mchog gi rdo rje'i gsung mgur ni/ na mo gu ru/ skyabs dkon mchog kun 'dus chos kyi rje// rigs kun gyi bdag po rdo rje 'chang*// dpal bde ba chen po mi yi gzugs// rje padma nyin byed dbang po zhes// sku mtshan dpe'i gzi brjid lhag par 'bar// gsung gang 'dul bden tshig chos sgo ston// thugs ting 'dzin 'jug ldang bsam mi khyab// bka' brgyud pa gser gyi phreng ba'i rgyan// khyed dgongs pa zab zhi chos kyi dbyings// mgon rgyal ba rnams dang dbyer med kyang*// bdag gsol ba 'debs pa'i bu rnams la// thugs snying rje chen pos dgongs su gsol// mchog 'dus pa'i zil gyis mi gnon pa'i// sku lhun po rdo rje'i bzhugs stangs can// byin rlabs kyi zil chen 'grogs pa de// yid rtse gcig dran pas gsol ba 'debs// lus ser gos gyon kyang mi nag tshul// las ci byas chos 'gal sha stag spyod// dus da lta'i rtags tsam 'dzin rnams kyang*// lus tshul dang ldan par byin gyis rlobs// gsung tshangs pa'i dbyangs kyi chos sgra sgrogs// tshig mtha' dag legs par gsung ba la// mi mi min kun kyang tshad mar gyur// blo gdung shugs drag pos gsol ba 'debs// rdzun long gtam ca cos mi tshe zad// kun khyad gsod mi dge'i las ngan bsogs// ngag sdig pa'i khur gyis non pa rnams// ci smras chos su 'gro bar byin gyis rlobs// spyan rdo rje'i lta stangs mkha' la gzigs// don rtogs pa'i ye shes dbyings dang mnyam// gzhan rjes 'dzin thugs rje rtsol mi 'jug /bdag mos pa'i shugs kyis gsol ba 'debs// nyams len mkhan yin par rlom na yang*// 'khrul rgya 'byams ngang du nyin mtshan mda'// tshe stong zad gtad so med rnams kyi// blo las su rung bar byin gyis rlobs// yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin chen ltar// 'bad med kyi yon tan lhun gyis grub// 'brel tshad la dkar po'i yon tan bgo

/drin can gyi bla mar gsol ba 'debs// bzang yon tan chung la nga rgyal che// rang mthong dang log ltas dag snang bsgribs// skyon ngan gyi gong bu bdag 'dra rnams// rgyud rnam par dag par byin gyis rlobs// rang 'dod dang chos brgyad rtsad nas zad// gzhan phan la btang snyoms skad cig med// 'brel tshad don ldan gyi phrin las can// yid khyed shes mos pas gsol ba 'debs// tshe 'dir snang las la mi tshe yol// kha lto rgyab tsam la sdig pa sgrub// chos lag tu ma lon skal dman rnams// las chos dang mthun par byin gyis rlobs// lar deng sang bstan pa rtags tsam 'dzin// dus snyigs ma'i rnam 'gyur je cher 'phel// mi tshe yang dgun gyi nyi bzhin thung*// rkyen glo bur sdug bsngal mang pos gtser// chos zab dgu dar yang lag len nub// bstan bshigs kyi zog pos rgyal khams gang*// chos min du spyod rnams dbu 'phang mtho// chos tshul bzhin spyod pa nyin skar 'dra// lha dkon mchog gsum la yid mi ches// bdud mi min shi 'dre skyabs su bsten// rgyu blang dor phyin ci log tu sgrub// de byas pas mi 'dod sna dgu 'byung*// rgyal bstan gyi snying po sgrub brgyud bstan// tshul bzhin du 'dzin pa shin tu dkon// ser gzugs kyis sa steng gang na yang*// dgos dus su slebs pa rab tu dkon// kye ma/ sems can mgon med la bsam na snying rjes gdung*// 'khor ba'i 'khrul tshab la bsam na skyo shas skye// rang gis rang phung 'di mthong tshe mchi ma 'khrug /ngan song sdug bsngal 'di dran tshe ya re nga// 'di bsam bzhin dwags po'i bka' brgyud dran// dgos mtshungs med byams mgon chos rje dran// rje mthong bas grol ba padma'i mtshan// reg pas 'tshings pa nyin byed dbang*// dran tsam gyis chog pa'i rin po che// yul mdo khams phyogs su sku 'khrungs nas// tshul bsam mi khyab pa'i phrin las kyis// ljongs bod dang bod chen gyi gdul bya rnams// legs lam la dkri ba'i thabs mkhas kyi// mdzad bzang de nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam// don snying po'i bstan pa rgya cher spel// dbyings rnam thar la tshad dang ris med kyang*// tshe rabs kyi phreng bar rjes bzung nas// sems chos skur ngo sprod bka' drin can// rje khyed la skyabs su gsol ba yi// mi bdag sogs la thugs brtses 'dir dgongs la// thog med nas 'khrul par bslus pa yi// col chung gi rig pa'i khye'u 'di// gzhi zhen log dang nges 'byung gi rkang pa zin// lam mos gus snying rjes rgyud 'khul te// grogs dam tshig spyod pa rnam dag gis// 'bras chos sku tshe 'dir 'grub pa zhig

/rje dpal ldan bla mas byin gyis rlobs// zhes pa 'di yang bla ma karma tshul khrims rgya mtshos bskul ba'i ngor karma pa'i sku phreng bcu bzhi pa'i mtshan 'dzin theg pa mchog gi rdo rjes bris pa dge/ ༈ rgyal bas ting nge 'dzin gyi rgyal po'i mdo sogs las lung bstan pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa blo gros mtha' yas pa'i sde'am/ karma ngag dbang yon tan rgya mtsho'i zhal snga nas phyag rgya chen po'i rtogs pa mngon du gyur pa'i tshe do ha rdo rje'i mgur bzhengs pa ni/ mnyam med dwags po bka' brgyud kyi lta sgom la nges pa cha tsam rnyed pa'i glu gnyug ma rang shar zhes bya ba/ rdo rje 'chang zhes g.yer po che// yon tan brgyad ldan tu skad pa de// bdag tha mal snang ngor mi yi gzugs// mgon padma'i mtshan can byin rlabs can// snying padma 'dab brgyad gur khang du// dus skad cig ma bral gsol ba gdab// rtogs grol dus mnyam gyi skal med kyang*// rang ngo shes tsam gyi byin rlabs thob// chos brgyad la gnyer kha chung du song*// 'od gsal chos sku sgra bo che// thugs yid bsres pas lhag ger mthong*// rnam rtog steng du mi rtog rnyed// blo bral ngang nas ye shes shar// sangs rgyas dwags po'i bu brgyud dang spro bas// rjes shes kyi mgrin pa btegs snying 'dod// nub o rgyan mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod nas// grub thob tai lo chen po yis// nor bu rnam gsum gter kha phyes// byang me tog mdangs 'phrog dgon pa na// mkhas pa nā ro paṇa chen gyis// rlung sems gnyis med kyi grub rtags thon// lho gro bo lung gi sman ljongs su// dgyes mdzad sprul pa'i lo tsā yis// grub thob yongs kyi chu 'go btsugs// nub la phyi gangs kyi ra ba na// skyes mchog bzhad pa rdo rje yis// tshe gcig la zung 'jug go 'phang bsgrubs// shar dwags la sgam po'i zhing khams nas// rgyal ba gnyis pa'i 'tsho byed zhabs// sa bcu pa'i ting 'dzin mngon du gyur// gnas sku gsung thugs kyi 'khor lo na// che bzhi chung brgyad grub pa'i khyu// phyag rgya chen po'i srog mthu grub// sangs la mi rgya ka med byung*// byang chub sems kyi dbang sdud mkhas// 'gro don mi 'byung ka med byung*// tshogs gnyis rdzogs pa'i nor sgrub zab// longs spyod mi rdzogs ka med byung*// gcig shes kun grol mkhyen pa rgyas// lung chen mi thob ka med byung*// pha bsags pa can gyi bu brgyud la// nor rang bzhin che ba sngon gyi las// seng dkar mo khyung chen phru gu rnams// rtsal rang bzhin rdzogs pa rigs kyi mthu// bka' grub thob brgyud pa'i rjes 'jug la// sgom rang bzhin skye ba byin rlabs stobs// lo grangs mang po'i sdug yus dang*// sos dal du bsdad pa'i nga rgyal dang*// sdug u tshugs byas pa'i ham pa dang*// gzhan khyad gsod byed pa'i pho tshod dang*// rang so skye rnam rtog grangs 'debs la// sa lam gyi mngon rtogs brtsi ba sogs// snyigs dus kyi blun sgom khyad chos rnams// mi ldan grub thob kyi ming med kyang*// dpe brgyud pa bzang po'i gdams ngag gis// don phyag rgya chen po'i ye shes mthong*// gzhi phyag chen lta ba'i gnas lugs go

/lam phyag chen sgom pa nyams su myong*// 'bras phyag chen sangs rgyas sems su rtogs// mi nga rang ngan te bla ma bzang*// dus snyigs mar skyes kyang skal ba che// snying rus chung yang gdams ngag zab// gzhi phyag rgya chen po zer tsa na// gnas lugs dang 'khrul lugs gnyis su gda'// 'khor 'das kyi ris su ma chad cing*// sgro skur spros pa'i mtha' dang bral// rgyu yis ma bskyed rkyen ma bsgyur// 'khrul pas ngan tu ma song zhing*// rtogs pas bzang du ma song ba// 'khrul ma myong la grol ma myong*// ngo bo gang du'ang ma grub pas// rnam pa 'gag med cir yang 'char// 'khor 'das kun khyab nam mkha' bzhin// 'khrul dang grol ba kun gyi gzhi// rang gsal shes pa 'char rung can// kun gzhi'i rnam par shes dang bcas// lung ma bstan de'i rig pa'i cha// ngo bo stong la rang bzhin gsal// dbyer med rig pa'i snying po can// ngos bzung med pa bar snang khams// dri med rin chen dwangs pa'i shel// rang rig rang gsal mar me'i mdangs// brjod du med pa lkugs pa'i nyams// ma bsgribs ye shes zang thal ba// 'od gsal chos sku bde gshegs snying*// gdod nas rnam dag lhun gyis grub// dpe sus kyang mtshon par mi nus shing*// tshig gang yang brjod par mi nus la// blos dpyad par mi bzod chos kyi dbyings// 'di thog ma nyid du gtan la dbab// sgro 'dogs thams cad bcad kyang 'tshal// lta thog nas sgom pa skyong ba de// mkha' lding gnam 'phang gcod pa 'dra// gang la'ang nyam nga bag tsha med// lta ba med pa'i sgom pa de// dmus long thang du 'khyams pa 'dra// lam nges pa yin min gtad so med// sgom par mi nus lta ba yang*// phyug po ser snas bcings pa 'dra// rang gzhan la dgos pa'i 'bras mi 'byin// zung 'brel du skyong ba dam pa'i lugs// lung ma bstan pa'i gti mug cha// rgyu mtshan lngas rang ngo ma shes pas// lhan skyes ma rig rgya mtsho las// bdag 'dzin 'khrul pa'i rba rlabs g.yos// rig pa bdag dang rang snang yul// gzung 'dzin gyi bag chags 'thas pa las// las bsags shing de las rnam smin byung*// 'khor ba zo chu'i khyud mo 'khor// 'khor bzhin tu ngo bo dri ma med// snang dus nyid nas bden pas stong*// snang tsam yang sku gsum bkra lam me// skyes pa'i rang bzhin ma skyes pa// ma skyes pa de 'gag pa med// gnyis med par na gnas pa bral// brjod par dka' ba'i sems nyid las// 'khor 'das kyi cho 'phrul sna tshogs shar// rang grol du shes pa lta ba'i mchog

/rtogs na thams cad de bzhin nyid// dgag sgrub med na gnyug ma'i gshis// blo las 'das na mthar thug lags// lam phyag rgya chen po zer tsa na// sems nyid dang snang srid phyag rgya che// sems lhan cig skyes pa chos kyi sku// snang ba lhan skyes chos sku'i 'od// dpal ldan bla ma'i byin rlabs dang*// rang gi las 'phro 'dzoms pa na// sngar 'dris kyi mi bzhin rang ngo 'phrod// bshad bshad mang po'i kha na med// las dang po pa la gang yang dgos// 'das ma 'ongs rtog pa'i skyel bsu spang*// da ltar gyi shes pa skad cig mar// bzo ma byas gnyug ma gshis kyi ngang*// blos ched du bsgom rgyu rdul tsam med// yengs 'khrul bar skad cig ma shor ba// ma yengs mi sgom bzo med gnad// so ma lhug pa rang dwangs ngang*// rnam thar sgo gsum gyi nam mkha' la// dran shes bzhin bya ra legs bkod nas// sems sgrim klod ran pos rtag bskyangs bas// phra rags sbom gsum gyi rtog tshogs zhi// sems ma bcos rang bab ngang la gnas// nyams rim pa bzhi po rim gyis skye// 'od gsal gyi nyi ma khor yug 'char// sgom phyag rgya chen po'i rtsa ba tshugs// 'di med pa'i rtogs pa mtho'o skad// rmings med pa'i mkhar gyi rnam bzhag 'dra// 'dir ha cang zhen pa'ang bdud kyi las// thos chung snying rus can phal cher// ltar snang yon tan gyis blo brid nas// rang gzhan ngan 'gro'i lam sna byed// nyams bzang po bde gsal mi rtog kyang*// 'dzin pa yod na 'khor ba'i rgyu// mos gus kyis snying la gzer btab nas// rig thog tu rdo rus 'phrod pa na// byin rlabs kyi don brgyud 'phos pa las// shor sa bzhi ru ma shor zhing*// gol sa gsum du ma lhung ba/ dga' bzhi las 'das rkyen gsum bral// skye lugs gsum gyis mtshams sbyar bas// chen po gsum gyi blos ma reg /nyams myong bas ma sbags rang byung gshis// sprin med nam mkha'i dkyil lta bu// rang rig rang gsal smrar mi gtubs// dpe bral mi rtog ye shes te// tha mal shes pa rjen pa
