nyid// go yul dang pho tshod du ma lus par// chos kyi sku ru lhag gis mthong*// tshogs drug gi yul snang chu zla bzhin// ye shes kyi ngang du sa la la// gang shar bzo med gnyug ma'i ngang*// cir snang phyag rgya chen po'i gshis// snang srid chos sku bde ba che// sgom rang bab 'jog pa'i zhi gnas dang*// don mthong med mthong ba'i lhag mthong gnyis// gnas 'gyu rig go cog kun la// ya bral ma yin zung du 'jug

/rnam rtog 'khrul pa spang du med// gnyen po'i dge sbyor bsgrub tu med// rang sar slebs pa'i dus shig mchi'o// rtogs pa'i rang so zin pa la// sgom min pa ci yang yod min zhing*// bral thob med pa'i sa mtshams na// sgom pa nyid kyang med mod kyi// blo yi spu ris ma yal ba'i// las dang po pa la sgom pa gces// sgom pa'i thog nas myong ba 'byung*// myong ba rig pa'i rgyan tu shar// lam khyad par dbye na rnal 'byor bzhi// sems rang ngo shes pa rtse gcig yin// de chung 'bring chen po'i rim pa las// bde gsal gyi ngo bo res 'jog mthong*// mnyam bzhag gi ting 'dzin rang dbang thob// nyams 'od gsal snang ba 'khor ma yug /sems rtsa bral du rtogs pa spros bral yin// de chung 'bring chen po'i dbye ba las// skye 'gag gnas gsum stong par rtogs// snang 'dzin stong 'dzin gyi gzhi rtsa bral// chos kun la spros pa'i sgro 'dogs chod// snang sems 'dres pa ro gcig yin// de chung 'bring chen po'i rim pa las// gnyis bsdus kyi chos rnams ro mnyam 'dres// snang sems chu la chu bzhag bzhin// ro gcig las ye shes du ma 'char// blo gtan zad du song ba sgom med yin// de chung 'bring chen po'i rim pa las// bsgom bya sgom byed kun dang bral// shes sgrib kyi bag chags rim gyis byang*// 'od gsal ma bu 'dres pa las// chos dbyings ye shes klong du 'byams// mdor na mnyam par bzhag pa la// sems ci 'dod du gnas pa rtse gcig ste// tha mal gyi shes pa'i rang ngo mthong*// gzhi med du rtogs pa spros bral yin// chos gnyis su 'dzin pa ji snyed kun// rig thog tu grol ba ro gcig ste// sgom mi sgom gyi tha snyad kun las 'das// bag chags zad pa sgom med ces// rnal 'byor dbang phyug chen po'i sa// nā ro mai tri'i dbu bzung nas// rje bla ma padma dbang chen bar// bka' brgyud pa gser gyi phreng ba rnams// sgom med chos sku'i rgyal sar gshegs// sgrib gnyis kyi mun pa dbyings su sangs// mkhyen pa gnyis kyi rtsal chen rgyas// gzhan don mkha' khyab kyi gter kha bye// blo the tshom med pa'i skyabs su bzhugs// bka' brgyud gcig la gcig brten ces// tshig tsam ma yin don la grags// mi rmu rgod so skye bdag 'dra yang*// rje khyed kyi brgyud pa'i rtags 'dzin pas// sgom med kyi rgyal sar myur du drongs// blo gtan zad du mdzod gcig thugs rje can// 'bras phyag rgya chen po skad pa de// gzhi gnyug ma'i sku gsum rang ngo 'phrod// lam lta sgom gnad du bsnun pa las// 'bras dri bral sku gsum mngon tu 'gyur// gshis stong nyid spros bral chos kyi sku// gdangs rang bzhin gsal ba longs spyod rdzogs// rtsal sna tshogs 'gag med sprul pa'i sku// dngos po kun gyi khyab bdag ste// zung 'jug rang bzhin phyag rgya che// spang thob med pa chos kyi dbyings// zag med bde ba'i lang tsho can// ye shes kyi longs spyod rgya che ba// thugs rje'i rang gzugs bsam las 'das// shes pas srid la mi gnas shing*// snying rjes zhi la mi gnas par// rtsol med kyi phrin las lhun gyis grub// gzhi lam gyi 'od gsal ma bu 'dres// gzhi 'bras gnyis po lto ba 'byor// sangs rgyas rang gi sems las rnyed// dgos 'dod kyi gter kha nang nas brdol// e ma ngo mtshar rmad du byung*// phyag rgya chen po'i lta ba la// 'di yin gyi dpyad ra mi 'jug pas// yid byed kyi shes pa rgyang du bskyur// phyag rgya chen po'i sgom pa la// 'di snyam gyi 'dzin stangs ma mchis pas// bcos ma'i mnyam bzhag bor la thong*// phyag rgya chen po'i spyod pa la// 'di byed kyi gtad so mi bdog pas// bya dang mi bya'i rtog pa phral// phyag rgya chen po'i 'bras bu la// 'di bsgrub kyi gsar thob ma mchis pas// re dogs 'dod blo ring du btang*// 'di bka' brgyud yongs kyi dgongs pa'i mthil// sras bcas rgyal ba'i bgrod gcig lam// srid pa'i 'khrul 'khor zlog pa'i thabs// tshe gcig sangs rgyas thob pa'i chos// bka' mdo rgyud yongs kyi nying khu ste// mi bdag dang mkha' khyab 'gro ba kun// chams gcig tu rtogs grol dus mnyam nas// phyag rgya chen po mchog grub shog

/'di'ang rnam kun mchog ldan gyi stong nyid shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa nyid rnam pa rdo rje 'dzin pa'i zol du snang ba'i gsung rnam pa thams cad pa'i rgya las mi 'da' ba'i slad du/ padma'i 'bangs yon tan rgya mtsho blo gros mtha' yas pa'i sdes/ de bī ko ṭi gsum pa tsā 'dra rin chen brag gi g.yon mgul kun bzang bde chen 'od gsal gling du smras pa shu bham// ༈ de yang rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug ban sgar 'jam dpal bzang po zhes bya ba de nyid gnyan chen po thang lhas 'tsho ba lo bcu gnyis kyi bar du sbyar nas phyag rgya chen po'i thugs dam 'ba' zhig la bzhugs pa na lo bdun song ba'i mtshams/ thams cad mkhyen pa mthong ba don ldan zhing gzhan du gshegs pa'i mtshan ma gzigs pas spyan chab char ltar 'brub cing yid rtse gcig tu gdung bas gsol ba btab pa ni/ ༈ na mo gu ru/ mtshan ldan gyi bla ma brgya yod kyang*// drin ldan gyi bla ma gcig las med// mtshan brjod par dka' ba'i karma pa// 'bral med du spyi bo'i gtsug tu bkur// khyed 'jig rten dbang phyug sa ra ha// dpal rta mgrin padma 'byung gnas sogs// dus gsum gyi bde bar gshegs pa khyed// dus snyigs ma'i 'gro ba'i mgon du byon// mi bdag gi dpal du shar pas legs// nga bdag la re ltos bcas pa'i mi// khong la las dad pa'i rnam 'gyur byas// khong la la zhen pa'i yid mos byed// khong la la gzhan gyi der rjes phyogs// tshul ji ltar byas kyang re ltos bcas// de 'dren pa'i nus pa bdag la med// khyed thugs rje ldan pa'i rdo rje 'chang*// thugs mkha' ltar yangs pa'i klong yangs na// sku mtshan dpes spros pa'i 'od stong 'bar// gsung zab mo'i dbyangs kyi tsha zer gyis// nged mos pa'i bu slob ji snyed pa// sang bde chen gyi gnas su lam sna drongs// lam zab mo rim gnyis kyi rnal 'byor thos// de thob kyang nyams su len pas dben// blo yengs ma lam du mi tshe zad// tshe 'di pa'i rjes su 'brangs pa yi// grogs mig ltos ngan pa'i dbang song nas// rang gcig rkya thub pa ma byung bas// yid rtse gcig snying nas gsol 'debs na// da ci byed bla ma dkon mchog mkhyen// rje mtshan ldan gyi bka' drin dran pa'i dus// yus ches pas cal col gsol 'debs 'di// rkyen nges 'byung cha tsam skyes pa'i tshe// tshig ri mo'i ngos su bkod pa yin// zhes so// de yang rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug ban sgar 'jam dpal bzang po zhes bya ba de nyid kyis drin can chos kyi rje mthong ba don ldan gyi sprul pa'i sku chos grags rgya mtsho 'khrungs pa'i mtshan ma gsal bar gzigs pa'i tshe dad pa'i shugs kyis spro ches pas 'di skad du/

༈ na mo gu ru/ ban de ri stong du thon na rgyang glu len// de mi len rgyu nyams myong gi spang gshong la// sems rtogs pa'i rtsi thog 'khrungs pas len// da dga' yo skyid do drin can rje// mi nga ni bla ma dgyes pa'i bu// nyams rtogs pa 'di rje btsun gyi phyag rten byed// rje dran no yang yang gsol ba 'debs// bdag mos pa'i bu la byin gyis rlobs// phyi dal 'byor lus la tshangs spyod kyis brgyan// nang byang chub sems gnyis kyi dkyil 'khor bkra// lam rim pa gnyis kyi srang la zhugs// da dga' yo skyid do drin can rje// lus tha mal zhen pa rgyang bsrings te// khams phung po skye mched sna tshogs pa// lha yi dam rgyal ba'i sku ru ldang*// da dga' yo skyid do drin can rje// ngag rlung gi sbyor ba gnad du bsnun// sngags rdo rje gsum gyi bzlas pas bran// las rlung gi rgyu ba dbu mar ldang*// da dga' yo skyid do drin can rje// sems bde stong phyag rgya chen po la// don 'od gsal lhan cig skyes pas brgyan// 'di chos sku'i ngang du lhang nge ba// da dga' yo skyid do drin can rje// blo gtad sa dkon mchog gsum la byas// phugs 'phral gang gnyis kyi skyabs gnas zhus// ci bsam pa thog tu khel bar byung*// da dga' yo skyid do drin can rje// nor zang zing 'di la zhen pa log /mi mar 'dren gyi kha la ma nyan pas// sprang bya btang gi kyus mgo thon par byung*// da dga' yo skyid do drin can rje// pha drin can gyi sku drin dran par byung*// nyams dga' bas de skad kha nas shor// 'di nges par bdag la yod pa min// da myur du 'grub par byin gyis rlobs// zhes gsol ba'o// ༈ na mo gu ru/ rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug tai lo pas nub phyogs so ma pu ri'i gtsug lag khang du zhabs la lcags sgrogs gsol nas lo bcu gnyis sgrub pa mdzad pas/

thun mong gi dngos grub yi dam lha'i zhal gzigs/ 'byung ba'i skye mched rag pa la dbang thob nas spyod pa la gshegs par dgongs pa la/ bla ma dang mkhan pos ma gnang bas gsung bcag na mi rung ba la/ nya'i rnam shes nam mkha' la spar pa'i rdzu 'phrul bstan pas/ thams cad kyis grub pa thob par shes te khong rang ci bder btang ba dang*/ rgya gar lho phyogs kyi rgyud du slob dpon nā gārdzu na tshol du phyin pas/ lho phyogs kyi rgyud na 'jigs byed bzhad pa zhes bya ba'i dur khrod chen po zhig na lha dbang phyug chen po'i rten yod pas/ nang pa dang phyi pa'i ḍā ki mang po dus bzang la re mos kyis tshogs nas/ tshogs kyi 'khor lo byed pa zhig yod pa na slob dpon brtul zhugs spyod pa ma taṃ gi spyil por bzhugs pa dang 'jal ba la gu ru nā gā rdzu na'i rgyus yod dam dris pas/ gu ru dri za'i rgyal po la chos gsung du gshegs/ skyes bu khyod rjes su 'dzin pa la nga mngags pa yin gsungs pas the tshom med par maṇḍal phul te/ bla mar bzung ba las de nyid du dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i dbang bskur/ gdams pa byin nas sems kyi de kho na nyid 'di ltar yin pas/ de kho na nyid kyi don la dus rtag tu ma yengs par sgoms shig /ces gdams nas rigs kyi nga rgyal bcag pa dang*/ lam gyi rtogs pa mngon du bya ba'i spyod pa rjes su gnang ste/ skyes bu khyod 'di nas shar phyogs bhaṃ ga la'i rgyud sa tshigs ring por phyin pa na ha ri kī la zhes bya ba za hor gyi grong khyer chen po zhig yod de/ sngon rā dza ud ma ki ma ra zhes bya ba sprul pa'i rgyal po zhig gis byin gyis brlabs pa'i sa phyogs yin te/ rang bzhin gyis sgrub thag nye zhing lam bgrod par myur ba yod pas/ grong khyer de'i dbus na pañtsa pa ṇa zhes bya ba 'dod yon lnga 'dzom pa'i tshong 'dus zhig yod de/ de na ḍā ri ma smad 'tshong ma'i g.yog 'khor mang po dang bcas yod pas/

de'i g.yog gyis la lam gyi rtogs pa sbyongs shig /ring por mi thogs par phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub thob par 'gyur la/ 'gro ba mang po yang sgrol bar 'gyur ro// zhes lung bstan par mdzad de/ rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug des kyang bla ma'i bka' bzhin du bsgrubs nas/ mtshan mo bzhin smad 'tshong ma de'i skyes pa 'gugs pa dang skyes pa'i grogs byed cing nyin mo bzhin til rdung ba'i las byed pa las/ ci zhig ltar na gnas lugs de kho na nyid kyi rtogs pa mngon du gyur te/ phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub brnyes pa las/ grong khyer ba rnams la mthong tshul tha dad pa byung ste/ la las me dpung 'bar ba gcig la mar me bcu bzhis bskor ba mthong*/ la las 'od kyi phung po zhig gi nang na dge slong zhig mnyam bzhag la bzhugs par mthong*/ 'ga' zhig gis ni rnal 'byor pa dur khrod kyi chas kyis brgyan pa zhig la bu mo mang pos phyag dang bskor ba byed par mthong nas ḍā ri ma la bsnyad de ltar phyin pas mdun gyi nam mkha' la 'od phung gi dbus su rgyal po rol pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs nas phyag g.yas kyis gtun shing lhung thabs su skyur zhing til 'bru ba mthong bas/ ḍā ri ma 'gyod pas sems gdungs te/ phyag dang bskor ba maṇḍal sngon du 'gro bas zhabs spyi bor blangs nas/ rje btsun khyed grub thob tu 'dug pa ngo ma shes nas sngon sdig bsags pa bzod par bzhes 'tshal/ deng phyin chad rjes su gzung du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas rnal 'byor pa'i zhal nas/ khyod kyis nga la gang zag dam par shes bzhin du las bcol ba ma yin pas nyes pa med de/ ngas spyod lam de la brten nas lam sbyangs pa yin pas/ da lta nga'i rgyud la skyes pa'i chos thams cad rang bzhin skye ba med pa gnyug ma lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes 'di khyod kyi snying la 'jug par gyur cig /ces gsungs shing me tog spyi bor bzhag pa tsam gyis de nyid du grol te byin rlabs kyi lam la snang ba thob pa'i rnal 'byor mar gyur to// de tsam na sprul pa'i rnal 'byor pa zhig gis ḍā ri ma grol bar byas so zhes rgyal pos thos te/

glang po che la bzhon nas 'khor mang po dang thabs gcig tu blta ba la lhags pas rnal 'byor pa dang ḍā ri ma gnyis tshong 'dus kyi srang mdor shing tā la bdun srid tsam du nam mkha' la 'phags nas bzhugs te/ tshangs pa chen po'i sgra dbyangs kyi nga ros rdo rje'i mgur bzhengs pa/ gang zhig snying por gyur pa til gyi mar// rmongs pas til la yod par shes gyur kyang*// rten cing 'brel 'byung yan lag ma shes pas// til mar snying po 'byin par mi nus ltar// lhan cig skyes pa gnyug ma'i ye shes de// 'gro ba kun gyi snying la gnas gyur kyang*// bla mas ma mtshon rtogs par mi nus te// til mar bzhin du bzhugs pa gsal ba min// til brdungs phub ma bsal bar gyur pa las// til mar snying po 'byung ba de bzhin du// bla mas bstan pa de bzhin nyid kyi don// yul rnams dbyer med ngo bo gcig tu 'gyur// kye ho// ring du 'gro ba gting dpag dka' ba'i don// da lta nyid du gsal ba ngo mtshar che// zhes don dam par lam sbyang bya dang spang gnyen gyi khyad par dang 'bras bu'i spangs rtogs la sogs pa med kyang kun rdzob tu chos thams cad rgyu 'bras la rag las pas/ til dang til mar gyi dpes bstan te/ gtun dang gtun shing dang skyes bu'i lag pa'i 'du byed kyis brdung ba dang*/ 'tshir bar ma byas na mar gyi don byed mi nus te/ ci'i phyir zhe na rgyu gcig gis ma yin rkyen gcig gis ma yin thams cad rten 'brel kyi nus pa tshogs pa las 'byung bas so// de bzhin du sems can thams cad la chos kyi sku yis khyab kyang*/ bla mas ma mtshon lam gyi rtogs pas ma sbyangs na 'bras bu mngon du mi byed pas kun rdzob tu chos thams cad rgyu 'bras rten 'brel la rag las pas 'di ltar ro// zhes til brdungs pa la brten nas de kho na nyid kyi ye shes mngon du gyur pa'i rtogs tshad brjod pas/

dus der de bzhin nyid kyi sgra thos pa tsam gyis der 'dus pa thams cad nyon mongs pa'i 'ching ba las grol te de kho na nyid kyi ye shes mthong zhing mkha' spyod kyi dngos grub thob nas lan gcig za hor gyi yul de stongs bar gyur to zhes grags so// ༈ rje mar pa'i mgur chen rnams bzhugs so// na mo gu ru/ gnyug ma spros bral chos kyi sku// 'od gsal 'gro 'ong med pa la// gzhan don brtse ba chen po yis// longs spyod rdzogs pa'i skur bstan nas// sa bcu'i 'khor rnams 'dul mdzad pa'i// bde gshegs drug pa rdo rje 'chang*// des gsungs bka' rnams sdud pa po// gsang bdag phyag na rdo rje dang*// rje btsun mkha' 'gro su ma tis// byin gyis brlabs mdzad sprul pa'i sku// tilli zhes byar grags pa yi// rnal 'byor dbang phyug thugs kyi sras// dka' ba spyad pa'i nā ro pa// mkhyen pa'i mnga' bdag 'dzam gling rgyan// zhabs rdul ze'u 'bru bsten mdzad pa'i// sgra sgyur mar pa lo tsā dang*// ras chen yab sras la sogs pa'i// bka' brgyud rnams la gus phyag 'tshal// rdo rje theg pa'i rgyal srid kyis// 'gro ba skyong mdzad chos kyi rje// lho brag mar pa'i zhabs la 'dud// de nas rje mar pas dpal nā ro pa la bde mchog gi dbang rgyud 'grel bshad rnams dgos zhes gsol ba btab pas/ dbang rgyas par gnang rgyud 'grel bshad lung du gnang nas gal nyams len che ba yin gsungs/ bka' babs bzhi'i gdams par grags pa nā ro chos drug dang gnyug ma lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes sems su ngo sprod pa phyag rgya chen po rnams gnang nas bsgoms pas/ spyir gyi gsang sngags bla med kyi nyams rtogs khyad par can mang po thugs la 'khrungs shing*/ khyad par du gtum mo bsgoms pas bde gsal mi rtog pa zung 'jug mngon du gyur pas sgo gsum g.yo 'gul mi nus pa'i ngang la zhag bdun gyi bar brtan pa thob pa dang*/

rtags bcu rnams byung bas thugs spro ba'i ngang nas nyin mtshan 'da' ba byung ngo*// de nas mar pa'i thugs dgongs la ngas bal po dang rgya gar du lo bcu gnyis tsam song 'dug /dbang dang gdams ngag thob pa tsam du ma bzhag par tshig don gnyis la slob gnyer dang nyams len rang mi 'gyod pa byas pas smra rgyu dang sgom rgyu yang gzhan la smon mi dgos pa byung*/ da gser phal cher rdzogs 'dug pas re zhig bod la phyin gser ci mang rang zhig bsgrubs te/ slar yang rgya gar du yongs nas bla ma rnams 'bul bas mnyes pa dang chos sngar thob pa rnams la dogs gcod nan tan byed pa dang ma thob pa rnams ci thob byed/ bod du spyir sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa sgos sgrub brgyud kyi bstan pa dar ba zhig cis kyang byed dgongs pa shar nas gser lhag ma gang yod kyis lam chas tsam zhig ma gtogs kun gyis yo byad bsgrubs te bram ze su ka ma ti dang*/ rnal 'byor ma su kha dha ri la sogs pa rnams bkug nas paṇa chen nā ro pa la gtang rag dang dga' ston du tshogs mchod phul ba'i gral du mar pa'i thugs dgongs la/ yang bod nas rgya gar du 'ongs pa'i don la bla ma mkhas shing grub pa brnyes pa mang po dang mjal/ rgyud 'grel pa dang bcas pa mang po thob cing slob gnyer byas/ sgra skad lo tsā ni mkhas pa'i tshad du shes/ nyams dang rtogs pa phyin ci ma log pa ni rgyud la skyes/ da bar chad med par bod du log 'gro ba yin pas dus de ring las dga' ba mi yong dgongs nas mgur chen brgyad kyi thog ma dpal nā ro pa'i drung du dbyangs ring tambu ra'i khong rgyud kyi skad la rta drangs te/ rtogs pa 'di mgur tu phul ba lags so// ༈ rje mtshan ldan gyi bla ma rin po che// khyed sngon sbyangs bsod nams bsags pa'i phyir// sprul sku tai lo dngos dang mjal// spang dka' srid pa'i sdug bsngal la// khyad du bsad pa bcu gnyis mdzad// dka' ba spyad pa'i thugs dam des// skad cig nyid la bden pa gzigs// shrī dzña na siddhi'i zhabs la 'dud// sgra sgyur bod kyi ban chung nga*// sbyangs pa snga ma'i las 'brel gyis// nā ro paṇa chen khyed dang mjal// rgyud zab mor grags pa'i dgyes rdor bslabs/

snying po ma hā mā yā gnang*// yang snying bde mchog 'khor lo zhus// lar rgyud sde bzhi yi khong snying phyung*// ma skal ba bzang mos rjes gnang ba'i// byin rlabs kyi chu rgyun ma chad pa'i// dbang bzhi'i don la ngo sprod mdzad// zag pa med pa'i ting 'dzin skyes// zhag bdun bar du brtan pa thob// srog rtsol 'pho ba nyi zla gnyis// g.yo med nam mkha'i khyim du tshud// rang byung lhan cig skyes pa'i nyams// bde gsal mi rtog khong nas shar// bag chags gnyid kyi 'khrul pa de// 'od gsal lam gyi ngo bor rtogs// yid kyi g.yo ba gzung 'dzin gnyis// spros bral chos kyi sku ru thim// phyi snang ba sgyu ma'i 'khrul 'khor 'di// skye med phyag rgya chen por rtogs// nang 'dzin pa yid kyi rnam shes 'di// sngon chad mdza' bo 'phrad pa bzhin// sems nyid rang ngo rang gis shes// lkugs pas rmi lam rmis pa bzhin// brjod du med pa'i nyams shig shar// gzhon nus bde ba myong ba bzhin// smra ru med pa'i don gcig rtogs// rje sku drin che'o nā ro pa// sngar yang dbang bskur byin gyis brlabs// da rung sku drin bskyang du gsol// zhes rtogs pa phul bas paṇa chen nā ro pa'i phyag mar pa'i dbu thog tu bzhag nas zhal gdams kyi mgur 'di gsungs so// ༈ bod yul gyi mar pa lo tsā khyod// chos brgyad tshe 'di'i don ma sgrubs// gzung 'dzin nga khyod ris ma gcod// nye du dgra la skur ma 'debs// gzhan gyi chos la sgro ma 'dogs// thos bsam mun sel sgron me yin// thar pa'i lam mchog 'phrang ma gcod// sngar yang bla rje yin pas chog /phyis kyang khur cig blos ma spongs// rang sems nor bu rin chen 'di// dred por chu la ma bskur bar// bag zon yengs med srungs shig dang*// dgos 'dod bsam pa thams cad 'grub// ces pa dang*/ gzhan yang thugs brtse ba'i gsung mang po gnang ba rnams la dgyes bzhin du slar yang sku drung du yong ba'i dam bca' phul nas bod la byon no// de nas rje mar pas bod la chas byon pa las li sho ka ra zhes bya ba bal bod mtshams kyi grong khyer sho gam len pa zhig yod pa der zhag shas bzhugs dgos byung ba las/

nub tha ma'i rmi lam la mkha' 'gros 'do li la btegs nas lho phyogs dpal gyi ri la byon pas bram ze chen po sa ra ha dang mjal te lus ngag yid gsum byin gyis brlabs/ snying po don gyi chos phyag rgya chen po'i brda don rnams gnang bas/ sku la zag med kyi bde ba dang*/ thugs la phyin ci ma log pa'i rtogs pa shar bas dga' spro dpag tu med pa zhig rmis pa las/ mnal sad nas kyang gsung rnams ma brjed par 'dug ste dga' spro dang bcas pa'i ngang nas mang yul du phebs te glang po mkhar du zla ba gnyis tsam chos gsung zhing bzhugs pas/ gtsang dgyer phu'i klog skya jo sras de sku gshegs nas gdan sa mdzad pa'i sras po che bas gsan te skyid grong du spyan 'dren mi btang byung ba la 'byon par zhal gyis bzhes dus btab nas btang bas dpal khud kyi lha mtsho srin mtsho nas bsu ba dang*/ dgyer phur gdan phebs pas sna len bzang po byas/ zla ba gcig gi bar chos grwa bzang po gtsugs/ zla ba yar ngo'i tshes bcu'i nyin dpa' bo dga' ston gyi tshogs 'khor bskor ba'i gral du/ jo sras kyis bla ma mar pa la/ bla ma khyed la nged yab sras kyis sngar yang sna len bzang po byas/ da yang bgyid lags pas/ de ring tshogs gral 'dir sngon chad tshig tu ma brjod cing tshig dang don du 'gril ba'i dbyangs shig gsung 'tshal zhus pas/ kho bos kha sing dpyid ka bal po'i mthil nas yar dro lam gcig yongs pa'i sa na/ li sho ka ra bya ba mtha' 'khob kyi grong khyer sho gam mang po len pa zhig 'dug pa der kho bos zhag 'ga' bsdad pas nub gcig gi rmi lam na/ rigs kyi mtshan ldan ma bram ze'i bu mo'i cha byad du byas nas kho bo la lho phyogs dpal gyi ri la 'dengs zer nas khrid de/ bram ze chen po dang dngos su mjal ba lta bu'i rmi lam byung*/ de'i dus yid la mi byed pa'i snying po'i don bram ze chen po'i zhal nas 'di lta bu thos gsungs te lta ba khyung chen gshog rgyang lding pa'i skad la rta drangs te sems gnad du bsnun pa do ha rdo rje'i mgur chen 'di gsungs so//

༈ dpal de ring bkra shis yar gyi ngo*// dus khyad par can gyi tshes bcu la// dpa' bo dga' ston gyi tshogs gral du// bu 'gyur ba med pa'i dam tshig can// khyod klog skya jo sras zhu 'bul ba// sngar ma thos pa'i glu long skad// nga shul ring lam la shar ba des// lus ngal dub dbang du song ba'i phyir// glu yid 'phrog snyan po ma mchis shing*// tshig sdeb sbyor mkhas po mi shes kyang*// grogs khyed las ngo che med pa'i phyir// ngo che'i dpral pa mi ldog pas// don sngar ma thos pa'i ya mtshan can// rje bram ze'i bzhed dgongs glur len pas// khyed gdan gang bzhugs pa'i mdo sngags rnams// snyan lhan ner gsan la thugs dgongs 'tshal// dus kha sang dpyid zla tha chung la// gzhi bal po'i mthil nas yar 'phags pa'i// gdugs dro lam mchis kyi shul kha na// bal po ling gi sho gam ri// gdol pa can gyi grong khyer du// mi brda mi 'jal gyi sho gam pas// mgron kha zhan po yi bod rnams bskyil// mi ngas kyang dbang med zhag 'ga' bsdad// dgung nub gcig tham thum rmi lam na// rigs kyi mtshan ldan tshangs skud can// bram ze'i bu mo mdzes ma gnyis// cung zad 'dzum zhing zur mig lta// mi kho bo'i drung du 'ongs nas kyang*// lho dpal gyi ri la 'gro dgos skad// kho bos sngon chad phyin ma myong*// rgyus med lam yang mi shes smras// bu mo gnyis kyi zhal na re// khyod ming pos dka' ba spyad mi dgos// nged kyis phrag la khur gyi zer// 'do li dar gyi lding khrir bcug /gdugs bzhin mkha' la btegs nas kyang*// glog 'gyu skad cig yud tsam la// lho dpal gyi ri la phyin pa rmis// shing pākṣa ljon pa'i bsil grib la// ti ra ro yi gdan steng na// rje bram ze chen po sa ra ha// zhal sngar ma mthong ba'i gzi mdangs can// btsun mo gnyis kyis mtha' brten nas// sku la dur khrod chas kyis brgyan// dgyes pa'i zhal ras 'dzum mdangs can// bu bde bar 'ongs sam zhes kyang gsungs// rje mthong bar dga' bas ma bzod par// lus kyi spu g.yos mchi ma 'khrugs// lan bdun bskor zhing rkyang phyag 'tshal// zhabs mthil spyi bor blangs nas kyang*// pha thugs rjes zung zhes gsol btab pas// lus la sku yis byin brlabs pa// phyag dbang spyi bor reg tsam gyis// lus zag med bde bas ra ro ba// glang chen chang gis myos pa bzhin// g.yo 'gul med pa'i nyams shig shar// ngag la gsung gis byin brlabs pa// stong nyid seng ge'i nga ro yis// yi ge med pa'i don gsungs pa// lkugs pas rmi lam rmis pa bzhin// brjod du med pa'i nyams shig shar// yid la thugs kyis byin brlabs pa// lhan cig skyes pa chos kyi sku// 'gro 'ong med pa'i don rtogs pas// dur khrod gnas pa'i mi ro bzhin// bsam du med pa'i nyams shig shar// de rjes bde chen dag pa'i gsung*// rin chen mgul gyi bum pa nas// tshangs pa'i dbyangs kyi brda skad kyis// sprin bral nam mkha' stong pa'i don// gnas lugs mtshon pa rdo rje'i mgur// skye med rang sgra 'di skad thos// na mo stong nyid snying rje dbyer med pa// rgyun chad med pa gnyug ma'i sems// gdod nas dag pa de bzhin nyid// nam mkhas nam mkha' sbyor ba mthong*// rtsa ba khyim na gnas pa'i phyir// yid kyi rnam shes btson du gzung*// sgom pa shes pa phyi ma yis// sems la lhan pa gdab tu med// snang srid sems kyi rang bzhin shes// gnyen pos bcos te sgom du med// sems kyi gnas lugs dran du med// de yang ma bcos ngang la zhog

/de don mthong na grol ba'i phyir// bu chung gdol pa'i spyod la ltos// sha za smyon pa gang dgar thong*// bsnyengs dang bral ba'i seng ge bzhin// sems kyi glang po yan du chug /bung ba me tog rgyu ba ltos// 'khor ba skyon du mi blta zhing*// mya ngan 'das pa thob byar med// tha mal shes pa rang lugs de// ma bcos so ma nyid du zhogs// bya ba rnams la khyod ma rtogs// phyogs dang cha la mi gnas shing*// spros bral nam mkha'i dkyil du ltos// chos zad sar 'khyol ba snying po'i don// lta ba'i yang rtse phyag rgya che// sems gnad du bsnun pa'i brda don zhig /bram ze chen po'i zhal las thos// skad cig de la gnyid kyang sad// de ma brjed dran pa'i lcags kyus zin// ma rig gnyid kyi mun khung du// rig pa ye shes mthong phye nas// sprin med mkha' la nyi shar ltar// 'khrul pa'i mun nag sangs nas thal// dus gsum sangs rgyas zhal mjal kyang*// phyin chad zhu rgyu med do snyam// sems kho thag chod pa'i nyams shig skyes// yid 'gyu ba zad pa ngo mtshar che// e ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i lung bstan dang*// bla mas gsungs pa zab mo'i don// ngag smra ru mi btub gsungs na yang*// dgung do nub mi smra'i thabs ma byung*// dus da res tsam zhig ma gtogs pa// sngon chad ngag tu brjod ma myong*// da phyin chad bzlas sam rna bas nyon// nga sngon chad shul ring rgyang gi mi// mdza' bshes gnyen med grogs kyang med// lus ngal dub bkres par gyur pa'i tshe// bu khyod kyis gang byas sems la yod// de ma brjed sems la shin tu gcags// drin 'khor bar thal lo snying gi grogs// rje gong na bzhugs pa'i bla ma dang*// dngos grub ster ba'i yi dam lha// bar chad sel ba'i chos skyong rnams// mi bdag la bka' bkyon mi gnang 'tshal// don 'khrul par gda' na bzod par gsol// zhes pa'i mgur gsungs pa dang klog skya jo sras kyis bla ma sangs rgyas dngos su mthong ngo*// de nas yang rje mar par rgya gar la 'byon gsung pa la/

slar yang slob 'bangs kun gyis phyag phul nas da sku na byon pa dang rgya gar gyi 'byon lam na dpal mo dpal thang zhes bya ba'i thang chen po rta yang ngal dub chad pa dang kha la bye la zhes bya ba shin tu grang bas dbyar yang 'khyags pa dang rong dang bal po tshad pa shin tu che ba dang*/ chu bo gaṅgā chu chen po 'jigs su rung ba dang rgya gar mtha' 'khob dang lam bar gyi yul phran mu ge che zhing ar jag rgod pa rnams ni bla ma rang gi gsung tshad ma lags pas bden nges yin/ da de lta bu'i nyen la bsdos nas rgya gar byon rung sku tshe'i bar chad du song na rang re grwa pa bu slob gdul byar gyur pa rnams su la re zhing ji skad byed/ gang zag gis nyams len nus na chos sngar bod du bsgyur ba rnams kyis ci dgos chog /bla ma ni thugs kyi dkyil du sgom zhing bzhugs pa la gsol ba 'bral med du btab pas/ thugs rje'i byin rlabs la thag nye ring med phyir 'dir bzhugs rung chog lags mod/ cis kyang sngar bod du spyan drangs pa'i chos kyis mi chog par len dgos na sras dar ma mdo sde phyag phyi ba dang bcas pa la bslab bya lam yig gnang*/ chos zhu ba la brdzangs te bla ma rang da lan bod kyi gdul bya rnams la dgongs nas cis kyang bzhugs pa thugs rjes 'dzin par zhu zhes gsol ba btab pas/ bla ma'i zhal nas/ bla ma'i thugs rje la nye ring med rung ngas da dung mjal du yong ba'i dam bca' 'phul yod/ bod kyi gdul bya rnams la thugs brtse ba'i phyir sngar ma thob pa'i gdams ngag khyad par can yod phyir len pa la mkha' 'gros brda bkrol nas bskul 'debs rim pas byed pa la nges shes 'drongs pas 'gro ba yin/ de la spyir dar ma mdo sde btang rung na gzhon pas kun sems las che ba min pa mi yong zhing*/ khyad par ngas bla ma'i drung du nga rang yong bar zhus pa ma gtogs bu gtong bar ma zhus/ tshong pa rgan po lus zung ngan rung lam rgyus bzang zer ba ltar/

nga lus cung zad rgas rung rgya gar du mi bgrod pa'i rgan po min cing rgya gar gyi rgyus kyang nga rang che bas/ da lan las ci la thug kyang chos len du 'gro ba yin/ lam bar na 'jigs pa de dag yod de nga la de dag gis mi brdzi ba'i gdengs 'di dag yod pas da lan shi ba srog la bab kyang rgya gar du 'gro gsung rgya gar phar 'byon gyi mgur 'di gsungs so// ༈ dpal nā ro mai tri'i zhabs la 'dud// ngas nā ro'i drung du dam bcas pa'i// dgos pa mchog cig yod pa'i phyir// gsung mkha' 'gros brda bkrol bskul mdzad pas// bla ma dran te bzod blags med// nga las ci la thug kyang rgya gar la 'gro// 'chi ba srog la bab kyang rgya gar la 'gro// dpal mo dpal thang thang du che lags kyang*// nga la rnam shes rlung zhon gyi gdams ngag yod// 'di mdo phrug phal gyi do zla min// las ci la thug kyang rgya gar la 'gro// 'chi ba srog la bab kyang rgya gar la 'gro// kha la bye la shin tu grang lags kyang*// nga la gtum mo me 'bar gyi gdams ngag yod// 'di snal gos phal gyi do zla min// las ci la thug kyang rgya gar la 'gro// 'chi ba srog la bab kyang rgya gar la 'gro// bal po shin tu tshad pa che lags kyang*// nga la 'byung ba ro snyoms kyi gdams ngag yod// 'di bzang drug phal gyi do zla min// las ci la thug kyang rgya gar la 'gro// 'chi ba srog la bab kyang rgya gar la 'gro// chu bo gaṅgā chu ru che lags kyang*// nga la rnam shes mkha' lding gi gdams ngag yod// 'di gru gzings phal gyi do zla min// las ci la thug kyang rgya gar la 'gro// 'chi ba srog la bab kyang rgya gar la 'gro// rgya gar mtha' 'khob mu ge che lags kyang*// nga la dka' thub chu 'thung gi gdams ngag yod// 'di bza' btung phal gyi do zla min// las ci la thug kyang rgya gar la 'gro// 'chi ba srog la bab kyang rgya gar la 'gro// lam bar dang yul phran 'jigs pa che lags kyang*// nga la ma mo jag ching gi gdams ngag yod// 'di zla skyel phal gyi do zla min// las ci la thug kyang rgya gar la 'gro// 'chi ba srog la bab kyang rgya gar la 'gro// bla ma nā ro dang mai tri yang rgya gar na bzhugs// dpal zhi ba bzang po yang rgya gar na bzhugs// rten ma hā bo dhi yang rgya gar na bzhugs// nga las ci la thugs kyang rgya gar la 'gro// 'chi ba srog la bab kyang rgya gar la 'gro// zhes gsungs shing thag chod pa'i tshe/

sngar 'bul sdud la byung ba'i gser dang slob ma rnams kyi 'bul ba thams cad gser du bsgril nas gser dkar yol gang byung ba bsnams te/ gzhan phyag phyi la gtong ba'i zhu ba phul ba yang ma gnang bar gcig pur rgya gar la byon no// de nas dpal nā ro pa chen pos mar pa chos kyi blo gros 'di nga'i rgyal tshab tu bkod pa yin gsungs/ rdzongs kyi tshogs mchod bshams pa'i gral du bka' lung gnang ba ni/ lo tsā ba khyod la sngar ngas ngo sprad pa ltar phung po lnga rigs lnga/ nyon mongs pa lnga ye shes lngar gdod nas gnas pa ngo 'phrod phyir ngo bo la spang blang med pas snang srid kyi chos thams cad rgyal ba rigs lnga'i ngo bor gyur cing de dag chos nyid 'gag med du shar ba'i rang rtsal du shes pas zung 'jug tu ma gyur pa'i chos gcig kyang med phyir/ chos nyid kyi klong du nyams su len pa la thog rdugs med pa dpe nam mkha' la bya 'phur ba lta bu yin zhing de rtogs pa'i chos 'khor gyi bstan pa 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po lta bu mngon du gyur pa yin pas/ lung gi chos 'khor gyi bstan pa rgyal srid rin po che sna bdun lta bu shugs la 'dzin par 'gyur bas spyir khyod kyis sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la mdo sngags gnyis ka lung rtogs kyi sgo nas 'dzin cing*/ bye brag tu gsang sngags kyi bstan pa lung rtogs gnyis nyin mor byed par 'gyur zhing khyod kyi tshe 'di'i rigs rgyud chad de chos rgyud chu bo'i gzhung ltar sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa nam gnas kyi bar du gnas par 'gyur la ma dag pa'i gang zag 'ga' zhig gi snang ngor khyod tshe 'di'i 'dod yon la mngon zhen rdo la ri mo bris pa bzhin du 'gyur mi srid cing brtan brtan dang che che 'dra mo zhig snang rung*/ khyod rang gi ngo thog na chos nyid du ngo 'phrod 'dug pas sbrul la mdud pa bor ba bzhin 'khor ba rang grol du 'gyur la/

ma 'ongs pa'i slob rgyud thams cad kyang seng ge dang khyung gi phrug gu bzhin du je bzang je bzang la 'gro ba yin zhing*/ rang re gnyis tshe 'di la brtse gdung nang mthun pas 'od gsal gyi ngang la 'du 'bral med la/ phyi ma yang dag pa mkha' spyod kyi gnas su ngas bsu ste 'bral med du 'grogs par 'gyur bas dga' bar gyis shig ces gsungs pas mar pas chos rgyud la dar rgyas yong ba'i lung bstan thugs rjes bzung*/ mthar thug mdo sngags kyi lta ba rtogs pa la khyad mi 'dug pas gnyis ka'i rtogs pa dang lung gi bstan pa 'dzin rung*/ rnam pa kun spyod so thar nyan thos kyi cha lugs can ni mi yong lags sam/ bdag la dar ma mdo sde zhes bya ba zhig gis thog drangs sha nas chad pa'i bu bdun yod rung*/ rigs rgyud chad na mi chad pa'i thabs kyi bka' lung gnang du rung lags sam zhes zhus pas/ paṇa chen nā ro pa'i zhal nas/ ma 'ongs pa na khyod kyi chos rgyud la phyi nyan thos kyi rnam pa can la nang theg chen gyi don rtogs pa'i sar gnas kyi sems dpa' 'khor bcas mang po 'byung zhing*/ gzhan cha lugs nges med kyis sgrub brgyud kyi bstan pa dar rgyas su byed par 'gyur la/ bu bdun gyi mi tshad stong yod kyang rigs rgyud yongs rigs su mi 'dug na'ang 'gyod med kyi thabs la pha bu kun yi dam lha'i bsnyen sgrub kyi mtshams dam po'i ngang nas mkha' 'gro chos skyong gi tshogs gtor la 'bad 'bungs thon/ khyod skye ba sngon nas sbyangs pa'i las 'phro can sar gnas kyi sems dpa' chen po yin phyir 'gro ba mang po la phan thogs par 'dug pas/ bod gangs can gyi gdul bya rnams 'dul phyir nga'i rgyal tshab tu mnga' gsol ba yin no gsungs/ phyag g.yas mar pa'i dbu thog tu bzhag nas ma 'ongs lung bstan gyi mgur 'di gsungs so// ༈ sngon tshul bzhin sbyangs pa'i las 'phro can// gnyug ma'i don rtogs rnal 'byor pa// bod yul gyi mar pa lo tsā khyod// rigs lnga bya 'phur chos nyid klong*// 'khor lo sgyur rgyal rin chen 'dzin// rigs rgyud nam mkha'i me tog yal// chos rgyud chu bo'i gzhung dang 'dra// zhen pa rdo la ri mo bkra// 'khor ba chu ris rang yal 'gyur// bu seng ge khyung gi phrug gu bzhin// slob ma bas kyang yang slob bzang*// theg pa chen po'i don rtogs nas// las can smin dang grol gyur pa'i// skal ldan gdul bya'i rgyal po khyod// da ni bod yul dbus su byon// byang phyogs kha ba can gyi ljongs// spos kyi shing sna rgyas pa'i sa// sman sna tshogs skye ba'i ri mgul na// skal ldan gdul bya snod ldan yod// bu de ru song la 'gro don mdzod// khyod kyis 'gro don 'grub par nges// tshe 'dir brtse gdung nang mthun pas// 'od gsal ngang la 'du 'bral med// phyi ma dag pa mkha' spyod du// kho bos bsus nas 'bral med du// 'grogs par 'gyur la gdon mi za// bu khyod kyi sems la de ltar zhog

/ces gsungs shing da khyod 'di nas mai tri pa'i sar song la 'dod chos rnams nan tan gyi sgo nas zhus shig /sngar bas kyang nges shes 'drongs pa zhig yong bar 'dug gi gsungs so// de nas mar pas bod la 'byon par thugs chas pa'i tshe/ phulla ha ri'i nub phyogs a mra'i tshal gyi shing drung zhig tu gzims pa'i tho rangs shig thugs dgongs la/ yang ngas tshe 'dir bod nas rgya gar la lan gsum 'ongs pa'i snga ma la lo bcu gnyis/ bar pa la lo drug /da lan gsum ste nyer gcig song ba las dpal nā ro pa rang gi drung du lo bcu drug dang zla ba bdun bsdad 'dug /chos byas pa la grub thob kyi bla ma rnams dang mjal/ sgra skad dang slob gnyer ni mthar phyin pa shes dgongs te dgyes shing bod du 'byon pa la bla ma dang mched grogs rnams shul du lus pa la ni thugs 'phreng*/ lam bar gyi chu 'phrang ar jag 'jigs pa rnams la ni 'tsher/ slob gnyer mthar phyin gyi rjes gdams ngag khyad par can rnams thob nas bod du byon pa la ni brod pa'i thugs nyams drag po shar ba paṇa chen nā ro pa la phyi phyag gi tshul du tshogs mchod cig phul ba'i gral du lo rgyus dang bka' gnang zhus nas/ bung ba rgyang ring du 'phur 'gro ba'i sgra la rta drangs nas yongs su grags pa'i mgur chen lam glu ring mo 'di bla ma dang mched lcam rnams la phul lo// ༈ rje 'gro ba'i 'dren mdzad bka' drin can// grub thob brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams// mi kho bo'i spyi gtsug rgyan du bzhugs// bzhugs nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol// rgya gar gyi nā ro paṇa chen dang*// bod yul gyi mar pa lo tsā gnyis// sngar sbyangs smon lam gcig pas mjal// lo bcu drug zla ba bdun du bsten// dus skad cig mi 'bral 'grogs pa'i phyir// thugs la mi 'dogs kyi skabs ma mchis// dpal me tog mdangs 'phrog gi dgon pa 'dir// dbang bzhi'i chu bo rdzogs par bskur// snyan rgyud kyi gdams ngag mthar thug gnang*// bla med theg pa mchog gi don// gnyis med rtse gcig mnyam par bzhag

/sems stong pa nyid la sbar zin byas// kha ba can ljongs byang phyogs su// lung bstan rgyal tshab bkod pa'i phyir// da ni ban chung bod du 'gro// ban chung bod du 'gro ba la// shul na 'phreng ba rnam gsum yod// yid la gcags pa rnam gsum yod// lam na 'jigs pa rnam gsum yod// bar na 'tsher ba rnam gsum yod// gdong na brod pa rnam gsum yod// ngo mtshar che ba rnam gsum yod// glu de yi rjes zlos ma bshad na// tshig des don gyi brda mi 'jol// shul na 'phreng ba rnam gsum ni// rje nā ro dang mai tris dbus mdzad pa'i// grub thob kyi bla ma brgya rtsa gcig /shul du lus te ma bas 'phreng*// dpal 'jigs med grags pas dbu mdzad nas// mched dang lcam dral brgya rtsa gcig /shul du lus te ma bas 'phreng*// gnas phulla ha ris sna drangs pa'i// grub thob kyi gnas chen brgya rtsa gcig /shul du lus te ma bas 'phreng*// yid la gcags pa rnam gsum ni// lha dharma bo dhi a sho ka /drin can gyi gnas po pho mo rnams// 'bral mi phod de yid la gcags// bram ze'i khye'u gser 'phreng can// shi srog gis mthud pa'i grogs po byas// 'bral mi phod de yid la gcags// ded dpon gyi bu mo sngo bsangs ma// mtshan ldan gyi rig mar bsten bsten nas// 'bral mi phod de yid la gcags// lam gyi 'jigs pa rnam gsum ni// chu dug mtsho khol mas sna drangs nas// shar chu bo gaṅgā da bzod brgal// 'di ma mthong gong nas nga re 'jig /ri u shi ri yi nags 'dabs na// chom rkun gyi jag pas lam na bsgug /'di ma mthong gong nas nga re 'jigs// grong khyer ti ra hu ti na// khrel med kyi sho gam char ltar 'bab// 'di ma mthong gong nas nga re 'jigs// bar gyi 'tsher ba rnam gsum ni// 'phrang pa la ha ti ma gtogs pa// dpya 'phrang zam pa brgyad cu gcig /kye ma dngul chu bas kyang 'tsher// la kha la bye la ma gtogs pa// la chen la chung brgyad cu gcig

/kye ma dngul chu bas kyang 'tsher// thang dpal mo dpal thang ma gtogs pa// thang chen thang chung brgyad cu gcig /kye ma dngul chu bas kyang 'tsher// gdong gi brod pa rnam gsum ni// sgra ka la tsānd+ras sna drangs nas// skad sna brgya dang rtsa brgyad shes// grogs lo tsā tshogs na nga re brod// dgyes rdor gdan bzhis sna drangs nas// rgyud 'grel brgya dang rtsa brgyad shes// grogs ston chen tshogs na nga re brod// bka' bzhi'i gdams pas sna drangs nas// snyan rgyud brgya dang rtsa brgyad shes// grogs sgom chen tshogs na nga re brod// ngo mtshar che ba rnam gsum ni// bsre dang 'pho ba ma gtogs pa'i// khyad chos brgya dang rtsa brgyad shes// che na ngo mtshar de che mod// dud sol lha mo ma gtogs pa'i// bstan srung brgya dang rtsa brgyad shes// che na ngo mtshar de che mod// rim lnga'i smar khrid ma gtogs pa'i// rdzogs rim brgya dang rtsa brgyad shes// che na ngo mtshar de che mod// de thams cad bla ma rje yi drin// 'bangs drin lan gzhal gyis mi 'khor bas// rje mi 'bral spyi gtsug rgyan du bzhugs// de 'og mched dang lcam dral rnams// ban chung bod du 'gro ba la// rkyen bar chad med pa'i smon lam zhu// dus da ni mjal bar yong ma mchis// dpal u rgyan yul lam mkha' spyod du// tshe phyi ma cis kyang mjal bar zhu// zhes bla ma lo tsā bas mgur de bzhengs pas/ mched grogs gong mar gyur pa bram ze su ma ti kīrti dang*/ rnal 'byor ma su kha dhā ri la sogs pa brgyad kyis spyan chab shor ro// de nas rje mar pas bla ma'i sku'i dkyil 'khor la dbang bzhi zhus smon lam btab nas byon pa la/ mched lcam gshegs skyel ba rnams kyis sku chas kun bsnams/ rje mar pa rang gis phulla ha ri'i rdo skas kyi rtsa bar ma phebs bar phyi 'gros kyis bla ma la gom pa re la phyag re dang them skas re'i steng nas phyag re phul zhing*/

rdo skas rdzogs mtshams su bla ma la gdung shugs drag pos phyag mang du btsal ba'i sa der yang rdo la rje mar pa'i zhabs rjes shig byung ba da lta yang yod do// gsum pa bod la byon tshul ni/ de nas mai tri pa dang dpal zhi ba bzang po ye shes snying po la sogs pa bka' drin can gyi bla ma rnams la phyi phyag phul nas/ dgun bal por snyel gso zhing bzhugs pa'i thugs dgongs dang*/ bod la tshur byon te bal po pham mthing du phebs pa dang*/ spyi ther ba chos kyi spyan can de ni sku yal 'dug piṇḍa pas thog drangs pa'i mched lcam mang pos sna len du tshogs 'khor zhig bshams pa'i gral du piṇḍa pa'i zhal nas/ lo tsā ba khyed la ngas dang po nas khyed dpon slob kyi thugs rje dang mos gus nang mthun pas zhal mjal bar nges byas pa ltar zhal mjal ba'i snyan pa ni sngar nas thos/ rang re gnyis bsdebs nas btsal ba ma gtogs gzhan gang dang gang du btsal/ bla ma dang zhal gang du mjal/ sku che ba'i yon tan dang ngo mtshar che ba'i ltas ci 'dra ba mthong*/ nā ro mai tri gnyis ma gtogs pa bla ma du tsam bsten/ nged rnams kyi tshogs chung 'di khyed bar chad med par 'dir byon pa'i dga' ston yin/ khyed kyis kyang skyes kha la dri ba de dag gi lan du glu zhig long mdzod gsungs pa'i lan du yid gdung shugs skyo ba sel bar byed pa chos skyong gi bshug glu'i skad la rta drangs te bla ma dang mjal tshul ngo mtshar ltas brgyad kyi mgur chen 'di bla ma dang mched lcam rnams la phul lo// ༈ dpal ka na ka shrīs dbu mdzad pa'i// 'dir bzhugs gson cig mched lcam rnams// mi nga rang gang yin zer tsa na// mtshan snyan mar pa lo tsā yin// lte ba bod yul dbus su bcad// sbyangs pa lho bal rgya ru byas// rgya gar yul du lan gsum phyin// dus da res nan tan zhu tig byas// zhabs pad spyi bor reg mdzad cing*// gsung don bdud rtsi rjes gnang ba'i// spyir chos 'brel pa tsam gyi bla ma mang*// dpal siṅga gling pas sna drangs pa'i// mngon shes rig pa mnga' brnyes shing*// snang ba 'gyur nges bcu gsum bzhugs// kun gyi nang nas mchod sdong bzhin// rje 'gran gyi do med nā ro pa// rdo rje 'chang chen mi gzugs can// rje khong gi drin la 'khor thabs med// pha yid la gcags so sprul pa'i sku// mi kho bos ma btsal sa phyogs med// zhal yang de mjal de ma mjal// ri mun pa can gyi nags 'dabs su// ngo mtshar shel gyi pha bong la// rgya yis 'bur du bkod pa bzhin// pha rje btsun gshegs pa'i zhabs rjes mthong*// lar ngo mtshar che na de che mod// shing tsandan sman gyi sdong po la// nā ro'i thugs rje'i rnam 'phrul gyis// dgyes rdor sprul pa'i lha dgu yi// yum lhan cig skyes ma'i thugs ka nas// aṣṭa sngags kyi 'khor lo de// spu shad rtse mos bris 'dra las// 'od zer sna tshogs 'phro ba yis// bdag la rjes su gnang bar mdzad// ngo mtshar che na de che mod// nga rang dbang med par mchi ma shor// ngu snying 'dod pa'i gdung sems skyes// rab tu ma bzod smre sngags bton// rtse gcig yid kyis gsol ba btab// thugs rjes gzigs nas mdun du byon// mthong lam lta bu'i dga' ba skyes// ngo mtshar che na de che mod// ngas dkon pa'i rin chen gser phye phul// nga ni de kun mi 'dod gsung*// yang yang bskyar te bzhes par zhus// pha bla ma dkon mchog mchod cig gsung*// ltos med nags kyi gseb tu gtor// kho bo phangs sems skyes pa la// khyod 'dod na slar yang yod do gsung*// phyag thal sbyar snyim pa kha phye bas// ma god ma nyams snga ma bzhin// ngo mtshar che na de che mod// zhabs mthe bong sa la brdabs pa la// rdo dang gseg ma gser du gyur// thams cad gser gling yin no gsung*// ngo mtshar che na de che mod// spyan lta stangs mkha' la gzigs pa yis// ltang dkar nya yi khog pa nas// tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i mchod pa bshams// ro brgya ldan pa'i kha zas byung*// ngo mtshar che na de che mod// yan lag brgyad ldan rdzing bu ru// khrus byas srung 'khor khwa tas khyer// lta stangs sdigs mdzub mdzad ma thag

/khwa ta rengs nas sa la lhung*// bar chad bdud las rgyal lo gsung*// ngo mtshar che na de che mod// khyed 'di ru ma 'dug bod la song*// ljongs byang phyogs kha ba can rgyud na// gdul bya snod ldan yod do zhes// lung bstan rjes su gnang ba thob// ngo mtshar che na de che mod// sprul sku nā ro paṇa chen la// ngo mtshar can gyi mthong lugs brgyad// khyod rdo rje spun rnams ma gtogs pa// khong gzhan la bzlas na yid mi ches// da dus bstan pa'i snyigs ma la// log rtog skye bo phrag dog che// yon tan brjod na sgro skur 'debs// de phyir rang min gzhan rnams la// bka' mched mi spel gsang bar zhu// dbyangs mchod par 'bul lo bla ma rje// thugs dgyes par mdzod cig snying grogs rnams// zhes gsungs pas kun thugs mnyes par gyur to// yang de nub spyi ther ba'i dus mchod dang tshes bcu'i mchod pa lhan cig byed pa'i sar/ dge slong 'jigs med grags pas dbu mdzad rnal 'byor pho mo nyi shu tsam tshogs pa'i gral du/ dge slong 'jigs med grags pa na re/ spyir yang khyed bod glu mkhas pa yin zhing khyad par du lo tsā ba khyod rgya gar du yun ring bzhugs pa la srog la bar chad med par slob gnyer mthar phyin 'dug pas bkra shis pa'i glu zhig len dgos/ khyed kyi bla ma mai tri pa de lta ba gtso bor ston pa yin zer bas khong gi dgongs pa ji ltar bzhed 'drir byung bas/ de'i lan du mai tri pa'i bzhed gzhung gi mgur 'di bzhengs par gda'/ ༈ dpal ri khrod zhabs kyis byin brlabs shing*// dgongs pa'i mthar thug snying po'i don// chos phyag rgya che la mnga' brnyes pa// rje mnga' bdag chen po'i zhabs la 'dud// grogs snying dang 'dra ba'i rdo rje spun// 'bral thabs med do mched lcam rnams// tha dad lus la sems rgyud gcig /dpal 'jigs med grags pa ma lags sam// nga rgya gar yul nas yongs pa dang*// khyed bal yul mthil na bzhugs pa gnyis// tshe 'du byed dbang du ma thal bar// kha sang de ring dus bzang la// mkha' 'gro mchod pa'i tshogs gral du// dus mtshungs zhal yang 'dzom pa de// dam tshig ngo lkog med par nges// mi kho bo shin tu spro ba skyes// khyed dga' ru tshor ram 'dir bzhugs rnams// nga blo rmongs bod kyi ban chung la// mi khyed kyis mtshan snyan lo tsār btags// khyod sgra sgyur bod kyis glu long zer// ngag mgrin pa'i gre 'gyur mi bde yang*// khyed gong ma rnams kyi bka' ma chog

/rje nā ro mai tri rnam gnyis la// sku drin rjes su dran pa'i glu// ngo mtshar can gyi mthong lugs yod// snyan lhan ne gson cig mched grogs rnams// rje rtogs pa can gyi mai tri pa// mi khong gi snyan pa rgyang nas 'khums// sprul sku'i bzhugs gnas rgya gar yul// ljongs yangs pa can gyi grong khyer du// sa skyong rgyal po'i cod pan gyis// zhabs kyi ze'u 'bru bsten mdzad cing*// gnas lnga rig pa'i paṇa chen rnams// mnga' bdag gtsug gi rgyan yin zhes// snyan pa'i ba dan phyogs bcur grags// cho 'phrul bya yi lo dus su// bde gshegs mchod pa mnga' mdzad phyir// mtshan mnga' bdag ces byar yongs su grags// rje sangs rgyas de yi zhal snga nas// theg pa'i mthar thug snying po'i don// chos phyag rgya che la ngo sprod bgyis// phyi gzung ba yul gyi snang ba 'di// bde ba chen por rgyun chad med// skye med chos kyi sku ru rtogs// nang 'dzin pa sems kyi rnam shes 'di// 'gyu ba ngos bzung med pa'i phyir// rig pa rten med gcer bur mthong*// spyir snang zhing srid pa'i chos rnams kun// gdod nas ma grub skye ba med// ngo bo spros dang bral bar rtogs// 'khor ba spang byar mi 'dod cing*// mya ngan 'das pa bsgrub byar med// 'khor 'das rang grol gnyug ma'i ngang*// zung 'jug bde ba chen por rtogs// dus gsum sangs rgyas thugs phyung yang*// mthar thug de las med do gsungs// mi kho bo'i sgro 'dogs di nas chod// rje mai tri chen po'i bzhed pa yin// khyed lta ba bzhed na de la mdzod// dbyangs mchod par 'bul lo dkon mchog gsum// thugs dgyes par mdzod cig gdan gang rnams// zhes gsungs pas khong rnams rje mar pa la lhag par ngo mtshar skyes so// de nas me dza gling na bla ma mi mnyam rdo rje zhes bya ba mnga' bdag mai tri pas bsdus pa'i mched grogs yin zhing rje rang gis kyang kri ya tshar gcig gsan pa'i slob dpon yang yin pa zhig yod pa de'i drung du phyag skyel du byon pas khong gi grogs po kha che'i lha bzo ba zhig gi dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor zhig gi rab gnas mdzad cing gda' ba la/

de'i tshogs gral du byon pas khong rnams na re/ lo tsā ba khyod kyis rgya gar du byon yun ring po bzhugs/ khyed kyi bla ma nā ro pa de sku snyan pa shin tu che bar gda' ba/ khong gi drung du khyed kyis ji tsam bzhugs/ chos ni gang gsan/ khyed rang la khong du chud pa'i gdengs ci yod/ khyed kyis rgya gar nas byon pa'i skyes su glu zhig long zer ba'i lan du/ nā ro pa dang mjal lugs kyi mgur 'di bzhengs so// ༈ rje grub thob rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// skal ldan bdag la byin gyis rlobs// nga mos pa'i bu yi lam sna drongs// lar mi nga la glu long mi rigs te// khyed mched grogs gong ma'i gsung ma chog /da ni 'chi brod kyi glu zhig len// khyed gdan gang thugs la 'di bzhes la// chos tshul bzhin nyams su len par zhu// nga bod yul gyi mar pa lo tsā dang*// rgya gar gyi nā ro paṇa chen gnyis// ljongs me tog rgyas pa'i grong khyer dang*// ri bo gser gling gi dgon par mjal// de tshe rabs kyi smon lam dag pa 'dra// gnas byin rlabs can du grags pa der// sku snyan pa can gyi rje btsun de// lo bcu drug zla ba bdun du bsten// dbang bzhi yongs rdzogs lan bdun zhus// dpal bde mchog 'khor lo'i byin rlabs mdzad// rgyud zab mo dgyes pa rdo rje gsungs// yi dam lhan cig skyes ma gnang*// gdams ngag skor tshe skor tshe zhus// lam rtsa dang rlung la sbar 'dzin byas// sangs rgyas lag pa'i mthil na gda'// dus lan cig 'chi ba'i tshul ston te// rnam smin gyi lus rgya grol ba'i phyir// 'da' ka zab mo'i gdings yod de// bsre 'pho gnad kyi mtshams sbyar nas// dpal bo dpa' mo'i bsu ba yod// rgyal mtshan rol mo'i sgra dang bcas// bde chen mkha' spyod gnas su 'gro// dpal nā ro pa dang mjal bar nges// da ni 'chi yang nga re brod// khyod 'dir bzhugs kyi jo bo sngags pa kun// don snyan rgyud kyi ngo sprod mi mnga' bar// bshad rgyud tshig gi tha snyad la// tshe gcig sangs rgyas ma re mdzod// lar snying nas dam chos mdzad dgongs na// nā ro mai tri'i brgyud pa zungs// bu slob ma bas kyang yang slob bzang*// bde nas bde bar 'gro ste mchi// dbyangs snyan du byon nam 'dir bzhugs rnams// don 'khrul par gda' na bzod par bzhes// zhes gsungs pas khong rnams na re/

lo tsā ba khyed la spyir bal po phan chad bla ma du bzhugs/ bla ma'i gtso bor rang gang la bgyid/ mnga' bdag gi zhabs drung du bsdad pa la sku che ba'i yon tan ci 'dra mthong*/ gdams pa'i gtso bo ni ci zhus 'drir byung bas/ yang lo tsā bas de'i lan du mgur 'di bzhengs so// ༈ bram ze chen po'i gdung 'tshob pa'i// mtha' bral gnyug ma'i don rtogs phyir// dpe med nam mkha'i rnal 'byor pa// mtshan mai tri zhes byar yongs su grags// pha rje btsun de yi bka' srol 'dzin// lam 'bral med sgom gyi rnal 'byor pa// mi nga rang mar pa lo tsā 'di// skye sa pham ste 'gro sa rgyal// rgya gar yul du lan gsum phyin// lus srog la ma bltas dam chos btsal// rje sprul sku sangs rgyas rnams dang mjal// dbang gdams ngag bcas pa thugs la btags// dus da res drin lan skyes du mchis// lar khyed la bla ma du yod gsungs// chos smon lam gyi 'brel ba bcu gsum bzhugs// khyad par grub thob zhal lnga bzhugs// rje 'gran gyi do med rnam gnyis bzhugs// gtso bo paṇa chen nā ro dang*// de 'og rgyal sras mai tri pa// khong lhag par ma bas brtse ba'i phyir// yang yang yid la 'phreng nas kyang*// shar chu bo gaṅgā'i 'gram du phyin// ri me ltar 'bar ba'i dgon pa ru// shing n+ya gro dha yi bsil grib tu// rje mnga' bdag chen po bzhugs pa mthong*// sa dang po lta bu'i dga' ba skyes// ḍā ki mnyes pa'i mchod pa phul// bla ma mnyes pa'i maṇḍal la// gu lang gser gyis me tog bkod// lus kyis thal sbyar rkyang phyag 'tshal// sems rtse gcig gdung bas gsol ba btab// rgyud zab mo bstod pa glur blangs dang*// yi dam dgyes pa rdo rje zhus// mthar thug phyag rgya chen po gnang*// dpal gnyis med a ba dhū ti pa// pha rje btsun de yis thugs rjes bzungs// gnad zab mo brda yi dbang bzhi bskur// rgyud yongs su dag par byin gyis brlabs// gzhi 'dun pa'i sa bon gting nas g.yos// nang rig pa sems kyi 'dug tshul de// 'od gsal rgyun chad med pa'i phyir// ma bcos gnyug ma'i ngo bo bstan// glo bur gyi rnam rtog dbyings su thim// zag med kyi bde ba nang nas shar// gdod nas dag pa kun gzhi'i rgyun// gzhi lam sku gsum gtan la phab// sems chos nyid ma dang zhal yang mjal// dus da res ngo mtshar che ba'i ltas// sgron shing mar me mdzub gang la// zhag bdun bar du snang ba byung*// bem por gyur pa'i ljon shing des// rab tu ma bzod g.yo 'gul byas// sprul pa'i lce spyang dmar po bdun// dngos su gtor ma len pa mthong*// sa gsum gnas pa'i mkha' 'gro rnams// gzugs med sngags kyi rang sgra sgrogs// bar snang gang ba'i zhing skyong rnams// sna tshogs rol mo sgrogs pa thos// khyod skye ba gsum gyi 'og rol tu// mchog gi dngos grub thob bo zhes// rje mnga' bdag chen po'i zhal nas thos// lar mi nga rang ngan te bla ma bzang*// chos lta ba'i yang rtse phu thag chod// lam grub mtha' dma' ba'i dogs ma mchis// rje mai tri chen po'i bzhed pa lags// mi khyed kyi thugs dgyes de la mdzod// ces bla ma mi mnyam rdo rjes dbu mdzad mched grogs rnams la byon skyes su phul bar gda'/

de nas rje mar pa de nyid bal yul rin chen tshul gyi gtsug lag khang na bla ma piṇḍa pa la ral gcig ma'i mngon rtogs dang bdud rtsi 'od ldan gyi sgrub thabs dang*/ rdzogs rim kha 'thor ba 'ga' gsan bzhin bzhugs pa las/ nub gcig gi mnal lam du rje mnga' bdag mai tri pa seng ge la chibs nas nam mkha' la gshegs pa rmis/ pha rje btsun thugs rjes gzung du gsol zhes 'o dod bos pas mdun gyi nam mkha' la byon nas mtshon pa'i brda bstan/ dpe dang bral ba'i chos gsungs/ mtha' las 'das pa'i don rtogs/ sngar ma skyes pa'i nyams shar ba rmis/ der mnal sad pa dang bla ma dran nas mang du bshums/ de'i phyi nub bla ma piṇḍa pa la chos thon pa'i gtang rag dang mai tri pa la gsol ba 'debs pa'i tshogs mchod bzang po zhig bshams pa'i gral du piṇḍa pa'i zhal nas/ do nub kyi tshogs gral 'dir khyed rang gi thugs la 'khrungs pa'i mgur zhig cis kyang len dgos gsungs pas rje mar par mtshan ltas zlos pa'i mgur/ yid bying ba gseng bar byed pa chu lcag zil pa can gyi skad la rta drangs pa'i mgur chen 'di gsungs so// ༈ rje snying po'i don rtogs chos kyi sku// mtshan yongs su grags pa'i mai tri pa// khong bsams shing sku drin che ba'i phyir// mi kho bo'i yid la shin tu gcags// nga rtse gcig gdung ba rgyun mi chad// pha byin gyis rlobs shig sprul pa'i sku// khyed 'dren pa'i bla ma sku drin can// dpal piṇḍa pa yis dbu mdzad nas// khyed 'dir bzhugs kyi rnal 'byor pho mo rnams// glu 'di la dar cig snyan gsan mdzod// dbyangs 'di la mkha' 'gro'i byin rlabs chags// nga mar ston chos kyi blo gros 'di// tshe sum cha rgya gar yul du bskyal// lo bzhi bcu'i bar du thos bsam byas// dus na ning gdug pa sbrul gyi lo// cho 'phrul khra yi zla ba la// mi kho bo lam la zhugs nas mchi// chu 'jigs su rungs pa'i gaṅgā brgal// rigs ngan shi skyid kyi jag pa gnyis// chu la nya ltar 'dzul zhing byung*// thang la rta ltar rgyug cing byung*// tshe snga phyi dran pa'i dngangs skrag shor// pha rje btsun spyi bor bsgoms pa las// khong yang yang blta zhing log nas thal// srog chu nas bton no sku drin can// pha khyed kyi drin lan 'khor thabs med// dus kha sang zla ba snga ma yi// khyad par yar ngo'i tshes bcu la// dur khrod ra ma do li der// bla ma mnyes pa'i mchod pa phul// mkha' 'gro mnyes pa'i tshogs 'khor bskor// khong der tshogs kyi rnal 'byor mthong ba'i tshe// rje nā ro mai tri tur gyi dran// thugs brtse bas 'bral med bskyangs pa'i phyir// pha yi mdzad spyod yid la dran// sems gdung bas ma bzod mchi ma shor// slar rgya gar yul du ldog gam snyam// nam tho rangs tham thum rmi lam na// gos shing lo gyon pa'i bud med ces// phyag g.yas pa brkyang mdzad sor mo rnams// mi kho bo'i mgo la reg mdzad de// khyod rgya gar yul du ma ldog par// slar bod yul dbus su song zhig gsungs// ljongs kha ba can du ma phyin par// phyi nang gi bar chad mi 'byung zhing*// gdul bya snod ldan yod do zhes// lung bstan byin gyis brlabs par mdzad// de zhing skyong gi mkha' 'gro yin par nges// de yang rje btsun khyed kyi drin// mdang bag chags gnyid kyi rmi lam na// rje mnga' bdag rgyal sras mai tri pa// khong seng ge chibs nas mkha' la gshegs// mi kho bo'i mdun du byon nas kyang*// skye med mtshon pa'i brda gsum bstan// yi ge med pa'i chos shig gsungs// brjod du med pa'i don zhig rtogs// sngon chad med pa'i nyams shig shar// nam langs gnyid de sad tsa na// rje yang yang dran no mai tri pa// mi kho bo'i yid la 'bral mi phod// gdong mchi mas gang ba'i ngu 'bod shor// dbugs kha nas ma thon byang khog brgyangs// pha snying la 'dod do skom chu ltar// mi kho bo'i gdung sems mkhyen lags sam// pha yis lam sna drongs shig sprul pa'i sku// lar rmi lam bag chags yin mod kyang*// pha rje btsun byon pa ngo mtshar che// sems dga' la mi dga' mtho dman byung*// khyed 'dir bzhugs kyi snyan du zhus pa lags// zhes gsungs pa dang*/

yang bla ma piṇḍa pas rje mar pa brod pa bskyed cing*/ bla ma'i ngo bo gcig la rang rang gi mthong snang ltar las yon tan tha dad du 'byung ba dang rmi lam de rnams ji ltar byung tshul dri ba'i phyir lan gsungs pa/ ༈ grogs snying dang 'dra ba'i lo tsā ba// bu khyod la dad pa gting nas yod// gzhi rang dbang thob pa'i 'dun pa yod// yid lhag par brtse ba'i snying rje yod// rgyud yongs su dag pa'i sems bskyed yod// rigs khyad par can gyi skyes bu khyod// sngon chad bla mar ma brnyes pas// da lta grub thob dngos dang mjal// de yang grogs po nga yi drin// byas pa drin gzo yod pa'i phyir// mi nga yang gtsug gi nor bur mthong*// bu byas pa shes pa ngo mtshar che// gsang sngags rgyal po mchog gi lam// bgrod pa kun gyi gzhir gyur pa// lhag pa'i dam tshig khyod la yod// lha dang mkha' 'gros rjes gnang zhing*// bla ma'i man ngag snying la zhugs// dus 'dir bde ba thob par rigs// dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// dngos grub kyi rtsa ba bla ma ste// sprul sku mchog gi rje btsun la// nam mkha' lta bur ngo shes na// skye ba med pa'i don rtogs 'gyur// nyi ma lta bur ngo shes na// gdal ba'i snying rje chen po 'byung*// zla ba lta bur ngo shes na// nyon mongs gdung ba sel bar byed// rgya mtsho lta bur ngo shes na// mi g.yo mchog gi ting 'dzin brnyes// nor bu lta bur ngo shes na// dgos 'dod re ba lhun gyis grub// ded dpon lta bur ngo shes na// thar pa'i rin chen gling du skyes// dmag dpon lta bur ngo shes na// log lta dgra yi g.yul ngo 'joms// ral gri lta bur ngo shes na// dngos 'dzin 'ching ba gcod par byed// 'khor lo lta bur ngo shes na// mtha' la mi gnas don rtogs 'gyur// seng ge lta bur ngo shes na// gzung 'dzin ri dwags zil gyis gnon// glang po lta bur ngo shes na// nyam nga'i bdud las thar bar byed// rta mchog lta bur ngo shes na// mya ngan 'das pa'i dbyings su skyel// rgyal po lta bur ngo shes na// kun gyis mchod cing bkur bar byed// rigs ldan khyod kyis gang mthong ba// drin can pha ltar ngo shes pas// chos kyi rgyal srid rgyun mi chad// bu khyod kyi bag chags rmi lam na// rje mnga' bdag chen po byon nas kyang*// skye med mtshon pa'i brda bstan cing*// yi ge med pa'i chos gsungs pas// mtha' las 'das pa'i don rtogs nas// sngar ma skyes pa'i nyams shar ba// de don gang lags smra bar rigs// zhes gsungs pas/

yang rje mar par rmi lam du gsan zhing thugs nyams su byon pa rnams/ bla ma piṇḍa pas dbu mdzad pa'i mched grogs rnams la rtogs pa phul ba/ ༈ rje brtul zhugs spyod pa'i piṇḍa pa/ mtshan lha yis lung bstan ngo mtshar che// dpal gnyis med rol pa'i phyag 'og na// sems tha dad med pa'i rdo rje spun// shrī gu ṇa ma tis dbu mdzad pa'i// gral g.yas na bzhugs pa'i dpa' bo gson// de 'og sbas pa'i rnal 'byor ma// lcam su kha badzris dbu mdzad pa'i// gral g.yon na bzhugs pa'i dpa' mo gson// spyir chos rnams thams cad sgyu ma ste// rmi lam sgyu ma khyad par 'phags// nam srod la bag chags rmi lam byung*// de la bza' gtad ci yang med// nam gung bdud kyi sprul pa ston// de la yid brtan byar mi rung*// tho rangs lha yis lung bstan pa// che na ngo mtshar de che mod// dgung da nang skya rengs shar ba la// rje mnga' bdag chen po byon nas kyang*// mthar thug ston pa'i chos gsungs pa// de ma brjed dran pa 'di ltar gda'// spyir chos rnams thams cad sems nyid de// rang sems nyid las bla ma byung*// sems las gud nas gzhan med pas// cir snang thams cad sems kyi ngang*// de yang gdod nas ma grub pas// ma skyes gnyug ma'i gnas lugs la// rnam rtog rtsol bas spang du med// ma bcings rang so lhug par zhog /de nyid brda yis mtshon pa'i phyir// mi ro gdol pa khyi dang phag /bu chung smyon pa glang chen dang*// nor bu rin chen utpa la// dngul chu ri dwags seng ge dang*// bram ze khri snyan mthong ngam gsungs// brda yis mtshon pa'i don rtogs pa// 'khor 'das gnyis su mi 'dzin cing*// spang blang rgyud la mi sbyor ba// gzhan nas 'bras bu mi re zhing*// yid la byar med spros dang bral// mtha' bzhi dag tu lhung ba med// sgom du med cing yengs su med// dran du med cing brjod du med// gang gis kyang ni mtshon du med// bla ma'i drin gyis de ltar rtogs// de don rtogs pa'i nyams shar bas// sems dang sems byung 'gags pa yi// dbyings dang rig pa dbyer med de// skyon dang yon tan skye 'bri med// bde stong gsal la ma 'gags pa// 'od gsal 'gro 'ong med par shar// gnyug ma ngo sprod lta ba'i gnad// skye med mtshon pa'i brda don rnams// rje mnga' bdag chen po'i zhal nas thos// ngag brjod pa glu ru mi len rgyu// rje gong du bka' nan ches pa dang*// mched grogs rnams kyi zhal ma chog

/mkha' 'gros ko long mi mdzad zhu// zhes piṇḍa pas dbu mdzad pa'i mched grogs rnams la bal yul rin chen tshul gyi gtsug lag khang du mnga' bdag mai tri pa rmi lam du byon nas phyag rgya chen po brda'i don bstan pa rnams mgur du bzhengs pa'o// ༈ rje btsun mi la'i gsung mgur thor bu bzhugs/ ༈ na mo gu ru/ gangs can khrod du sku 'khrungs shing*// 'jig rten skyon gyis ma gos pa// nā ro'i brgyud pas byin brlabs phyir// dka' ba spyad pa'i ngo mtshar can// 'gro ba'i nad gso sman pa'i mchog /nyi zla ltar grags phyag gi gnas// mtshan mi la zhes byar yongs grags pa'i// ras pa de la gus phyag 'tshal// 'khor ba snying po med par thugs la shar// zas gos 'dun pa bral bas ri khrod 'grim// bde drod ngo 'phrod srog rtsol gnad du tshud// rje btsun mi la'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod// rgyal ba ma lus pa'i khyab bdag rdo rje theg pa'i gsang ba legs par grub pa/ 'phags pa'i yul nyid kyi bdag nyid chen po 'jam dpal bshes gnyen gyi rnam 'phrul byang phyogs kha ba can gyi ljongs na 'gran zla thams cad dang bral ba rje btsun mi la ras pa chen po de nyid bla ma dang jo mos thugs la btags shing gdams ngag thams cad rdzogs pa dang*/ da nga yar la 'gro zhus te mi las mgur la snga ba gtsang la yar 'gro'i mgur du phul ba yin no// ༈ rje mi bskyod kyi ngo bo thugs rje can// sprang lan gcig yul du 'gro bar zhu// nga yi a ma lus kyi sgrom bu de// dus da lta zhig gam ma zhig blta// sring mo pe ta dpal 'dren de// dus da lta bde 'am mi bde blta// khyim mtshe a khu g.yung dpal de// dus da lta shi'am ma shi blta// a ne khyung bza'i dpa' 'dren de// dus da lta skyid dam mi skyid blta// khang pa ka bzhi gdung brgyad de// dus da lta 'gyel lam ma 'gyel blta// gtsang khang zur bzhi logs brgyad de// dus da lta zhig gam ma zhig blta// gshong zhing 'or mo gru gsum la// 'jag skya phyur ram ma phyur blta// dam chos glegs bam rgyas pa de// dus da lta bzhugs sam ma bzhugs blta// bla mchod dkor gnyer lha 'bum de// dus da lta sku khams e bzang blta// rje mi bskyod kyi ngo bo thugs rje can// sprang lan cig yul du 'gro ba la// skyel ma dang bsu ma'i thugs dam mdzod// bar chad dang rkyen ngan gyi bzlog pa mdzod// lus ngag dang bsam pa'i srung ma mdzod// smon lam dang thugs khur gyi rten 'brel mdzod// thugs rje dang nus pa'i dbang skur mdzod// rgyud lung dang man ngag gi rgyab brten mdzod// tshe ring nad med kyi bkra shis mdzod// sprang po'i skyid sdug khyed rang shes// ri khrod thub par byin gyis rlobs// zhes zhus pas/

bla ma'i zhal nas 'o mthu chen yid gnyis dang the tshom mi dgos/ khyod la yang nga shes nga la yang khyod shes/ chos nus na nga yang gang nas dga' 'di nas dga' nges pa med par dga' khyod kyang gang nas skyid dang 'di nas skyid med par skyid pas rems shig gsungs te mgur 'di gsungs so// ༈ rje bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs// las byas pa chos dang mthun pa'i bu// lus sprul sku sangs rgyas su 'grub par shog /ngag rdo rje'i bzlas pa bdud rtsi'i ros// rten 'brel longs skur 'grub par shog /sems rtsa ba byang chub kyi sdong po la// chos sku'i lo 'dab rgyas par shog /bla ma'i bka' tshig rdo rje'i gsung*// snying la brjed med gnas par shog /yi dam mkha' 'gro'i byin rlabs de// srog gi rtsa bar gnas par shog /chos skyong srung ma'i rgyab brten des// 'bral ba med par skyong bar shog /rten 'brel zab mo'i smon lam de// myur ba nyid du 'grub par shog /chos mdzad kun gyi thugs rje de// dus gsum kun tu 'dzin par shog /khyod gtsang bsil ma la yi la thog tu// brtan ma bcu gnyis kyi bsu ma yod// sang nyin 'gro ba'i lam kha na// dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i skyel ma yod// pha yul zhen pa'i mkhar zhing na// mi rtag sgyu ma'i dam chos yod// a ne sring mo'i nye 'khor na// sgyu ma bshig pa'i gdams ngag yod// mi med lung pa'i brag phug na// 'khor 'das brje ba'i tshong 'dus yod// snying rus lus kyi dgon pa na// lha bde gshegs 'dus pa'i mchod khang yod// na med zwa yi tshogs 'khor la// mkha' 'gro mnyes pa'i bdud rtsi yod// 'khrul 'khor gnad kyi kha bsgyur la// 'bras rin chen skye ba'i so nam yod// yul mi rtsis chung ba'i rang yul der// 'phral g.yeng ba med pa'i dge sbyor yod// mtshams dam po mi med khyi med na// rtags myur du mthong ba'i sgron me yod// zas dkor zas med pa'i rang zas la// bde ba lha yi pha 'bab yod// grib dwangs ba lha yi gzhal yas na// rang don chen 'grub pa'i ltad mo yod// ngo lkog med pa'i lha chos la// dam tshig gtsang ma'i phrin las yod// bka' bzhin sgrub pa'i so nam la// dngos grub kun gyi gter kha yod// dam chos mkha' 'gro'i srog snying la// 'khor 'das gnyis kyi gyes so yod// mar pa lo tsā'i bu rgyud la// gtam snyan mang po'i yong sgo yod// mi la ras pa'i snying rus la// sangs rgyas bstan pa'i srog shing yod// ces gsungs te/

da 'gro na ngas kyang yar skyel gsungs nas/ jo mos phud bzang po dang tshogs 'khor bshams/ lam chas gang 'dod pa'i 'gro brgyags sprad de jo mo yang nyams 'phar ba dang spyan chab mang po shor te yab yum sku 'khor bcu tsam gyis snga dro gcig gi bar skyel thung mdzad de/ yid 'phreng ba'i skyo shas/ ngag 'phreng ba'i snying gtam/ lus 'phreng ba'i phyag rgya mang du mdzad cing*/ tshogs 'khor zhig shar nub gsal ba'i la khar mdzad nas/ mar pas mi la'i phyag nas bzung ste/ nga'i rgyud pa 'di khyod kyis 'dzin pa'i rmi lam 'di lta bu yod gsungs nas ka chen bzhi'i mgur 'di gsungs so// ༈ rje bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// nyi ma shar du ka chen btsugs pa rmis// ka thog tu seng ge 'gying ba rmis// seng g.yu ral gra ru rgyas pa rmis// seng gangs dkar stongs su 'phyo ba rmis// shar rmi lam mi ngan rmi lam bzang*// nyi ma lho ru ka chen btsugs pa rmis// ka thog tu stag mo ngar ma rmis// stag gra 'dzum mtha' nas rgyas pa rmis// khong 'dzum lan gsum byas pa rmis// stag nags ma'i gseb tu 'phyo ba rmis// thang shing rgyud du 'brel ba rmis// lho rmi lam mi ngan rmi lam bzang*// nyi ma nub tu ka chen btsugs pa rmis// ka thog tu khyung chen babs pa rmis// khyung rtse sgro gra ru rgyas pa rmis// bya spu gnam du gzings pa rmis// bya mig gyen la lta ba rmis// nub rmi lam mi ngan rmi lam bzang*// nyi ma byang du ka chen btsugs pa rmis// ka thog tu rgod cig babs pa rmis// rgod rtse sgro gra ru rgyas pa rmis// bya tshang brag la bcas pa rmis// bya de la bu gcig skyes pa rmis// bya phran gyis nam mkha' gang ba rmis// byang rmi lam mi ngan rmi lam bzang*// sngon chad dbyangs la bskyar ma myong*// da res tshig la gsal zhing 'debs// nyi ma shar du ka chen btsugs pa de// dol gyi mtshur ston dbang nge yin// ka thog tu seng ge 'gying ba de// khong mi gzhi seng dang 'dra ba yin// seng g.yu ral gra ru rgyas pa de// bla ma'i gdams ngag go ba yin// seng gangs dkar stongs su 'phyo ba de// gdams ngag gi brgyud pa zin pa'i rtags// shar rmi lam bzang ba de ltar lags// nyi ma lho ru ka chen btsugs pa de// gzhung gi rngog ston chos rdor yin// ka thog tu stag mo ngar ba de// kho mi gzhi stag dang 'dra ba yin// stag gra 'dzum mtha' nas rgyas pa de// bla ma'i gdams ngag go ba lags// khong 'dzum lan gsum byas pa de// bshad brgyud kyi bstan pa dar ba'i rtags// stag nags ma'i gseb tu 'phyo ba de// tshe gcig gis grub pa brnyes pa'i rtags// thang shing rgyud du 'brel ba de// bu tsha bos brgyud pa 'dzin pa'i rtags// lho rmi lam bzang ba de ltar lags// nyi ma nub tu ka chen btsugs pa de// gtsang rong gi mes ston tshon po yin// ka thog tu khyung chen babs pa de// khong mi gzhi khyung dang 'dra ba yin// khyung rtse sgro gra ru rgyas pa de// bla ma'i gdams ngag go ba lags// bya spu gnam du gzings pa de// gdams ngag gi brgyud pa zin pa'i rtags// bya mig gyen la lta ba de// 'khor ba la phyi phyag 'tshal ba'i rtags// nub rmi lam bzang ba de ltar lags// nyi ma byang du ka chen btsugs pa de// khyod gung thang gi mi la ras pa yin// ka thog tu rgod po babs pa de// khyod mi gzhi rgod dang 'dra ba yin// rgod rtse sgro gra ru rgyas pa de// bla ma'i gdams ngag go ba lags// bya tshang brag la bcas pa de// tshe srog brag las sra ba'i rtags// bya de la bu gcig skyes pa de// 'gran gyi do med gcig 'byon pa'i rtags// bya phran gyis nam mkha' gang ba de// bka' brgyud kyi bstan pa dar ba'i rtags// byang rmi lam bzang ba de ltar lags// nga mi rgan gyi kha la gtad yod na// chos sgrub brgyud kyi bstan pa dar te mchi// zhes gsungs pas sems dpa' ting gis song ste/

ngas snying rus shig nus na dogs pa med par 'dug bsam pa'i snang ba mtho ting nge ba zhig rgyun du byung ngo*// de la 'khor ba snying po med par shes pa'i yon tan ni/ khong rang gi yul du song tsa na pha'i rus pa la btsa' zhen nas khang pa'i phug na 'dug /ma'i rus pa yang khang pa'i sgo them na skya khrol le 'dug /sring mo sprang du song yul thams cad na 'dre yod zer nas dri za'i grong khyer du song*/ zhing thams cad 'jag skya bshug bshug 'dug /tshang mang 'gyel ba'i gyang rar pha ma'i rtsibs khog skya zing nge 'dug /mkhar zhig yod pa bong bu'i rna cog bzhin song*/ chos tsho yang glegs thag glegs shing rnams mis khyer nas/ shog bu'i bar du rtswa ldum skyes nas 'dug ste/ nyin mo wa spyang 'drog 'u re/ nub mo ri dwags bshi ring nge 'dug pas blo dang snang ba mi bde ba'i ngang la de nub der nyal ba las mnal ye ma byung bas da chos shig ma nus na phan gnod mi 'dug bsam pa zhig skyes te/ nam tho rangs kha snying mi dga' phyod de ba zhig la phyod ma dbyangs kyi mgur 'di gsungs so// ༈ kye ma kye ma kyi hud kyi hud ang*// 'khor ba'i chos la blo gtad byas pa rnams// bsams shing bsams shing yi mug yang yang ldang*// spyad cing spyad cing sdug bsngal gting nas 'khrugs// bskor zhing bskor zhing 'khor ba'i gting la 'phen// 'di 'dra'i snying rlung las kyis zin pa rnams// cug byed cug byed chos las drag pa med// rje mi bskyod kyi ngo bo rdo rje 'chang*// sprang ri khrod thub par byin gyis rlobs// mi rtag sgyu ma'i grong khyer na// bshul ring 'gron po snying rlung langs// yul ya mtshan can gung thang gi sgor lung na// nor lug ba ra'i kha zas rtswa// dus deng sang 'byung pos bdag tu bzung*// 'di yang mi rtag sgyu ma'i dpe gcig red// dpe 'dis kyang rnal 'byor chos shig byed// tshang mang ka bzhi gdung brgyad de// dus deng sang seng ge'i ya mgal 'dra// mkhar zur bzhi logs brgyad rtse dang dgu// dus deng sang bong bu'i rna ba 'dra// 'di yang mi rtag sgyu ma'i dpe gcig red// dpe 'dis kyang rnal 'byor chos shig byed// gshong zhing 'or mo'i gru gsum de// dus deng sang 'jag ma'i pha yul red// gnyen nye ba phan du re ba rnams// dus deng sang dgra bo'i dmag dpung red// 'di yang mi rtag sgyu ma'i dpe gcig red// dpe 'dis kyang rnal 'byor chos shig byed// pha bzang po thos pa se ba de// dus deng sang rus phye sbar gang red// a ma nyang bza' dkar rgyan de// dus deng sang rus pa'i rtsib khog gcig

/'di yang mi rtag sgyu ma'i dpe gcig red// dpe 'dis kyang rnal 'byor chos shig byed// bla mchod dkor gnyer lha 'bum de// dus deng sang mi yi g.yog po byed// dam chos dkon mchog brtsegs pa de// dus deng sang bya byi'i tshang zla byed// 'di yang mi rtag sgyu ma'i dpe gcig red// dpe 'dis kyang rnal 'byor chos shig byed// khyim mtshes a khu g.yung dpal de// dus deng sang sdang ba'i dgra dang bsdongs// sring mo khyung bza' dpal 'dren ma// gar song rjes 'gro'i gtad so med// 'di yang mi rtag sgyu ma'i dpe gcig red// dpe 'dis kyang rnal 'byor chos shig byed// rje mi bskyod kyi ngo bo rdo rje 'chang*// sprang ri khrod thub par byin gyis rlobs// zhes skyo ba'i gdung shugs mang po blangs nas chos de rnams kyi yig 'bru gsal ba rnams slob dpon rnying ma ba yi ge bslabs sa zhig yod pa la phul nas bla bo zhib tu dris pas tsha ba zhig gnang nas khyed da bar du gar song*/ khyed la re ma byung mi mang po bsad nas ma la yang ma phan yul mkhar yang ma zin gsungs pas slob dpon rnying ma ba'i drung du mi rtag pa'i mgur 'di gsungs so// ༈ kye ma 'khor ba'i chos la snying po med// mi rtag mi rtag snying po med// 'gyur zhing 'gyur zhing snying po med// ma nges ma nges snying po med// yul yod bdag med snying po med// bdag yod yul med snying po med// bdag yul gnyis ka 'dzom yang snying po med// 'khor ba'i chos la snying po med// pha yod bu med snying po med// bu yod pha med snying po med// pha bu gnyis ka 'dzom yang snying po med// 'khor ba'i chos la snying po med// pha yod ma med snying po med// ma yod pha med snying po med// pha ma gnyis ka 'dzom yang snying po med// 'khor ba'i chos la snying po med// pha ma bu gsum 'dzom yang snying po med// 'khor ba'i chos la snying po med// mi yod nor med snying po med// nor yod mi med snying po med// mi nor gnyis ka 'dzom yang snying po med// bde skyid longs spyod 'dzom yang snying po med// 'khor ba'i chos la snying po med// ci byas sdug bsngal snying po med// ci bsams mi rtag snying po med// ci bsgrubs sgyu mar snying po med// thams cad 'dzom yang snying po med// 'khor ba'i chos la snying po med// snying po med pa'i rang bzhin la// de ni rnal 'byor bdag cag gis// snying po'i don zhig cug sgrub ang*// rje mi bskyod kyi ngo bo rdo rje 'chang*// sprang ri khrod thub par byin gyis rlobs// zhes gsungs pas slob dpon de na re/

de bzhin yin na go bcad/ yul 'di'i mi rnams kyis khyed kyis 'dre bsgrubs nas las 'di byas zer zhing yod/ khyed kyi ma shi nas lo mang po song*/ sring mo sprang du song*/ a ne yul 'di na phu 'brog mda' zhing 'dzom yod pas der song dang brgyags chu la phan pa zhig ster mod gsung bas rje btsun gyis skyo phyed de ba zhig la a ne can du yar song tsa na/ a nes yun ring bltar ma nyan/ re zhig na sbra'i ka ba phab nas khyi bkye ste brdung du byung*/ sprang po pha mes kyi bla 'tshong po yul 'phung zer zhing brgyab pas rje btsun gyis phyi nud byas pas rdo zhig la rkang pa 'thogs pas ko mo gcig tu 'gyel ba dang ber ka'i sne mo la 'jus nas mgur 'di gsungs so// ༈ yul ngan rtswa ma'i ko ron na// gnyen 'dun dgrar langs kyi ma smad gsum// sran phung ber kas gtor ba bzhin// sprang po mi yul gyi sa mtha' bskor// a ma sdug mtha' shi bas bskor// sring mo pe ta dpal 'dren sprang du song*// nged ma bu gsum las sdug pa med// nga rang pha yi yul du yongs tsa na// snying rlung gi skyo shas khong nas langs// gnyen 'dun gyi gdung sems ma chod pas// khyod a ne btsal nas sprang du yongs// tshig ngan gyi brjod pa rgyang nas tshor// blo yi mug gi khong gzer nang nas langs// sbra'i ka bas brdungs shing sha rus bcom// lus zug rngu sdug bsngal na tshas bskor// khrel ngo tsha'i reb ma gting nas bkral// nga gdug pa'i ro mig ma 'dzum dang*// mi bdag gis bla bo tshig gsum lab// ces gsungs pas/ a ne na re/ bla bo ci lab rgyu yod pha bzang po la bu khyod 'dra ba skyes zer zhing thal ba dang sa rdo mang po ngo la btab pas gting nas ma bzod de mgur 'di gsungs so// ༈ a ne ma 'di bdud mor 'dug /gum par de'u shi bdud mor 'jug /gnyen nye du a ne yod pa yis// sprang po bla 'tshong shog cig zer// khyi cho cho zer zhing bkye nas ded// sbra yi ka ba phab nas brdungs shing brgyab// gor mo rdo yis sna len byas// sa rdo gnyis kyi char pa phab// ber ka'i sne mos mnan pa byas// chab ko mog nang du sku khrus gsol// sprang rin chen srog dang de'u bral byas// ma nus kyi nye ba dgra bor 'dug

/snyoms chung gi grogs po byed pa nyung*// a ne'i nye ba kho thag chod// a ne bu nor dang bde skyid 'dzoms lags kyang*// 'dis kyang rtag tu 'khyongs par mdzod// rje sgra sgyur gyi rgyal po rin po che// sprang ri khrod thub par byin gyis rlobs// zhes gsungs nas spyan chab mang po yang shor/ a ne yang dum pa zhig skyengs nas song bas bla bo 'ga' yang zer te/ khyod ma smad kyis mthu byas pas yo phung nged tshos bsten skyabs byas na ngo tsha zhing ngan lab par yod pas lan pa yin/ da mthu mi byed na zhing khang ngas nyo zer bas zhing mos nyo bar byas nas brgyags sprod pa'i chad don byas za ma dum pa zhig kyang byin nas khyod rang chos byed na song zer skad do// de thams cad snga la bar ma gnyen 'dun gyi skor ro// ༈ gnyis pa rmi lam brdar shar ba'i yon tan ni/ rag ma byang chub nam mkha'i rdzong bya ba la bsgoms pas yon tan chen po tsam ma byung ste/ da cug drag na bsam gyin yod pa'i rmi lam na zhing tha ba sra po zhig 'dug pa rmos tsa na ye nas ma phed pas chu bkye zhing snying rus byas pas dum pa phed pa zhig rmis pas/ ngas thabs lam sgom pa la snying rus dang sems bskyed gnyis dgos par 'dug dgongs te/ de'i don gsal gdab pa'i mgur 'di gsungs so// ༈ rje bka' drin can la gsol ba 'debs// sprang ri khrod zin par byin gyis rlobs// gzhi mnyam pa nyid kyi zhing sa la// lam dad pa brtan po'i chu lud sbyar// sems dkar po dri med kyi sa bon btab// gsol 'debs drag po'i g.yu 'brug ngar// byin rlabs rtsol med kyi char pa bab// sems yid gnyis med pa'i rmo bshol la// thabs dang shes rab kyi rmo dor brdebs// 'khrul rtog med pa'i skyes bu yis// yengs pa med pa'i thong zhig 'dzin// brtson 'grus drag po'i lcag gis brab// nyon mongs dug lnga'i thal ba rlog /rang rgyud ngan pa'i rdo ba sel// g.yo zol med pa'i yur ma byed// las bden pa drag po'i snye ma la// rnam thar bzang po'i btsas ma byed// gdams ngag zab mo'i 'bras bu yis// stor sa med pa'i bang ba 'gengs// mkha' 'gro'i rngod 'thag zan gyi mchog

/bdag rnal 'byor sgrub pa'i 'tsho ba yin// rmi lam rmis pa sad nas dpyod// tshig la don nyid mi skye bas// mtshon pa tsam gyis mi rtogs te// slad nas byang chub sgrub 'dod rnams// dka' thub dang snying rus rtsal bskyed la// dka' bas bsgrubs na dkon pa 'grub// pho byang chub kyi skyes bu chos byed rnams// sgrub pa'i bar chad med par shog /ces gsungs so// de nas 'bungs nas sgom kyin yod tsa na nyin gcig a nes nas bre drug dang thul gog gcig khyer nas yongs te khyod kyi zhing rin 'dis 'khor da nga la bsnyad snyod med pa'i yi ge byin la nged tshos mi tshor ba'i yul zhig tu song*/ khyod 'dir bsdad pas nged tsho yang ngo tsha mis kyang lab par 'dug zer bas skyo ba skyes nas mgur 'di gsungs so// ༈ rje bla ma'i bka' drin ri khrod 'grims// sprang po'i skyid sdug khyed rang shes// 'jig rten 'khor ba las kyi dug /'bags na thar pa'i srog rtsa gcod// skye bo'i so nam sdig pa'i las// spyad na ngan song gi sdug bsngal myong*// nye du'i gdung sems bdud kyi mkhar// brtsegs na me 'obs kyi nang du chud// zas nor gyi gsog 'jog mi yi rgyu// bsags tshad sprang po'i brgyags phye yin// skyid 'dod kyi ja chang btsan dug gi chu// 'thungs 'thungs yi mug gi mun par 'khrid// a ne'i zhing rin ser sna'i rdzas// zos na yi dwags kyi gnas su skye// a ne'i kha ta zhe sdang gi tshig /lab na bdag gzhan gnyis phung yod// bdag gi zhing khang thams cad pa// a ne dbang ba'i yi ge byin// mi kha chos kyis sangs pa yin// lha kha snying gis bsgrubs pa yin// 'dre kha snying rjes non pa yin// nye kha rlung la bskur ba yin// rang kha gyen la blta ba yin// rje mi bskyod kyi ngo bo rdo rje 'chang*// sprang ri khrod thub par byin gyis rlobs// zhes gsungs nas zhing khang thams cad a ne la byin/

nye 'brel gyi kho thag bcad/ sems yid gnyis med par gdos thag bcad/ yid skyo shas kyi snying rlung langs pas/ da de da de kho de kho de ngas cig ngas cig chos cig chos cig bsam pa yang yang skyes te/ brag dkar rta so dbu ma'i rdzong bya ba zhig tu song ste/ slob dpon rnying ma bas byin pa'i rtsam pa dum pa zhig dang*/ ngo shes 'ga' la bslangs pa'i nas dum pa zhig byung bas rtsam pa ya chung gang byung ba la brgyags kyi blo phugs gtad nas/ dam bca' rang gis rang la mang po byas te/ ngas lus 'di'i steng nas grub pa zhig ma thob bar du bdag gis 'jig rten gyi bya ba mi sgrub par gyur cig /bdag gi las ngan pa ma zad bar du sdig pa spyod pa'i mi dang mi 'phrad par gyur cig /dngos grub dam pa ma thob bar du gshin zas dang dad zas sku glud kyi thal ba mi 'gam par gyur cig /bdag gi bgegs rigs lan chags bar chad kyi sdig sgrib thams cad byang bar gyur cig /bla ma sku drin can gyi thugs dgongs rdzogs par gyur cig /sangs rgyas bstan pa'i bya ba byed par gyur cig /'gro ba sems can thams cad kyi sdug bsngal gyi khur po 'khur bar gyur cig /ces gsungs te/ bdag 'di nas byang chub cig ma thob kyi bar du grong yul du mi 'bab e go /gal te babs na chos skyong srung mas chad pa chod cig gsungs nas bsgoms te nyin cig spang sangs la 'gro 'dod pa zhig byung ba la mgur 'di gsungs so// ༈ rje rdo rje 'chang chen mar pa'i sku// sprang ri khrod zin par byin gyis rlobs// a mtshar po mi la thos pa dga'// gros rang gtam rang la phan pa'i dbyangs// grogs gtam snyan smra ba'i mi dang bral// ltad mo blta 'dod kyi lung pa stongs// skyo ba sangs 'dod kyi yul rkyen med// sems ma spro ma spro rang sar zhog /spros na don med sna tshogs dran// ma yengs ma yengs dran pa brten// yengs na dge sbyor rlung la 'chor// ma 'gro ma 'gro nyal sa non// song na gom pa rdo la thug
