/ma srings ma srings mgo bo khug /bsrings na lag stongs phyal bar 'gro// ma nyal ma nyal dge sbyor mdzod// nyal na bsam med dug lngas non// cis kyang bsgoms pas ma grol yang*// mi med lung stong du 'chi bar shog /ces gsungs nas bdag gis 'di nas brtan pa zhig ma thob bar du grong pa'i g.yeng ba la ma dga' e go /gal te grong pa'i g.yeng ba la shor na mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis chad pa thong zhig gsungs nas mgur 'di gsungs so// ༈ rje nā ro'i bu rgyud thar pa'i lam// sprang ri khrod du gnas par byin gyis rlobs// bdud 'jig rten gyi bya bas mi g.yeng bar// sgom mnyam gzhag gi bsam gtan 'phel bar shog /zhi gnas kyi rdzing la ma zhen par// lhag mthong gi me tog 'khrungs par shog /spros bcas kyi rtsab rtsub mi ldang bar// spros med kyi lo 'dab rgyas par shog /sgrub khang du yid gnyis mi skye bar// nyams rtogs kyi 'bras bu smin par shog /bdud rigs kyi bar chad mi nus par// rang sems la nges shes rtogs par shog /thabs lam la the tshom mi skye bar// pha rjes bu yis sleb par shog /rje mi bskyod kyi ngo bo thugs rje can// sprang ri khrod non par byin gyis rlobs// zhes gsungs te/ bdag grub pa zhig ma thob bar du grong yul du mi 'bab e go /gal te babs na bla ma bka' drin can gyi chad pa thong zhig gsungs nas mi 'bab pa'i dam bca' rnam pa gsum gyis bsdams te/ mtshams dam po mi med lung stong du 'chi ba zhig e nus bsam pa rang yid la byas nas 'bungs te bsgrubs pas lo gcig ma 'khor bar du bar chad med par brgyags kyis skyol ba byung ba dang*/ spo ri spo mthon nam mkha'i rdzong bya ba'i btsan po zwa mang po yod pa zhig tu spos nas sgom dgos bsam pa la brgyags thes gang yang med pas thugs mug pa zhig byung nas/ nga 'di nas grub pa zhig ma thob bar du zwa sngon mo'i 'tsho ba rang bzang bsam pas sems dpa' skong ba bsal nas bsgoms tsa na ltogs pa'i snang ba chung du song ste/

lus kyi shed je chung je chung la song nas lan cig kun yid mi ches pa re byung ste/ sku lus la bltas tsa na sna med par song nas sngo ba ham pa rid pa 'gyel la khad chag la khad par song ba la nyin gcig mi mang po brag de la sgro 'tshol du yongs pas khong mthong bas mi rnams dang po mi ma yin red zer gyin bros/ nga 'dug yin byas pas kyang e yin mi yin zer nas rgyang nge ba la bsdad nas bla bo byas pas/ a mtshar po mi la 'chi rgyu med pa red zer nas song ngo*// de nas mi las brag 'di'i nang du bdag 'chi ba zhig byed bsam yang 'chi rgyu ma byung ba la/ zhag 'ga' nas mi de rnams kyi nang nas rgan pa zhig gis rtsam pa dum pa zhig khyer nas byung bas de zwa la btab nas gsol bas khams bzang ting gis btang bas de dus mgur 'di gsungs so// ༈ rje bla ma'i sku la gsol ba 'debs// sprang ri khrod zin par byin gyis rlobs// yon bdag bzang po'i tshogs gsog dang*// 'dzed kha zab mo'i rten 'brel 'grig /rnyed dka' 'jig sla'i lus po 'di// zas dang phrad pas sku khams bzang*// dog mo sa yi rtsi bcud dang*// dgung sngon dbyings kyi char pa gnyis// 'gro la phan pa'i rten 'brel yin// rten 'brel gyi snying po lha chos yin// pha mas gsos pa'i sgyu lus dang*// bla ma dam pa'i gdams ngag gnyis// lha chos byed pa'i rten 'brel yin// rten 'brel gyi snying po snying rus yin// mi med lung pa'i brag phug dang*// kha zhe med pa'i dge sbyor gnyis// ci bsam 'grub pa'i rten 'brel yin// rten 'brel gyi snying po stong nyid yin// mi la ras pa'i sgom sran dang*// khams gsum sems can gyi dad pa gnyis// byang chub thob pa'i rten 'brel yin// rten 'brel gyi snying po snying rje yin// brag la bsgoms pa'i sgom chen dang*// 'tsho ba sbyor ba'i yon bdag gnyis// 'tshang mnyam du rgya ba'i rten 'brel yin// rten 'brel gyi snying po bsngo ba yin// bla ma bzang po'i thugs rje dang*// slob ma bzang po'i sgom sran gnyis// bstan pa 'dzin pa'i rten 'brel yin// rten 'brel gyi snying po dam tshig yin// byin rlabs myur po'i dbang bskur dang*// dad gus gdung ba'i gsol 'debs gnyis// myur du mjal ba'i rten 'brel yin// rten 'brel gyi snying po bkra shis yin// rje mi bskyod kyi ngo bo rdo rje 'chang*// sprang po'i skyid sdug khyed rang shes// zhes gsungs nas sgom gyin yod pa las mi de rnams kyi nang nas rgan pa rtsam pa skyel mkhan gshen rdor mo bya ba yin pas chang sa zhig tu phu 'di na mi la thos pa dga' bya ba zhig chos min pa'i bsam pa med pa zhig 'dug

/thams cad kyis tshogs gsog byas na 'thad/ khong gi nye ba a ne yod pas brgyags skyol zer bas a ne ngo tsha nas byung ste brgyags ngas skyel zer sha dum pa zhig dang mar zhig khyer nas a ne dpon g.yog gnyis yongs bas mi la dge sbyor ma grol bas a nes ngang thung byas nas spang thog cig tu skyur nas khros log pas/ mi las ma gzigs pas wa spyang la shor skad do// de nas sring mos tshor bas a ne bden nam bsams nas a ne la dris tsa na ngas tshogs gsog khyer tsa na lan byin ma nyan/ khyod sring mo yin pas phrad sa yod las che zer nas a nes sring mo la lam bslabs nas btang ste/ sring mos yar la yongs nas gnam sgo'i 'og nas bos pas/ rje btsun gyis gzigs tsa na 'di mi red cig 'dug nga'i ming po ma red bsam pa la/ yar shog gsungs pas skad ngo shes nas yid za yig ge song ste/ bla bo yang 'dri rgyu ma byung ba la rje btsun la bltas pas sngo ba ham pa rid pa zwa 'thungs pas dbu lo dang ba spu thams cad sngo zhu le ba lus keng rus bzhin du song*/ shangs zhom/ spyan khung du song*/ zhal dang ljags kyang dig kyin 'dug pas sring mo rang dbang med par yi mug skyes te nged ming sring gnyis las sdug pa mi 'dug bsams nas pus mo gnyis kyi bar du mgo bcug nas mchi ma mang po phyung gin ngus pas rje btsun gyi na bza' a nes byin pa'i thul gog cig las med pa des gsang gnas bkab ste/ sring mo'i lag pa nas bzung nas mgur 'di gsungs so// ༈ rje bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// sprang ri khrod zin par byin gyis rlobs// sring mo'i gdung sems yi mug lus// skyid sdug gang yang mi rtag pas// dbyangs 'di la dar cig gsan par zhu// nga'i gnas la bltas na ri dwags 'dra// mi gzhan gyis mthong yang snying rlung ldang*// nga'i zas la bltas na dud 'gro 'dra// mi gzhan gyis mthong na skyug bro ldang*// nga'i lus la bltas na keng rus 'dra// dgra sdang bas bltas kyang mchi ma 'chor// nga'i spyod pa la bltas na smyon pa 'dra// khyod sring mos bltas kyin yi mug ste// nga'i sems la bltas na sangs rgyas dngos// bla ma gong mas gzigs na spro ba skye// nga'i 'og tu rdo ba'i gram gcal la// sha pags pa 'bugs pa'i snying rus byas// lus phyi nang zwa yi rang bzhin la// mdog sngon po gcig la 'gyur ba med// mi med brag gi phug pa na// skyo phyed de ba la sang rgyu med// bla ma dam pa'i sangs rgyas la// skyo dung nge ba la 'bral ba med// nga yi snying rus 'di yi che lugs kyis// nyams rtogs pa skye bar the tshom med// pe ta yi mug ma ldang zwa tshod tshos// zhes gsungs pas sring mo la ni 'bul rgyu med/

ming po la ni gnang rgyu med pas zwa 'tshod du bcug pas sring mo'i bsam pa la a nes tshogs gsog bskyal zer bas dum pa e yod bsams nas zwa la sdor dgos zhus pas/ zwa la sdor yod na zas yin te zwa'i sdor la zwa rang thob gsung*/ zwa la yal dgos zhus pas zwa la yal yod na zas yin te/ zwa'i yal la zwa rang thob gsung*/ zwa la tshwa dgos zhus pas/ zwa la tshwa yod na zas yin te zwa'i tshwa la'ang zwa rang thob gsung*/ sems ma bde ting nge ba la zwa lan gsum btab lan gsum du btsos nas rje btsun la drangs pas rje btsun gyis zhim zhad dang bcas nas gsol zhing 'dug /sring mo ni sprang mo yin yang skyug bro ba zhig byung bas mchi ma mang po shor bas 'o skol ming sring gis nyin gcig kyang tshe mi thon par 'dug pas khyed kyang bsod snyoms dum pa re mdzad na zhus pas/ ngas skyabs 'gro dum pa re e yong bsam bsod snyoms byed thabs med byas pas sring mos 'o na cug drag bsams nas yi mug phyod de ba zhig la yul du sprang ba la song ste/ phu rgyug mda' rgyug byas pas sprang phye dum pa zhig rnyed pa de khyer nas yongs pas/ na bza' med par sngo hrang hrang 'dug pa da sring mo yin pa la ngo tsha yang mi shes par 'dug /da mi'i ming mi 'dug byas pas/ rje btsun gyis mgur 'di gsungs so// ༈ rje bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// sprang ri khrod zin par byin gyis rlobs// ngas rtag tu mi yul 'grim 'grim nas// rang yul ngang gis brjed de thal// gcig pur ri khrod 'grim 'grim nas// grong yul ngang gis brjed de thal// spra spre'u'i yang rtsal bltas bltas nas// be'u lug ngang gis brjed de thal// bla ma spyi bor bsgom bsgoms nas// gnyen 'dun ngang gis brjed de thal// lha chos yid la byas byas nas// mi chos ngang gis brjed de thal// lus la gtum mo sbar sbar nas// lus gos ngang gis brjed de thal// zas su ting 'dzin zos zos nas// sha chang ngang gis brjed de thal// 'od gsal zung 'jug bsgom bsgoms nas// spros bcas ngang gis brjed de thal// mi rtog ye shes bsgom bsgoms nas// rnam rtog ngang gis brjed de thal// me lcags rnon po bzung bzung nas// khyim mtshes ngang gis brjed de thal// sems la gang byung byas byas nas// sba gsang ngang gis brjed de thal// gcig pur bag yang spyad spyad nas// ngo tsha ngang gis brjed de thal// 'jig rten so nam dug gi rdzong*// rdzong de las rnal 'byor thar thar 'dra// zhes gsungs pas sring mos yang sprang du song ba'i lam kha na bla ma ba ri lo tsā ba longs spyod dang thab dang rta dang ber thul dang gdugs bskor kyin chos gsung ba'i tshogs gral du song bas mi'i chos pa la 'di 'dra ba zhig yong ba yin/

nga'i ming po tshe ma phyid pa'i chos pas ci yong bsam pa byung nas/ phu rgyug mda' rgyug byas pas ru ba'i mtsher snying nas bal dug dang khyi spu dang ra bal rnams las byas pa'i snam bu sre bo zhig rnyed pa khyer nas rje btsun la phul te/ mi'i chos pa bla ma ba ri lo tsā ba 'dra zhig dgos pa yin/ ming po'i chos 'dis kyang mi yong bas snam bu 'di la gos shig gyis dang bla ma ba ri ba'i nye gnas la 'gro zhus pas lan du mgur 'di gsungs so// ༈ rje bla ma'i sku la gsol ba 'debs// sprang ri khrod thub par byin gyis rlobs// gdugs ya thog gser gyi bum chu dang gcig /ma thog dar gyi sham bu dang gnyis// bar na rma bya'i lding khang dang gsum// tshon rtsi sna lnga'i gdugs rtsibs dang bzhi// 'di bzhi skor na 'a 'bus kyang 'khor tshod du gda' ste// de bas kyang blo chos brgyad spangs na dge /blo chos brgyad spongs shig pe ta ma// grong ltag gi dgon chung khra mo dang gcig /ston chung gsar pa'i bshad pa dang gnyis// yu mar ja yi thab kha dang gsum// btsun chung gzhon pa'i lag bde dang bzhi// 'di bzhi bskyangs na 'a 'bus kyang 'khyongs tshod du gda' ste// de bas kyang blo chos brgyad spangs na dge /blo chos brgyad spongs shig pe ta ma// rag dung ser po lcags kyi kha rgyan dang gcig /de la mdzes pa'i 'phur lce dang gnyis// lce dbugs rkan gsum 'dzom pa'i dung mkhan dang gsum// mgo nag mi yi 'du 'dzi dang bzhi// 'di bzhi bsgrubs na 'a 'bus kyang 'grub tshod du gda' ste/ de bas kyang blo chos brgyad spangs na dge /blo chos brgyad spongs shig pe ta ma// rta na phran mgo 'phangs mtho dang gcig /de la mdzes pa'i dar gdan dang gnyis// seng ldeng chu ris kyi sga khra dang gsum// mdo mang lcags kyi glo nan dang bzhi// 'di bzhi btsal na 'a 'bus kyang rnyed tshod du gda' ste// de bas kyang blo chos brgyad spangs na dge

/blo chos brgyad spongs shig pe ta ma// ma jo sgom ma'i tshogs dpon dang gcig /mo bon rtsis gsum gyi grong chog dang gnyis// kha za 'dod 'bru yi tshogs 'khor dang gsum// nya ma mgo skor gyi glu chung dang bzhi// 'di bzhi bskor na 'a 'bus kyang 'khor tshod du gda' ste// de bas kyang blo chos brgyad spangs na dge /blo chos brgyad spongs shig pe ta ma// sa mkhar mthon po'i bdag po dang gcig /zhing lhu mo 'phred la rmo ba dang gnyis// pha spun mnyam gnyis kyi 'gran zla dang gsum// bshes nye du 'brel ba'i gdung sems dang bzhi// 'di bzhi byas na 'a 'bus kyang yong tshod du gda' ste// de bas kyang blo chos brgyad spangs na dge /blo chos brgyad spongs shig pe ta ma// gnyen nye du'i gdung ba sems la gzan// pha bla ma'i nye gnas dge sbyor spur// chos long yod kyis phyi bshol lag stong 'gro// khyod pe ta a lcam sprang du song*// nga na med kyi rnal 'byor dge sbyor byed// ces gsungs pas sring mo na re de bzhin yin na yang dga' ste/ e yin nam zer/ de nas sring mos sprang du song bas nyin gcig sprang phye dang chang skyur po zo ba gang khyer yongs pa la tshogs 'khor mdzad de/ da sring mo khyod kyang ma yongs gsungs nas mgur 'di gsungs so// ༈ rje bla ma'i sku la gsol ba 'debs// sprang ri khrod zin par byin gyis rlobs// nga skyid pa dgra yis ma tshor dang*// sdug pa gnyen gyis ma tshor bar// ri khrod 'di ru 'chi nus na// sprang po'i bsam pa 'grub pa yin// nga rgas pa grogs kyis ma tshor dang*// na ba sring mos ma tshor bar// ri khrod 'di ru 'chi nus na// sprang po'i bsam pa 'grub pa yin// nga shi ba mi yis ma tshor dang*// ro rul bya yis ma mthong bar// ri khrod 'di ru 'chi nus na// sprang po'i bsam pa 'grub pa yin// nga'i sha rus sprang bus 'jib pa dang*// rtsa rgyus 'bu yis za ba ru// ri khrod 'di ru 'chi nus na// sprang po'i bsam pa 'grub pa yin// nga'i sgo na mi rjes med pa dang*// nang na khrag rjes med pa ru// ri khrod 'di ru 'chi nus na// sprang po'i bsam pa 'grub pa yin// nga'i ro la 'khur mi med pa dang*// shi ba la ngu mi med pa ru// ri khrod 'di ru 'chi nus na// sprang po'i bsam pa 'grub pa yin// nga gar song 'dri mi med pa dang*// 'dir song gtad ra med pa ru// ri khrod 'di ru 'chi nus na// sprang po'i bsam pa 'grub pa yin// mi med lung pa'i brag phug tu// sprang po'i 'chi ba'i smon lam 'di// 'gro ba'i don du 'grub par shog

/ces gsungs pa 'di rnams snga la 'og ma ste/ de thams cad snga la skor gsum mo// gsum pa bde drod ngo 'phrod pa'i yon tan ni/ sring mo na re khyod nyin mo glu blangs/ mtshan mo nyal bas sems yangs yangs su song nas e zug zer bas mo bden dgongs nas lus ngag yid gsum gnad rnam pa gsum la bcun te/ sring mos byin pa'i snam bu yang bzo ma khom bar/ tsog pu lus kyi gnad/ rgya mdud ngag gi gnad/ sbrul mdud sems kyi gnad de gnad gsum la dril bas/ shi ma shi 'gyel ma 'gyel med par bsgoms pas zhag bco brgyad la bde drod rang 'bar la song ste sring mos byin pa'i snam bu yang 'bu dang mug pas zos nas dum bur song ba la/ yang nyin gcig sring mo slebs nas byung bas khyed kyis snam bu e bzos zhus pas/ snam bu bzo ba ma byung bas 'bus zos gsungs pas/ khyed kyis snam bu chud zos byas nas/ da gcer bur ngo mi tsha ba e lags zhus pas/ mgur 'di gsungs so// ༈ rje bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs// sprang ri khrod thub par byin gyis rlobs// khyod ngo mi tsha ba la ngo tsha byed// ngo tsha'i bu pho pang du blangs// ngo tsha'i bu mo rin gyis nyos// ngo tsha'i las la thod pa rgas// 'di ni rang byung pho rtags yin// pho mo ming btags phyin chad nas// 'di nyid yod pa sus kyang shes// khrel ngo tsha dag la khyod mi 'dzem// ngan spyod g.yo sgyu brku ba dang*// spyod ngan zhe ngan log lta dang*// ngo shes nye ba 'tshong ba rnams// khrel ngo tsha yin te 'dzem mi med// rdo rje zab mo'i gsang spyod dang*// man ngag zab mo'i sgom chen kun// mi tshe chos la skyel ba la// ngo tsha'i 'jigs pa skad cig med// khyod pe ta ma re sdug sems ma chung*// yi chad ma 'da' sprang du song*// zhes gsungs te 'bungs nas bsgoms bsgoms pa las/ zwa rang gis ma 'khyol bar sgom shed je chung je chung la song nas dbang po mnyel po las ma byung ba la nyin cig khyi ra ba 'gas sha ba bsad pa'i sha khur nas brag rtsa de na byung bas ltogs 'dod byas te skad mang du btang bas/

rje btsun gyis gzigs tsa na khyod mi la thos pa dga' e yin zer bas yin gsungs/ khyod brag 'di la bsdad pa la brag 'di la yon tan ci yod zer ba'i lan du mgur 'di gsungs so// ༈ rje bla ma'i byin rlabs brag la zhugs// brag 'di'i yon tan ma shes na// spo ri spo thon nam mkha' rdzong*// nam mkha' rdzong gi pho brang na// steng na lho sprin smug po 'thibs// 'og na gtsang chab sngon mo 'bab// rgyab tu brag dmar nam mkha'i rdzong*// mdun na na spang me tog bkra// zur na gcan gzan ngar skad sgrog /logs la bya rgyal rgod po lding*// dus su sbrang char zim bu 'bab// rgyun du bung bas glu dbyangs len// sha rkyang ma bu rtsed bro brdungs// co ga ma bu 'gyur skad mang*// lha bya gong mo glu dbyangs len// rdza chab sil mas snyan pa brjod// dus kyi skad rigs nyams kyi grogs// gnas 'di yi yon tan bsam mi khyab// nyams dga' glu ru blangs pa yin// gdams ngag kha nas bton pa yin// khyod khyi ra ba la bshad pa yin// las sdig pa ma byed dge ba mdzod// ces gsungs pas khyi ra ba rnams kyis ngo mtshar che zer nas sha ba'i sha dang phye'i lhag ma dum pa zhig 'dug pa rnams phul ba la sha tshod mdzad nas gsol bas sku lus 'bol shig ger btang bas sgom shed cher song*/ khams dwangs lus bde/ sems gsal du song dge sbyor bzang po byung ba la yang zhag gcig gnyis na khyi ra ba rgan pa zhig gis rtsam pa khyer yongs pas/ do zhag sku khams bde'am zhus pas legs por bde gsungs nas mgur 'di gsungs so// ༈ brag dkar spo mthon pho brang na// mi la ras pa'i sgom lugs bde// 'dzin chags med pa'i 'gro 'dug bde// na tsha med pa'i sgyu lus bde// nyal ba med pa'i 'dug lugs bde// rtog pa med pa'i ting 'dzin bde// grang ba med pa'i gtum mo bde// zhum pa med pa'i brtul zhugs bde// rtsol ba med pa'i so nam bde// yengs pa med pa'i dben pa bde// de tshe lus kyi 'khyer so yin// thabs shes rab gnyis kyi theg pa bde// bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug gi nyams len bde// rlung 'gro 'ong med pa'i sems nyid bde// lab grogs med pa'i smra bcad bde// de tsho ngag gi 'khyer so yin// ngos bzung med pa'i lta ba bde// rgyun chad med pa'i sgom pa bde// nyam nga med pa'i spyod pa bde// re dogs med pa'i 'bras bu bde// de tsho sems kyi 'khyer so yin// 'gyur med rtogs med 'od gsal bde// bde chen rnam dag dbyings su bde// 'gag med 'char sgo'i klong du bde// shin tu bde ba'i dbyangs chung 'di// nyams myong glu ru blangs pa yin// gdams ngag kha nas shor ba yin// lta spyod zung du bsdebs pa yin// slad nas byang chub bsgrub 'dod rnams// don nyams su len na de ltar mdzod// ces gsungs pas yon bdag de dga' nas phyag mang du btsal nas khyim du song ste/

zhag gcig gnyis shig na yon bdag grogs 'ga' dang 'grogs nas rtsam pa dum pa re khyer te 'ongs pa/ bla ma lags kha sing gi mgur ma de legs po zhig byung ste/ nged shes rab chung bas ma zin pas tshig nyung la don gsal ba zhig gsungs dang zer bas yang mgur 'di gsungs so// ༈ rje bla ma'i byin rlabs brag la zhugs// sprang brag la gnas par byin gyis rlobs// dad dang mkhas dang btsun dang gsum// 'di gsum sems kyi srog shing yin// gtsugs na brtan la 'dzug na bde// srog shing mdzad na de la mdzod// chags med zhen med rmongs med gsum// 'di gsum sems kyi go cha lags// gyon na yang la mtshon khar sra// go cha mdzad na de la mdzod// bsgom dang brtson dang bsran tshugs gsum// 'di gsum sems kyi rta pho lags// rgyug na mgyogs la bros na thar// rta pho mdzad na de la mdzod// rang rig rang gsal rang bde gsum// 'di gsum sems kyi 'bras bu lags// btab na smin la za na bcud// 'bras bu mdzad na de la mdzod// sems don rnam pa bcu gnyis 'di// rnal 'byor blo la shar nas blangs// khyod yon bdag dad pa'i gdab lan mdzod// ces gsungs pas yon bdag de dad pa can gshen rdor mo bya ba yin pas da dung mdor bsdus pa'i tshig gcig la 'dril ba zhig gsungs dang zer bas mgur 'di gsungs so// ༈ bla ma'i byin rlabs sems la zhugs// sems stong nyid rtogs par byin gyis rlobs// yon bdag dad pa'i phyag rten la// lha yi dam mnyes pa'i glu zhig len// snang dang stong dang dbyer med gsum// 'di gsum lta ba'i mdor bsdus yin// gsal dang mi rtog yengs med gsum// 'di gsum sgom pa'i mdor bsdus yin// ma chags ma zhen ma 'khrul gsum// 'di gsum spyod pa'i mdor bsdus yin// re med dogs med mthar skyol gsum// 'di gsum 'bras bu'i mdor bsdus yin// ngos med lkog med zol med gsum// 'di gsum dam tshig mdor bsdus yin// zhes gsungs pas yon bdag gnyis te khyim du song ngo*// lar snye nam gyi mi sde rnams dad kyang 'khos chung bas zhabs tog chen po ma byung bas dkor gyis dge sbyor ma phrogs zla ba lnga drug la skyo thang rgyu re bskyal bas ltogs gri'i rlung la ma bskur zhes gsungs so// de thams cad spo ri spo mthon gyi skor ro//

༈ de nas spo ri spo mthon du lo drug song ba dang*/ brag dmar mchong gling khyung gi rdzong du byon nas lo bcu gnyis zla ba bcu gnyis zhag bcu gnyis za ma bcu gnyis bcu gnyis cha bzhi sgrub pa'i dam bca' byas pa'i 'og tu shi ba zhig e nus bsams nas yul gyi mi sdes kyang gar yod ma tshor bar bsgoms pas e 'chi bsam pa la 'chi rgyu ye ma byung zhing dbang po ngan par byung bas ngas 'jig rten gyi bya ba ni btang thal zin/ da dung ma shi na chos rang byed bsam pa skyes te/ zwa zhig btsos nas gsol dgos dgongs te shing 'thu ba la song bas shing hrag hrug dum pa zhig rnyed pa de rdo leb gcig gi steng du bzhag nas mnyel gso yin yod pa la/ lhag pa zhig byung ste shing rnams gtor bas thams cad mi rtag pa 'di kha rang yin ang bdag la'ang mi rtag pa zhig nam yong ngam dgongs pa la da rung shing zhig cis kyang 'thu dgos dgongs nas shing skam po che ba zhig bcag pa dang mnyam du 'gyel ba'i ngang la dbang po ma byung ste/ dgongs mo nyi ma zer ba la lhag pa'i bser bu gshi re byung bas mnal sad pa 'dra zhig la dbang po byung bas skyo ba'i snying rlung drag po zhig langs zin nas/ nyi ma shar phyogs su gzigs pas bla ma'i sku mkhar yod phyogs su sprin dkar po zhig ling nge 'dug pas bla ma dran te/ de dus bla ma dran drug gi mgur 'di gsungs so// ༈ rje bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs// sprang po'i snying rlung sangs bar thugs rjes zung*// shar sprin dkar lding ba'i 'og shed na// lho dro bo lung gi dgon pa na// mi bdag gi bla ma bzhugs pa ste// mtshan brjod na mar pa lo tsā zer// dus da lta bzhugs na dga' ba la// da lta bzhugs na skyid pa la// sa bskor thag ring yang mjal snying 'dod// lam bgrod par dka' yang mjal ba zhig lags te// sho mo slar yang bla ma dran pa zhig byung*// bsams shing rje btsun dran pa zhig byung*// yum sangs rgyas dgyes byed bdag med ma// dus da lta bzhugs na dga' ba la// da lta bzhugs na skyid pa la// ma la phyag rten med kyang mjal snying 'dod// 'bul ba med kyang mjal ba zhig lags te// sho mo slar yang bla ma dran pa zhig byung*// bsams shing rje btsun dran pa zhig byung*// dbang zab mo brda yi dbang bzhi de// dus da lta bskur na dga' ba la// da lta bskur na skyid pa la// nga 'bul ba yo byad chung yang 'bul snying 'dod// 'tsho ba dkon yang zhu ba zhig lags te// sho mo slar yang bla ma dran pa zhig byung*// bsams shing rje btsun dran pa zhig byung*// rgyud zab mo dgyes pa rdo rje de// dus da lta zhu na dga' ba la// da lta zhu na skyid pa la// 'a 'bu shes rab chung yang zhu snying 'dod// blo rtse brtul yang nyan pa zhig lags te// sho mo slar yang bla ma dran pa zhig byung*// bsams shing rje btsun dran pa zhig byung*// khrid zab mo nā ro chos drug de// dus da lta zhu na dga' ba la// da lta zhu na skyid pa la// 'a 'bu sgom sran chung yang sgom snying 'dod// 'byung bzhi rgud kyang sgom pa zhig lags te// sho mo slar yang bla ma dran pa zhig byung*// bsams shing rje btsun dran pa zhig byung*// dbus gtsang gi grogs po dad 'dus de// dus da lta bzhugs na dga' ba la// da lta bzhugs na skyid pa la// bgro gleng go bsdur byed snying 'dod// nyams bsdur bla bo byed pa zhig lags te// sho mo slar yang bla ma dran pa zhig byung*// bsams shing rje btsun dran pa zhig byung*// bla ma mnyes pa'i sku mkhar de// dus da lta brtsig nas dga' ba la// da lta brtsig na skyid pa la// nga na so rgas kyang brtsig snying 'dod// sgyu lus ngan kyang brtsig pa zhig lags te// sho mo slar yang bla ma dran pa zhig byung*// bsams shing rje btsun dran pa zhig byung*// drin can gyi pha ma yab yum de/

dus da lta yod na dga' ba la// da lta yod na skyid pa la// pha ma drin lan 'jal snying 'dod// zhabs tog ci nus byed pa zhig lags te// sho mo slar yang bla ma dran pa zhig byung*// bsams shing rje btsun dran pa zhig byung*// rdo rje 'chang chen byin rlabs can// sprang po'i skyo ba sangs par byin gyis rlobs// zhes gsungs pas sprin de je ring je ring la song nas khong gi dbu thog tu snam bu brkyang pa bzhin byung bas sprin de'i sne mo la bla ma mar pa de nyid seng ge dkar mo srab med pa zhig la bcibs nas bzhugs pa gzigs nas/ mi la ras pa khyod de ring 'o dod chen po byed pa ci byung*/ bla ma la dad pa skyes sam/ rkyen ngan rtog pa yul phyir 'brangs sam/ nang sgrub pa'i khang par skyid 'dod kyi bar chad zhugs sam/ blo 'gong re dogs kyis gtser bas khyod spun nam ci byung*/ nga dang khyod gnyis 'du 'bral med pa yin gsung ba'i sgra thos pas dga' 'drags nas 'di zlo ma rnyed pas dpe dang bral ba'i rtogs pa shar/ brjod du med pa'i nyams skyes nas gsol 'debs mos gus gyi mgur 'di gsungs so// ༈ rje bla ma'i zhal mthong gsung thos pas// sprang po'i snying rlung nyams su shar// thugs rje yid la bsam pa yis// rtogs pa'i mos gus gting nas skyes// bka' drin byin rlabs dngos zhugs pas// chos min snang ba khrig gis chod// mi med lung stong 'o dod 'di// pha bla ma'i snyan la gzan lags kyang*// sprang snang ba 'di min gyis tshims ma nus// snying rus sdug sran gyi sgrub pa 'di// pha bla ma mnyes pa'i zhabs tog yin// na med gcig pu'i ri khrod 'di// ma mkha' 'gro mnyes pa'i zhabs tog yin// shir chug ltogs sgur sdug sran 'di// mgon med sems can gyi sbyin pa yin// grogs med gcig pu'i snying rus 'di// las rnam smin sbyong ba'i phyags shing yin// zad med zwa yi chos brgyags 'di// nyams rtogs pa skye ba'i mthun rkyen yin// pha bla ma'i drin lan sgrub pas 'jal// drin thugs la thogs shig gu ru rje// sprang ri khrod non par byin gyis rlobs// zhes gsungs nas snang ba bde ting nge ba zhig la shing dum pa zhig khyer nas yar la byon tsa na/

phug pa na lcags kyi a tsa ra gzugs mthe bong tsam la mig phor pa tsam yod bdun gyis/ la las me 'bud/ la las chu len/ la las rtsams pa thag stangs dang las sna tshogs pa'i rdzu 'phrul ston cing 'dug pa dang*/ gzigs ma thag tu ya nga ba zhig byung ste lha bsgoms nas drag sngags brjod pa dang*/ lta stangs dang rol pa cher byas pa dang*/ byams dang snying rje bsgoms kyang zhi ma nus shing 'di rnams yul 'di'i gzhi bdag e ma yin ngas gnas 'di la lo zla ba 'di tsam bsdad pa la gtor ma dang bstod pa zhig kyang ma byas dgongs nas gnas la bstod pa'i mgur 'di gsungs so// e ma ri khrod dben pa gnas// rgyal ba byang chub bsgrubs pa'i sa// mi rang nyid gcig pur 'dug pa'i yul// gnas brag dmar mchong gling khyung gi rdzong*// steng na lho sprin smug po 'thibs// de la rgod po lang ma ling*// mda' na gtsang tshab me re re// de la nya sram gya ma gyu// rgyab tu ri rgyal rtse mo mtho// de la rtsi shing sna tshogs rgyas/ mdun ri 'bras spungs rang la 'khor// de la chu mig me tog rgyas// rtsa na na spang cho lo ris// de la sha rkyang ma bu rtse// shing lo me tog padma ris// de la 'jol mo gsungs snyan sgrog /rdza dang g.ya' ma gangs ri mang*// de la gong mo skad snyan gyur// 'brog dang lung pa'i phu mda' dam// de la bar chod mi rjes chad// nga dang gnas bzang byang chub mthun// de lta bu yi dben gnas 'dir// nga mi la ras pa nyams myong skyong*// nyams myong gi rtsa ba byang chub sems// 'dre 'dir tshogs bar chod mi ma yin// byams snying rje'i bdud rtsi 'thung la dengs// zhes gsungs pas cho 'phrul ston pa'i a tsa ra gsum dengs song*// bzhed rung 'gro ma nyan pas bzhi po 'dre'i cho'aphrul gyi bar chad yin par dgongs nas nyams lta ba'i gdengs dang ldan pa'i mgur 'di gsungs so// ༈ nga seng ge dkar mo'i bu rgyud 'di// seng phrug gi ring la khyu sna drangs// seng chen gyi ring la gangs khrod 'grim// dgra bu yug 'tshub kyang nyam nga med// nga bya rgyal khyung gi bu rgyud 'di// bya phran gyi ring la khyu sna drangs// khyung chen gyi ring la nam 'phang bcad// mtho g.yang sa che yang nyam nga med// nga nya chen yor mo'i bu rgyud 'di// nya phran gyi ring la mtsho mtha' bskor// nya chen gyi ring la gtsang chab 'grim// gtsang po g.yos kyang nyam nga med// nga nā ro chen po'i bu rgyud 'di// sgom phrug gi ring la bla ma bsten// sgom chen gyi ring la ri khrod 'grim// khyod bar chad bdud la nyam nga med/

khyod 'dra'i 'dri med la nyam nga med// 'dre de ring byon pa ngo mtshar che// sang nyin cis kyang 'byon par zhu// skabs skabs su gsung gleng yang yang byed// ces gsungs pas a tsa ra gsum ni 'ja' yal ba bzhin du song ste/ gcig ni lta stangs dang rol pa'i gar cher btang bas 'di ma rungs pa'i mthu che ba zhig red dgongs te rtogs tshad lta ba'i mgur 'di gsungs so// ༈ seng gangs la 'gying ba sbar mi 'khyag /seng gangs la 'gying ba sbar 'khyag na// seng rtsal gsum rdzogs pa don go chung*// bya nam mkha' la 'phur ba lhung mi srid// bya nam mkha' la 'phur ba lhung srid na// bya gshog drug rgyas pa don go chung*// nya chab la gnas pa 'tshub mi srid// nya chab la gnas pa 'tshub srid na// nya gser mig 'khyil ba don go chung*// lcags kyi pha wang rdos mi chog /lcags kyi pha wang rdos chog na// lcags zhun thar legs pa don go chung*// nged sems nyid rtogs pa 'dres mi 'jigs// sems nyid rtogs pa 'dres 'jigs na// mtho brag la gnas pa don go chung*// khyod 'dra'i 'dre la nyam nga med// khyod 'dra'i 'dre la nyam nga na// sems snying rje shar ba don go chung*// 'dre da rung bzhugs na thugs la btags// khyod grogs po yod na bskor la shog /nged rang gsung gleng kho thag gcod// a tsa ma 'byung po snying re rje// rje mi bskyod kyi ngo bo rdo rje 'chang*// sprang snying rje 'byongs par byin gyis rlobs// zhes gsungs pas byams snying rjes lus ltos pa med par kha na phar btsangs pas za rgyu ma byung bar 'ja' yal ba bzhin deng nas song ngo*// de thams cad brag dmar mchong gling gi skor ro// ༈ de nas rje btsun gung thang lho sgo na phar byon tsa na mi mang po rtsed sna la tshogs nas 'dug pa'i nang na nya ma btsun seng ba zhing 'dug pas rnal 'byor pa khyed kyi yul dang pha ma nye 'brel gang yin zer ba'i lan du mgur 'di gsungs so//

༈ rje bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// byin gyis brlab par mdzad du gsol// nga'i yab ni kun tu bzang po yin// yum ni 'gro ba bzang mo yin// pho bo thos pa'i rgyal po yin// a ne snang gsal sgron me yin// sring mo dad pa'i lcam me yin// grogs shig rang byung ye shes yin// bu ni rig pa'i khye'u chung yin// dpe cha snang srid gzhir bzhag yin// rta pho rnam shes rlung zhon yin// yon bdag dbus gtsang ru bzhi yin// nga rang mchod rten dkar chung yin// zhes gsungs pas a la la ngo mtshar che ba yod par 'dug ste/ nged 'jig rten pas ma go bas ji ltar yin gsung bar zhu zhus pas mgur 'di gsungs so// ༈ ngas sngon chad dbyangs la bskyar ma myong*// da res tshig la gsal zhing 'debs// yab gcig kun tu bzang po des// lta sgom phogs su btang ba la// 'jig rten gyi snang ba yod ma myong*// yum zhig 'gro ba bzang mo des// gdams ngag nu ma bsnyod pa la// nyams len la mu ge yong ma myong*// pho bo thos pa'i rgyal po des// thabs shes rab ral gri lag tu gtad// chos phyi nang gi sgro 'dogs bcad nas bzhag /a ne snang gsal sgron me yis// rang sems me long blta ba la// bag chags g.ya' yis gos ma myong*// sring mo dad pa'i lcam me yis// ser sna'i mdud pa 'gro ba la// rnal 'byor la zas nor yod kyang med// yod kyang sdug btsir byed ma myong*// grogs shig rang byung ye shes dang*// gnyis su med par 'grogs pa la/ gshis ngan dang sdug 'thab byed ma myong*// bu gcig rig pa'i khye'u chung des// rgyal ba'i gdung rgyud 'dzin pa la// snabs shal bu tsha gso ma myong*// dpe cha snang srid gzhir bzhag des// mtshon pa'i go yul ston pa la// yig nag dpe cha blta ma myong*// rta pho rnam shes rlung zhon des// gar 'dod gnas su skyel ba la// khrag chags rta la zhon ma myong*// yon bdag dbus gtsang ru bzhi des// 'tsho ba gang 'dod sbyor ba la// phye rkyal la dgag btsir byed ma myong*// nga rang mchod rten dkar chung 'di// mchod pa dkon mchog mchod pa yin// rten pa bla ma rten pa yin// dkar ba chos la dkar ba yin// chung ba nyon mongs chung ba yin// de phyir mchod rten dkar chung yin// zhes gsungs pas a la la de shin tu bzang ba zhig 'dug

/khyed nged tsho'i nang du 'byon dus 'khor ba'i snang ba med las che zhus pas/ rje btsun gyis yang mgur 'di gsungs so// ༈ ngas dgra 'khor ba 'di la phar bltas pas// dang por 'khor ba nyams dga' ba// bar du snang ba brid mkhas pa// tha ma btson dong thar med po// 'khor ba'i mtha' la zhen pa log /de nas grogs la phar bltas tsa// grogs dang po lha mo 'dzum kha mo// bar du mi mo khro gtum ma// tha ma bdud mo ngo nag ma// gtan grogs de la chags pas phung*// de nas bu la phar bltas tsa// bu dang po lha phrug kha 'jam po// bar du khyim mtshes snying ring po// tha ma dgra bo lan chags po// dgra lan med gso ba blo nyes che// de nas nor la phar bltas tsa// nor dang po nor bu rin po che// bar du med thabs med pas bzung*// tha mar sbrang rtsi bsags pa bzhin// sdug gsog byas tshad mi yis spyod// de la soms la lha chos mdzod// 'chi khar mi 'gyod tsam re gyis// zhes gsungs pas nya ma de dad pa skyes nas rnal 'byor pa khyod la chos rgyud bzang po e yod zer ba'i lan du mgur 'di gsungs so// ༈ chos sku kun la khyab pa'i kun tu bzang po// longs sku mtshan dpes brgyan pa'i rdo rje 'chang chen// sprul sku 'gro don mdzad pa'i shākya thub pa// brgyud pa de gsum dang ldan pa'i rnal 'byor pa zhig lags// brgyud pa de gsum la dad pa'i skal ldan yod dam// zhes gsungs pas mo na re/ brgyud pa bzang bar 'dug bla ma bzang po yod dam zer ba'i lan du mgur 'di gsungs so// ༈ shes rgyud phyi nas mtshon pa phyi'i bla ma// rig rgyud nang nas ston pa nang gi bla ma// don rgyud sems la 'char ba don gyi bla ma// bla ma de gsum dang ldan pa'i rnal 'byor pa zhig lags// bla ma de gsum la dad pa'i nya ma yod dam// zhes gsungs pas mo na re/ bla ma de 'dra ba dang mjal nas dbang bskur e thob zer ba'i lan du mgur 'di gsungs so/

༈ bum pa mgo thog tu 'jog pa phyi yi dbang*// rang lus lha skur sprod pa nang gi dbang*// sems nyid bde stong du sprod pa don gyi dbang*// dbang bskur de gsum dang ldan pa'i rnal 'byor pa zhig lags// dbang bskur de gsum zhu ba'i nya ma yod dam// zhes gsungs pas mo na re/ dbang zab mo thob rting gdams ngag e zhus zer ba'i lan du mgur 'di gsungs so// ༈ thos bsam sgom gsum byed pa phyi yi khrid// rig pa rdo rus sprod pa nang gi khrid// nyams dang 'du 'bral med pa don gyi khrid// khrid de gsum dang ldan pa'i rnal 'byor pa zhig lags// khrid de gsum zhu ba'i nya ma yod dam// zhes gsungs pas mo na re/ khrid de 'dra ba thob rting gnyan khrod e 'grim zer ba'i lan du mgur 'di gsungs so// ༈ gnyan sa ri khrod 'grim pa phyi yi gcod// phung po gzan du skyur ba nang gi gcod// nyag gcig rtsad nas gcod pa don gyi gcod// gcod de gsum dang ldan pa'i rnal 'byor pa zhig lags// gcod de gsum byed pa'i nya ma yod dam// zhes gsungs pas mo na re/ gcod byed pa la phaṭa dgos pas phaṭa kyi don ci lta bu lags zhus pa'i lan du mgur 'di gsungs so// ༈ 'thor ba sdud pa phyi yi phaṭa// bying ba gseng ba nang gi phaṭa// sems nyid gzhi rtsa gcod pa don gyi phaṭa// phaṭa skor de gsum dang ldan pa'i rnal 'byor pa zhig lags// phaṭa skor de gsum byed pa'i nya ma yod dam// zhes gsungs pas mo na re/ phaṭa de rnams byas pa'i rting la gzhi lam 'bras bu ji lta bu yod zer ba'i lan du mgur 'di gsungs so// ༈ gzhi ma bcos khyab gdal chen po// lam ma bcos zang thal chen po// 'bras bu ma bcos phyag rgya chen po// gzhi lam 'bras gsum dang ldan pa'i rnal 'byor pa zhig lags// gzhi lam 'bras gsum dang ldan pa'i nya ma yod dam// zhes gsungs pas mo na re/ gzhi lam 'bras bu gsum de ltar yod na mi 'jigs pa'i gdengs ci yod zer ba'i lan du mgur 'di gsungs so//

༈ lha med 'dre med lta ba'i gdengs// yengs med sgom med sgom pa'i gdengs// re dogs med pa 'bras bu'i gdengs// gdengs de gsum dang ldan pa'i rnal 'byor pa zhig lags// gdengs de gsum rtogs 'dod kyi nya ma yod dam// zhes gsungs pas nya ma shin tu dad pas zhabs la 'jus te nang du gdan drangs bsnyen bkur bzang po byas nas sgom zhig tu zer te gsol 'debs 'di phul lo// ༈ ang gi rje btsun rin po che// 'o na skyes mchog rnal 'byor pa// nga nyin mo bya ba'i las la brel// mtshan mo gti mug gi gnyid du song*// nang nub lto gos kyi khol por song*// chos la byed pa'i long ma byung*// sangs rgyas thob pa'i chos shig zhu// byang chub thob pa'i chos shig zhu// zhes zer ba'i lan du rje btsun gyis dpe bzhi don dang lnga'i mgur 'di gsungs so// ang gi nya ma dpal dar 'bum// gson dang phyug mo dad pa can// khyod nam mkha' 'di la yar ltos la// mtha' dbus med pa'i sgom zhig gyis// nyi zla gnyis la yar ltos la// gsal 'grib med pa'i sgom zhig gyis// ri bo 'di la phar ltos la// 'pho 'gyur med pa'i sgom zhig gyis// rgya mtsho 'di la mar ltos la// rba rlabs med pa'i sgom zhig gyis// rang sems 'di la tshur ltos la// rnam rtog med pa'i sgom zhig gyis// zhes gsungs pas nya mas bsgoms nas sems dpyod 'di phul lo// ༈ ang nge rje btsun rin po che// 'o na skyes mchog rnal 'byor pa// ngas nam mkha' sgom du gtub lags te// lho sprin byung na ji ltar sgom// nyi zla sgom du gtub lags te// gza' skar 'khrugs na ji ltar sgom// ri bo sgom du gtub lags te// rtsi shing rgyas na ji ltar sgom// rgya mtsho sgom du gtub lags te// rba rlabs byung na ji ltar sgom// rang sems sgom du gtub lags te// rnam rtog 'phro na ji ltar sgom// zhes zhus pas rje btsun gyis gegs sel gyi mgur 'di gsungs so//

༈ ang nge nya ma dpal dar 'bum// gson dang phyug mo dad pa can// nam mkha' sgom du gtub lags na// lho sprin nam mkha'i cho 'phrul yin// da rung cho 'phrul gtan la phob// da rung sems nyid gtan la phob// nyi zla sgom du gtub lags na// gza' skar nyi zla'i cho 'phrul yin// da rung cho 'phrul gtan la phob// da rung sems nyid gtan la phob// ri bo sgom du gtub lags na// rtsi shing ri bo'i cho 'phrul yin// da rung cho 'phrul gtan la phob// da rung sems nyid gtan la phob// rgya mtsho sgom du gtub lags na// rba rlabs rgya mtsho'i cho 'phrul yin// da rung cho 'phrul gtan la phob// da rung sems nyid gtan la phob// rang sems sgom du gtub lags na// rnam rtog sems kyi cho 'phrul yin// da rung rnam rtog rtsa bdar chod// da rung sems nyid gtan la phob// ces gsungs nas bsgoms pas nyams bzang po skyes nas bla mas zhal ta rgyab skyor bzhi ma 'di mgur du gsungs so// ༈ ang nge nya ma dpal dar 'bum// gson dang phyug mo dad pa can// tshe 'di las phyi ma bshul thag ring*// brgyags phye grabs su tshud lags sam// brgyags phye sbyin pa yin pas thongs lags sam// dgra ser sna zer ba'i 'gag 'ching mkhan// 'dis phan pa bzhin byas nas gnod pa bskyal// ser sna dgra bor 'dug pa shes lags sam// shes na rgyab tu skyur la thong*// go na rgyab tu skyur la thong*// ang nge nya ma dpal dar 'bum// gson dang phyug mo dad pa can// tshe 'di las phyi ma mun pa nag /gsal me grabs su tshud lags sam// gsal me 'od gsal yin pas sgom lags sam// dgra gti mug zer ba'i ro nyal mkhan// 'dis phan pa bzhin byas nas gnod pa bskyal// gti mug dgra bor 'dug pa shes lags sam// shes na rgyab tu skyur la thong*// go na rgyab tu skyur la thong*// ang nge nya ma dpal dar 'bum// gson dang phyug mo dad pa can// tshe 'di las phyi ma 'jigs pa che// skyel ma grabs su tshud lags sam// skyel ma lha chos yin pas byas lags sam// dgra nye 'brel zer ba'i bshol 'debs mkhan// 'dis phan pa bzhin byas nas gnod pa bskyal// nye 'brel dgra bor 'dug pas shes lags sam// shes na rgyab tu skyur la thong*// go na rgyab tu skyur la thong*// ang nge nya ma dpal dar 'bum// gson dang phyug mo dad pa can// tshe 'di las phyi ma lam 'phrang ring*// rta pho grabs su tshud lags sam// rta pho brtson 'grus yin pas brtsams lags sam// dgra le lo zer ba'i snyom las mkhan// 'dis phan pa bzhin byas nas gnod pa bskyal// le lo dgra bo yin pas shes lags sam// shes na rgyab tu skyur la thong*// go na rgyab tu skyur la thong*// zhes gsungs te gdams ngag byin nas bsgoms pas snyan rgyud 'dzin pa'i rnal 'byor ma ngo mtshar can zhig byung ngo*// de thams cad gung thang lho sgo'i skor ro//

༈ de nas rje btsun ras chung pa de nyid rgya gar la byon dus su bal po dang rgya gar gyi bar du 'grul pa ma byung bas dgun bal por bzhugs nas bal po ha ru dkar po'i phag mo yang zhus/ dpyid kar song ba dang bal po'i rgyal po la rtags shig blangs nas rgya gar du e thon bsams nas rnga ma dkar po gcig /gla rtsi gor gcig /gser zho gang dang gsum khyer nas mjal zhus tsa na bod glen pa khyod dang mjal sa med zer/ 'o na sku mkhar gyi rtse la byon na nga la zhu rgyu gal chen zhig yod bzlas pas/ sku mkhar gyi rtse la mngon pa la phyag rten sna gsum po de phyag tu phul nas mgur 'di gsungs so// ༈ lta ba'i sku mkhar mtho mi mtho// phyogs ris dmag gis bskor na mngon// sgom pa'i ri rgyal brtan mi brtan// dgon par yun ring bsdad na mngon// spyod pa'i rgyal po bzang mi bzang*// chos brgyad chab la brgal na mngon// brtson 'grus rta pho mgyogs mi 'gyogs// le lo'i thang la rgyug na mngon// ser sna'i mdud pa grol ma grol// zang zing nor dang 'phrad na mngon// shes rab ral gri rno mi rno// lung dang rigs pa bshags na mngon// rgyal po'i bka' khrims dam mi dam// ras chung rgya gar yul du phyin na mngon// zhes zhus pas rgyal po'i zhal nas khyod mi la ras pa'i slob ma ras chung pa zhes bya ba zhig yod zer ba de e yin gsungs/ yin zhus pas ghaṇḍa'i rtags shig gnang*/ phyag rten rnams kyang phyir gtad/ lam chas dgos pa khyer gsungs nas/ da res khyod kyis rgya gar du 'gro tshad pa khrid dang ci yang mi lto gsungs/ ras chung pas brgya tsam khrid nas song bas shing spang gser gyi maṇḍal gyi rtsa ba na gsang sngags kyi rgyal po te pu pa dang mjal lo// ༈ rje sgam po pa sogs kyi gsung mgur lo rgyus dang bcas pa bzhugs/ ༈ de nas rje sgam po pa de nyid bla ma'i rdzu 'phrul gyis bskul ba dang rje rang yang bla ma'i mtshan thos pa tsam la mos gus 'bar nas mjal ba la byon dus su/

spro bde bkra shis sgang du byon te/ bud med gcig thags 'thag gin 'dug pa la rje btsun mi la ras pa bya ba gzhan rgyud kyi bsam pa mkhyen cing sprul pa sna tshogs ston nus pa zhig bzhugs zer ba ga na zhugs gsungs pas/ de rgyus yod pa'i nya ma zhig bstan zer nas bud med rgan mo ras gos kyi steng na rgya ma lhod de ba bcings pa zhig bstan nas dris pas bud med rgan mo na re/ do nub sleb sa med nga'i khang pa'i steng du bzhugs zer nas steng khang zhig tu gdan drangs nas/ kha sang ngas rje btsun chen po'i spyan sngar phyin pas dbus nas bka' gdams pa'i ston pa zhig nga la 'phrad du 'ong bas/ de dang nga gnyis 'phrad pa'i mjal sna sus byas pa de la ngan song gi 'jigs pa las skyob nus gsungs pas/ nga'i bu mo sgom ma zhig rje btsun gyi drung na yod pas mo la mjal sna 'tshol ba yin zer phyi de nang par bla ma'i spyan sngar sleb pa las rin po che'i thugs dgongs la nga yong ba mkhyen lugs kyis snod ldan zhig yin par 'dug /gdams ngag la dka' tshegs mi 'ong snyam pa'i nga rgyal zhig skyes pa de mkhyen nas zla ba phyed du mjal kha ma byung*/ se ban ras pas phru ba zhig byin nas gad 'og cig tu bskyal/ dbus pa ston pa khyod 'ong ba bla mas mkhyen nas 'dug /gdams ngag kyang gnang bar 'dug gis da ngang thung ma byed par gsol ba 'debs shing sdod zer/ zla ba phyed song tsa na spro bde bkra shis sgang du bla ma dang mjal zer nas byon pas rje btsun pha wang zhig gi steng na bzhugs nas 'dug /gser phyag tu phul bas/ gser dang mi rgan blo mi mthun/ khyod rang sgrub pa byed pa'i brgyags gyis gsungs/ khyod kyi ming ci yin gsungs pas/ bsod nams rin chen bya ba lags zhus pas/ bsod nams bsod nams tshogs chen bsags las byung*/ 'gro ba kun gyi rin po che/ bya ba lan gsum gsungs/ chang thod phor gang gi gsol 'phro 'dug pa de gnang nas 'di 'thung gsung ba la rten dge slong yin pa dang 'khor mang bar 'dug pas len ma nus pa la/

rje btsun gyi zhal nas rnam rtog ma mang 'thungs gsung bas bla mas mkhyen 'dug snyams nas lhag ma tsam yang ma lus par gsol bas rgyud pa zin cing gdams ngag ma lus pa'i snod du 'gro bar mkhyen no// de nas se ban ras pa dang ras chung pa gnyis 'dir shog 'o skol gyis ston pa la sna len gyi glu zhig bya'o gsungs nas mgur 'di gsungs so// ༈ rje bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// shar seng ge dkar mo'i 'o ma de// bcud dang ldan par cha mchis kyang*// lha dbang brgya byin khong gis gsol nas 'ong*// lha rgya stag khra bo'i yang rtsal de// yang rtsal che yo skad par cha mchis kyang*// ḍombi he ru ka yis chibs nas 'ong*// nub dga' ldan lha yi pho brang de// gzigs mo che yo skad par cha mchis kyang*// 'phags pa thogs med khong gis gzigs nas 'ong*// byang ltang dkar nya yi mkhris pa de// ro kha yo skad par cha mchis kyang*// klu rgyal gtsug na rin chen khong gis gsol nas 'ong*// nā ro'i thabs lam zab mo de// lam bgrod thag nye bar cha mchis kyang*// rje mar pa lo tsās gshegs nas 'ong*// mar pa'i snyan rgyud dri med de// nyams rtogs pa skye bar cha mchis kyang*// mi la ras pa nga yis bsgoms nas 'ong*// nga mi la'i nyams myong tshig gsum po// tshig gnad du 'dril bar cha mchis kyang*// dbus pa ston pa khyod byung bas 'chad pa yin// gser dang ban rgan blo mi mthun// ja la bskol ba'i thab ka med// bu snying nas lha chos mdzad dgongs na// tshe 'di la ma dga' phyi ma soms// bka' rgyud kyi gdan sa 'dzin 'dod na// tshig la ma dga' don la ltos// khyed dge slong gi thugs la de ltar zhog /de la ston pa khyod kyi sna len byed pa yin gsungs/ yang gsang ba 'dus pa dang rdo rje gdan bzhi la sogs pa rnams nas kyang*/ dus gsum sangs rgyas mchod pa bas// slob dpon ba spu'i khung bu mchog /ces gsungs pa dang*/

dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad la rin po che'i phung po ri rab tsam phul ba bas/ bla ma'i ba spu gcig mchod pa bsod nams che gsungs/ de bas zab pa'i tshogs gsog thabs yod dam zhus pas/ yod gsungs/ de bdag la gnang bar zhu zhus pas/ bla mas bstan pa'i gdams ngag de chud ma zos par nyams su blangs na de ka yin gsung*/ bdag gis dge ba'i bshes gnyen snyug rum pa la tshe gcig lus gcig la sangs rgyas srid dam zhus pas/ tshe 'di la ltos pa spu tsam med pa zhig dgos pa yin gsung*/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen yar klungs pa la zhus pas gsung de nges pa can ma yin/ dgongs pa can yin/ sman ri lu 'grub pas tshe nyi zla dang mnyam pa/ skye ba bdun pa yin pa/ yi dam lha'i zhal mthong ba/ mkha' spyod du 'gro nus pa zhig dgos pa yin gsung*/ de ltar lags sam zhus pas/ gsung de dgongs pa can min/ nges pa can yin/ tshe 'di la ltos pa med pa zhig dgos/ bla ma mtshan nyid dang ldan pa zhig la slob ma snod dang ldan pa zhig gis gsang sngags kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang rdzogs par zhus nas bskyed rdzogs kyi gdams ngag bar ma chad par bsgoms pas tshe 'dir 'tshang rgya/ 'bring 'chi kha'am bar dor 'grub/ shin tu le lo che na yang skye ba bdun nam bcu drug tshun du 'grub/ de la ma 'grub na dam tshig la sel zhugs pa yin pas/ re zhig ngan song du skye dogs yod/ lar lha rje ston pa khyod lta ba kha tshol bskur ba'i mi dang blo ma bstun/ de'i ngag la ma nyan/ rjes su ma 'brang*/ sgom pa nyams su len pa'i mi dang blo bstun/ de'i ngag la nyon/ rjes su 'brang dgos pa yin/ gros phug thams cad tshe 'di blos btang ba'i skyes bu dam pa rnams la bya dgos/ tshe 'dis mi khrid pa'i gang zag 'ga' zhig gis chos brgyad slob tu 'ong ba yin/ lar stong nyid la gol sa yod pa yin/ stong nyid rgyas 'debs su shor ba dang*/ stong nyid shes bya'i gshis la shor ba dang*/

stong nyid gnyen por shor ba dang/ chags par shor ba bzhi yin te/ stong nyid rgyas 'debs su shor ba 'di ltar gzung ba dang 'dzin pa blo'i yul du gyur pa thams cad stong nyid yin zer ba yod/ stong nyid shes bya'i gshis la shaur ba bya ba 'di ltar 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa'i chos thams cad stong pa nyid yin zer ba dang*/ stong nyid gnyen por shor ba bya ba nyon mongs pa dang rnam par rtog pa gang skyes la bltas pa de ka stong pa yin zer ba yod/ stong nyid chags par shor ba bya ba gang la sgom rgyu med cing sgom thams cad stong pa yin zer ba yod/ de rnams lam yang dag pa ma yin/ 'on kyang las dang po pa la blo'i bden zhen ldog pa la phan rung tsam yin/ lar sems kyi gzhi rtsa ma chod na bde gsal mi rtog pa gsum gyi nyams yod kyang srid pa gsum las ma 'das/ rtsa ba ma chod pa bya ba'i nyams yin/ 'o na lam yang dag pa gang yin na/ bla ma mtshan nyid dang ldan pa zhig gis slob ma snod dang ldan pa zhig ngo sprad de khrid pas/ gnyug ma'i shes pa de sems can thams cad la khyab par gnas/ sangs rgyas thams cad la chos sku'i snang ba gsal/ rnal 'byor pa la thabs dpag tu med pas mtshon nas bsgoms pas lta ba shugs kyis rtogs/ nyon mongs pa ngang gis 'gags/ rnam rtog shugs kyis chod/ ye shes shugs la 'char/ de dus su nyams su myong ba'i rtogs pa de ngag tu smra mi gtub/ dper na gzhon nu ma'i bde ba'am/ lkugs pa'i rmi lam bzhin/ gzhi de ni sems can kun la yod kyang ngo ma shes/ des na rgyud ldan gyi bla ma bsten pa gal che/ de bas gnyug ma'i shes pa de phu gar yang ma gtad/ sgo gang yang ma 'gags/ dpe gang gis kyang mtshon par mi nus/ brjod bya gang gis kyang thog tu mi phebs/ tha snyad gang gis kyang mtshon par mi nus/ des na bcas bcos mi bya/ rang gar ma bcos pa'i ngang la lhod de gzhog mdzod gsungs nas mgur 'di gsungs so//

༈ lta ba yin par nges kyi rang gi sems la ltos// sems las gzhan du lta ba btsal ba na// gyad kyis nor 'tshol 'dra'o ang nge lha rje ston pa ba// sgom pa yin par nges kyi bying rgod skyon ma bsal// sgom pa bying rgod skyon bsal na// nyin par mar me 'degs pa 'dra'o ang nge lha rje ston pa ba// spyod pa yin par nges kyi blang dor res ma byed// spyod pa blang dor res byas na// sbrang ma rgya ru tshud pa 'dra 'o ang nge lha rje ston pa ba// dam tshig yin par nges kyi lta ba'i gdengs la zhog /bsrung med dam tshig gzhan nas btsal ba na// chu bo gyen la slog pa 'dra'o ang nge lha rje ston pa ba// 'bras bu yin par nges kyi sems la nges shes bskyed// thob med 'bras bu gzhan nas btsal ba na// sbal pa gnam du mchong ba 'dra 'o ang nge lha rje ston pa ba// bla ma yin par nges kyi rang gi sems la dris// sems las gzhan du bla ma btsal ba na// de yis rang sems spangs pa 'dra'o ang nge lha rje ston pa ba// des na snang ba thams cad sems su 'dus par gda' 'o ang nge lha rje ston pa ba// zhes gsungs so// der je 'jigs je 'jigs la song nas sku'i gzi brjid la ma tshugs par bzhugs gdan khyer nas ma tshad la byon nas gzims so// nang par rje btsun gyi spyan sngar phyin pas/ dbus pa ston pa khyod chos gsha' ma zhig byed na yon tan 'tshong ba dang dge sbyor byed pa gnyis rgyab bsnol yin/ ston brin dang snye nam la bsod snyoms kyis nub mo grong seb tu ma sdod par spro bde phug tu snyogs gsung*/ der rje btsun bden dgongs nas bsod snyoms mdzad de/ gtum mo'i khrid zhus nas bsgoms pas dang po la lung pa'i mdor gcer bur bsgoms pas bde drod rang 'bar la song*/ nam langs nas gnyid du song bas lus rdo ba ltar song nas 'dug /de nas zhag bdun bsgoms pas bde drod rang 'bar la song nas zhag bdun gyi nang par rgyal ba rigs lnga'i zhal mthong*/

bla ma la zhus pas mig btsir nas bltas pas zla ba gnyis su mthong ba dang 'dra/ 'byung ba lnga'i rlung zin pa yin/ skyon dang yon tan gang yang min sgoms gsungs/ zla ba gsum lon pa'i tho rangs shig stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di 'khor lo bskor ba bzhin 'khor zhing 'dug pas stong skyug mang pos byas/ 'gyel nas yun ring zhig tu brgyal nas 'dug pa la/ bla ma la zhus pas ro rkyang gnyis kyi rlung dhū tir brjes pa yin/ skyon dang yon tan gang yang min sgoms gsungs/ yang snga dro zhig thugs rje chen po them ber nem ber du 'dug pa la/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor re re dbu thog na 'dug par mthong*/ bla ma la zhus pas/ spyi gtsug bde chen gyi 'khor lor thig le 'phel ba yin/ skyon dang yon tan gang yang min sgoms gsungs/ yang dgongs mo srod cig la dmyal ba thig nag mthong bas rkyen byas nas snying 'tshangs pas snying rlung drag po byung*/ bla ma la zhus pas sgom thag thung bas rtsa bcing pa yin/ cung ring du gyis gyen du rgyu ba'i rlung zin pa yin/ skyon dang yon tan gang yang min sgoms gsungs/ yang nyin zhig tsa na 'dod lha rigs drug gi lha rnams gsal por mthong nas gong ma gong mas 'og ma 'og ma la bdud rtsi'i char 'bebs shing 'dug /lha rnams ngoms shing tshims nas 'dug pa la bdag gi ma skom grir 'chi ba zhig 'dug pa mthong*/ bla ma la zhus pas/ bdud rtsi 'bab pa de mgrin pa longs spyod kyi 'khor lor ro rkyang gnyis kyi thig le 'phel ba yin/ ma skom pa de dhū ti'i kha ma bye ba yin pas/ lus kyi 'khrul 'khor 'di tsho gyis dang gsungs/ 'khrul 'khor btsan thabs kyi rdog 'tshog gnang nas zla ba gcig byas pas lus 'phar ba dang 'dar ba dang sprug 'dod pa rgyun chad med pa dang*/ rang dbang med pa'i ku 'debs 'dod pa byung*/ 'dre yin nam snyam bla ma la zhus pas/

snying ga chos kyi 'khor lo thig les gang ba yin/ 'khrul 'khor 'phro ma bcad par 'bad la sgoms/ skyon dang yon tan gang yang min gsungs/ de nas kha zas cher mi dgos pa byung*/ yang nyin gcig mdun gyi nam mkha' la nyi zla gnyis gzas zin 'dug /gza' de rta rnga phra mo gnyis su 'dug /bla ma la zhus pas/ dhū tir ro rkyang gnyis kyi rlung chud pa yin/ skyon dang yon tan gang yang min/ pho rgod rab tu 'dug /da ni da ni bya ba lan gsum gsungs/ de nas drag tu bsgoms pas zla ba gcig na dgyes pa rdo rje dmar po'i dkyil 'khor zhig mthong*/ bla mas da ni da ni gsungs pa de 'di yi dam gyi lha yin par 'dug snyam nas bla ma la zhus pas/ snying ga chos kyi 'khor lor ma las thob pa'i rakta brtan pa yin te/ skyon dang yon tan gang yang min sgoms gsungs/ yang 'bad nas bsgoms pas nyin gcig bde mchog lo hi pa keng rus kyi dkyil 'khor zhig mthong*/ bla ma la zhus pas/ lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lo thig les gang ba yin/ skyon dang yon tan gang yang min sgoms gsungs/ de nas 'bad de bsgoms pas/ zhag bcu bzhi lon tsa na mtshan thog gcig la bdag gi lus 'di nam mkha'i khams tsam du red nas 'dug /spyi bo'i gtsug nas rkang pa'i mthil yan chad du 'gro ba rigs drug gi sems can rnams 'dug pa las/ phal cher 'o ma 'ba' zhig 'thung zhing 'dug /la la skar ma la bzhos pa'i 'o ma 'thung zhing 'dug /'ur dir gyi sgra lta bu ga nas byung cha med par dus rgyun du 'ong zhing 'dug /nam langs nas sgom thag bkrol tsa na med par song*/ bla ma la zhus pas/ lus kyi rtsa stong phrag tsam bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i nang du las kyi rlung gis thig le khrid pa yin te/ rlung de ye shes kyi rlung du sgyur 'tshal gda' gsungs nas mchog gi gtum mo gnang nas bsgoms pas nyin gcig gung thang gi lung thams cad dud pas gang nas 'dug /phyi dro song nas mun nag tu red nas 'dug

/lam ma rnyed pas long ba 'gros byas nas bla ma'i spyan sngar phyin pas/ bla ma'i zhal nas/ ci yang mi lto der sdod la sgoms gsungs nas/ steng gi gegs sel zhig gnang bas nam langs pa bzhin song*/ de nas yar nub cig rang gi lus keng rus sha med par rtsa mang pos sbrel nas 'dug par mthong*/ bla ma la zhus pas/ rlung rtsub thal ba yin/ 'jam par gyis gsungs/ de nas srod la yi dam gyi lha bsgoms shing bzlas pa byas/ gung la bla ma'i rnal 'byor bsgoms shing gsol ba 'ba' zhig btab/ tho rangs srog rtsol gyi rlung bsgoms/ nang par skya rengs shar tsam na gnyid thun phran tsam zhig song ba la sngar 'dris kyi bag chags med pa'i rmi lam du ltas nyi shu rtsa bzhi byung ba la/ der mnal sad pa dang*/ rmi lam dge'am mi dge snyam du rtog pa cung zad cig skyes pa las/ yang thugs dgongs btang bas yong bla ma rje btsun sangs rgyas mngon sum pa ci yang mkhyen pa bzhugs pa la zhus pas chog snyam nas tsha ba yang ma skol bar de ka la bzhengs nas byon pas/ rje btsun chu bar gyi brag rtsa zhig na dbu thums skyur gzims gda' ba la/ der phyag btsal maṇḍal phul nas/ rje btsun lags kho bo la gal shin tu che ba zhig mchis/ ma gzims par bzhengs par zhu zhus pa la/ rje btsun gyi zhal nas/ khyod la rnam rtog cig skyes 'dug pa da nang de nga'i nyams snang la byung bas/ da ma bde ba'i do gal ci yod smros shig gsungs pa la/ bla ma rin po ches tho rangs rmi lam du byung ba'i mtshan ltas de rnams bla ma rje btsun chen po'i snyan du gsol te de rnams dge mi dge ji ltar lags zhus pas/ rje brtul zhugs spyod pa'i rnal 'byor pa// ngo mtshar ras kyi na bza' can// yid bzhin nor bu gtsug gi rgyan// kun gyis thod bzhin bkur ba'i gnas// mtshan mi la zhes byar yongs su grags// mtshan de yi snyan pas phyogs bcur khyab// de thos pas kho bo spro ba skyes// shar skar ma smin drug 'og nas bsnyags// lus tsha grang yid la ma bgyis te// rtag tu ngu yi rnam thar bzhin// rje ras pa khyod dang nam mjal snyam// lam ring dka' ba sna tshogs spyad// gdugs phyed dang gnyis kyis phyin kha ru// lus srog yal bar de'u dor byas// 'on kyang mos gus drag po'i mthus// shar phyogs spos ldan grong khyer du// chos 'phags dngos su zhal gzigs ltar// bkra shis sgang gi gdan sa ru// pha ras pa rje btsun khyod dang mjal// kho bo'i bsam pa mthar phyin snyam// shin tu spro dga' ba spu g.yos// nor sgyu ma'i 'bul rgyu ma mchis kyang*// gzhi 'khor ba'i chos la zhen pa log

/lam skye shi gnyis la 'jigs shing skrag /'jig rten gyi snang ba blo yis btang*// sgrub blo zhig gting nas skyes pa de// rje khyod kyi thugs rje'i lcags kyus bzung*// de mi brjed kho bo'i sems la 'jog /'bangs zhu don mchis so gu ru rje// mdangs srod la yi dam bsnyen pa byas// nam gung rje la gsol ba btab// de rjes srog rtsol rlung la 'bad// dgung da nang skya rengs tha ma la// gnyid thum phral tsam zhig song ba la// sngar 'dris bag chags ma mchis pa'i// ya mtshan rmi lam 'di rnams byung*/ ༈ /dbyar zhwa dar gyi cha ga can// mtshal dmar 'obs kyi pad kyis brgyan// de la rgod kyi spu ru btsugs// mi kho bo'i mgo la gyon pa rmis// sum lh+wam sngo gzhi 'gying bag can// ra gan 'bur mgo cho lo btab// sgrog dngul gyi a long cho lo mdzes// lh+wam de 'dra zung zhig gyon pa rmis// gu lang dar dkar ral ga la// gong skor gser thag mdo long ris// mtshal gyi thig phran 'dzum ris can// gos de 'dra lus la gyon pa rmis// mon zong ras yug gi ske rags la// me tog sna tshogs bkra bas brgyan// mu tig har gyi chun 'phyang spras// de 'khor gsum sked la bcings pa rmis// chu lon ras dkar gyi phying pa la// bzo dras su ma byas rang lugs la// gong rgyan dngul gyi pho long btags// de ya mtshan steng nas gyon pa rmis// a mra tsandan dbyug pa la// rin chen sna bdun phra bkod de// 'chang gzung gser gyi drwa ba can// de lag pa g.yas su bzung ba rmis// mtshan ldan rdo rje kā pā la// gser mdog bdud rtsi bcud kyis bkang*// kho bo'i kha phor bya snyam nas// de lag pa g.yon du khyer ba rmis// sum gal khra bo dor gcig gi /nang du 'bras dkar sā lu blugs// kho bo'i chos brgyags bya snyam nas// phrag pa g.yas su bkal ba rmis// ri dwags kṛṣḍa'i pags pa la// mgo dang sder bzhi ma nyams pa// 'di yis kho bo'i stan bya snyam// phrag pa g.yon du bkal ba rmis// de rjes g.yas su phar bltas pas// gser gyi spang po ngos bzang la// be'u lug mang po bzas la bkram// kho bos phyugs rdzi bya snyam rmis// phyi rjes g.yon du tshur bltas pas// g.yu yi ne'u thang sing ma la// me tog sna tshogs tshon tshogs bkra// bud med mang pos phyag byas rmis// dbus me tog ser po'i gling kha na// shin tu 'dab rgyas gser mdog can// padma spungs pa'i gdan stengs su// sems dpa'i skyil krung bcas pa rmis// mdun du chu mig rdol ba rmis// rgyab tu 'od cig 'khyil ba rmis// lus la me dpung 'bar ba rmis// snying la nyi zla shar ba rmis// ya mtshan rmi lam de rnams byung*// ltas dge'am mi dge 'chad ma shes// rje dus gsum mkhyen pa'i rnal 'byor pa// 'di don ma 'tshal gsung bar zhu// zhes rmi lam gyi ltas de rnams snyan du gsol ba la/

rje btsun gyi zhal nas/ bu lha rje ston pa thugs mi bde mi 'tshal bas shes pa lhod glod la gzhog mdzod/ rnam rtog gi drwa bar bdag 'dzin gyi nang 'tshang ma gzhug /the tshom gyi mdud pa rang grol du thong*/ gnyis 'dzin gyi thag pa phra sar chod/ bag chags kyi rdul stan srab sar gtor/ sems 'du 'phro ma mang*/ ma bcos so ma'i ngang du zhog /nga sgyu lus sbyangs pa'i rnal 'byor pa zhig yin pas rmi lam 'chad pa yang shes/ rmi lam bsgyur ba yang shes/ rmi lam gyi de kho na nyid kyi rgyas 'debs pa'i gdengs yod/ lar ngas rmi lam gyi chos nyid khong du chud pa yin pas bu khyod kyis smras pa'i mtshan ltas de rnams dus da res pha rgan nga yis tshig zhib tshags go nges su bshad la brda don ngo sprad kyi/ thugs ma yengs par gtod la snyan lhan ne gson cig gsungs pa'i rjes la rje btsun gyis rmi lam zhu gsol gyi drin lan gsung dbyangs mgur du bzhengs pa/ ༈ glu dri lan 'jal lo lha rje ba// snyan lhan ner gson la thugs gtad 'tshal// bu zangs dkar lugs kyi bde mchog gsan// dbu ru stod kyi bka' gdams bskyangs// gnas pa bzang po'i chu rgyun mnga'// de kun ngo mtshar che snyam pas// rmi lam bag chags nying 'khrul la// ltas ched du bzung ste yid gtod pa// bu gsan rgya chung ngam rdzu ba lags// mdo rgyud bstan bcos ma gzigs sam// nges don pha rol phyin pa nas// rmi lam yang dag ma yin te// gsog dang gsob dang ya ma brla// snying po med ces thub pas gsungs// de bzhin sgyu ma'i dpe brgyad la// gong dang mtshungs te rgyas par gsungs// de don thugs su ma byon nam// 'on kyang da res mtshan ltas de// ma 'ongs lung bstan ngo mtshar che// nga rmi lam sbyangs pa'i rnal 'byor pa// sgyu ma'i ngo sprod 'chad pa shes// mgo la zhwa dkar gyon pa de// theg pa yas mar 'bubs pa'i brda// rgya mo'i dar chag btags pa de// sems nyid zab cing phra bar bstan// spu sdug 'obs kyi kha dog ltar// grub mtha' ma 'dres so sor gsal// rgod kyi bya phod ldem pa de// lta ba'i yang rtse phyag rgya che// skye med ngo bo mthong ba'i brda// sum lh+wam zung zhig gyon pa de// spyod pas yas mar 'dzeg pa'i brda// sngo bzhi 'bur gyis brgyan pa de// 'bras bu sku bzhi thob pa'i brda// tshogs gnyis bsags pa'i brda ru bstan// sgrog dngul gyi a long gsal ba de// spyod pa'i gol sa yin pa'i phyir// rtog med rang gar mi spyod par// rgyal sras gzhon nu'i tshul bzhin du// bag yod mdzes par spyod pa'i brda// dar dkar ral ga gyon pa de// rang rgyud skyon gyis ma gos brda// gong skor gser thag btso ma de// mi 'gyur bsam pa bzang ba'i brda// mtshal gyi thig phran 'dzum ris can// brtse bas 'gro don byed pa'i brda// mon zong ras yug ske rags kyis// 'khor gsum sked la bcings pa de// rgyud sdom pa gsum dang ldan pa'i brda// me tog dkar po'i rgyan mdzes shing*// mu tig har gyi spras pa de// bslab pa gsum gyis rab brgyan cing*// gdul bya dang ba 'dren pa'i brda// steng nas 'phying dkar gyon pa de// chos sku dri med rtogs pa'i brda// bzo dang dras su ma byas pa// de la bcas bcos med pa'i brda// dngul gyi pho long btab pa de// de don 'gyur ba med pa'i brda// a mra tsandan dbyug pa de// rang 'dod bla ma rnyed pa'i brda// rin chen sna bdun phra bkod pa// de ni rje yi yon tan lags// 'chang gzung gser gyi drwa ba de// snyan rgyud gnad kyi gdams ngag gis// skal ldan rjes su 'dzin pa'i brda// lag pa g.yas la thogs pa de// bde nas bde bar lam bgrod de// sangs rgyas zhing du gshegs pa'i brda// mtshan ldan rdo rje ka pā la// ngo bo stong pa mtshon pa'i brda// bdud rtsi bcud kyis bkang ba de// nyams myong 'bral ba med pa'i brda// gser mdog 'od dang ldan pa de// rnam pa 'od gsal mtshon pa'i brda// kho bo'i kha phor bya snyam pa// de gsum gcig tu mtshon pa'i brda// lag pa g.yon du khyer ba de// nyams myong 'bral ba med pa'i brda// sum gal khra bo mdzes pa de// ci 'dod lam su slong ba'i brda// dor bsdebs phrag la bkal ba de// zung 'jug thabs dang shes rab kyis// theg chen lam du bgrod pa'i brda// nang gi 'bras dkar sā lu de// kho bo'i chos brgyags bya snyam pa// sku tshe la bar chad mi 'byung zhing*// bsam gtan zas kyis 'tsho ba'i brda// phrag g.yon kṛṣṇa'i khri snyan pags pa de// dran pa yengs med mtshon pa'i brda// mgo dang sder bzhi ma nyams pa// byang chub sems kyi rgyun goms shing*// tshad med bzhi la sbyangs pa'i phyir// 'gro drug sdug bsngal sel ba'i brda// kho bo'i stan bya snyam pa yang*// stong nyid snying rje dbyer med pa'i// rtogs pa rgyud la skye ba'i brda// de rjes g.yas su phar bltas pas// gser gyi spang po ngos bzang de// phyi nang yon tan rgyas pa'i brda// be'u lug bzas la bkram pa de// chos dang zang zing skyabs gnas kyis// 'gro ba'i re 'dod skong ba'i brda// kho bos phyugs rdzi bya snyam pa// sdug bsngal mgon med gyur pa rnams// thugs rjes 'gro ba skyong ba'i brda// phyi rjes g.yon du tshur bltas pas// g.yu yi ne'u thang sing ma de// zag med ting 'dzin rgyun goms pas// dga' bde ye shes mthong ba'i brda// me tog sna tshogs brgyan pa de// drod rtags phyogs med rim gyis 'char// nyams myong sna tshogs skye ba'i brda// bud med mang pos phyag byas pa// rtsa dang thig ler gnas pa yi// ḍā ki dbang du 'dus pa'i brda// dbus me tog ser po'i gling kha de// ting 'dzin rtogs pa dang ldan zhing*// tshul khrims gtsang mas rab brgyan pa'i// mkha' la sprin bzhin dge 'dun rnams// khyod kyi 'khor du 'du ba'i brda// shin tu 'dab rgyas gser mdog can// padma spungs pa'i gdan steng yang*// shes pas srid la mi gnas shing*// padma 'dam gyi ma gos ltar// 'khor ba'i skyon gyis ma gos brda// sems dpa'i skyil krung bcas pa yang*// snying rjes zhi la mi gnas shing*// byang chub sems dpa' gzhon nu ltar// 'gro drug sems can mar gyur la// sprul sku 'gro don byed pa'i brda// mdun du chu mig brdol ba de// chos kyi chab srid dar ba'i brda// rgyab tu 'od gcig 'khyil ba de// bod khams dkar por gtong ba'i brda// lus la me dpung 'bar ba de// bde drod gtum mo'i ye shes kyis// rnam rtog chab rom bzhu ba'i brda// snying la nyi zla shar ba de// 'gro 'ong med pa'i 'od gsal gyi// ngang la rtag tu gnas pa'i brda// bu rmi lam mi ngan rmi lam bzang*// dus phyi mar 'byung ba lung bstan pa// ltas dge bar bshad kyi chos kyi brda// lar rmi lam mngon sum gang la yang*// mtshan mar bzung na bar chad yin// sgyu mar shes na lam du 'gyur// rmi lam mi shes 'chad mi shes// bzang rmis ngan rtags rmi bar bshad// rmi lam sbyangs pa mngon gyur na// ngan rmis bzang ste dge bar bshad// lar skyon dang yon tan gang yang min// mchog tu ma 'dzin rigs kyi bu// khyod dge slong gi thugs la de ltar zhog

/ces gsungs so// da ni 'di nas shar phyogs na sgam po bdar gyi ri bo bya ba/ ri rgyal po gdan la bzhugs pa lta bu/ rtse mo rin chen prog zhu ltar yod pa/ nga'i zhwa 'di lta bu shing spang gser gyi maṇḍal bkod pa lta bu/ mdun ri rin chen spungs pa 'dra ba/ ri bdun blon po phyag 'tshal ba lta bu yod/ de'i mgul na khyod kyi gdul bya yod pas der song la 'gro don gyis shig gsungs nas mgur 'di gsungs so// ༈ ston pa dbus su bzhud mi bzhud// ston pa dbus su bzhud pa na// res 'ga' zas kyi snang ba 'char// zas kyi snang ba shar tsa na// zas su zag med ting 'dzin zo// zhim mngar kun sgyu mar shes par mdzod// cir snang chos skur nyams su long*// res 'ga' gos kyi snang ba 'char// gos kyi snang ba shar tsa na// gos su gtum mo'i bde drod gyon// 'jam legs kun sgyu mar shes par mdzod// cir snang chos skur nyams su long*// res 'ga' yul gyi snang ba 'char// yul gyi snang ba shar tsa na// yul du chos nyid gtan yul zung*// pha yul kun sgyu mar shes par mdzod// cir snang chos skur nyams su long*// res 'ga' nor gyi snang ba 'char// nor gyi snang ba shar tsa na// nor du 'phags pa'i nor bdun zung*// nor rdzas kun sgyu mar shes par mdzod// cir snang chos skur nyams su long*// res 'ga' grogs kyi snang ba 'char// grogs kyi snang ba shar tsa na// grogs su rang byung ye shes sten// zla grogs kun sgyu mar shes par mdzod// cir snang chos skur nyams su long*// res 'ga' bla ma'i snang ba 'char// bla ma'i snang ba shar tsa na// 'bral med spyi bor gsol ba thob// brjed med snying gi dkyil du sgoms// bla ma yang rmi lam sgyu ma 'dra// lar thams cad sgyu mar shes par mdzod// shar sgam po bdar gyi ri bo de// ri rgyal po gdan la zhugs pa 'dra// rgyab ri dar dkar phyar ba 'dra// mdun ri rin chen spung pa 'dra// rtse mor rin chen srog zhu 'dra// ri bdun blon po 'dud pa 'dra// shing spang gser gyi maṇḍal 'dra// ri de yi mgul na gdul bya yod// khyo de ru song la 'gro don mdzod// bu khyod kyis 'gro don 'grub ste mchi// gsungs nas khyod kyi ming yang dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa 'dzam gling grags pa zhes bya ba yin no gsungs/

de nas dbang dang byin rlabs gnyis kyi bka' byin/ chos thams cad rdzogs par gnang nas a ru ra gser mdog gcig la ljags kyi mchil ma btab pa zhig dang*/ me cha zhig gnang nas/ bla ma'i zhal nas da yul du song la sgoms gsungs/ spyir yang ri dwags rmas ma'am bya bzhin zon bag che bar bya/ zhi ba 'dul ba rtse rag chung bar bya/ bzod glags che bar bya/ thams cad dang mthun par bya/ gtsang sbra shin tu che bar bya/ rtog pa shin tu chung bar bya/ ri mtshams dang smra bcad dang 'dag sbyar gsum gyis dus 'da' bar bya/ rang sems sangs rgyas su rtogs kyang bla ma rdo rje slob dpon mi spong bar bya/ bsags sbyangs gnyis po rang sar dag kyang tshogs chung ngu nas bsag /las 'bras ni nam mkha' ltar go yang sdig pa chung ngu la 'dzem/ mnyam bzhag dang rjes thob med pa'i nyams myong yod kyang thun bzhi'i rnal 'byor rgyun chad med par nyams su long*/ bdag gzhan mnyam pa nyid du go yang chos dang gang zag la skur pa mi gdab/ bu khyod kyis yos bu lo rta zla ba'i tshes bcu bzhi la brin snye nam gyi mtshams su sleb pa gyis gsungs nas dwags po'i skyel mgur 'di gsungs so// ༈ bu spros bral sems la shar dus su// tha snyad tshig phyir ma 'brang zhig /chos brgyad sgrog tu tshud nyen yod// bu nga rgyal med pa'i ngang la zhog /de go'am dbus pa ston pa ba// de go'am dwags po lha rje ba// bu rang grol nang nas shar dus su// tshad ma'i sbyor ba ma bkod cig /don med kyi 'bad rtsol byed nyen yod// bu rnam rtog med pa'i ngang la zhog /de go 'am dbus pa ston pa ba// de go'am dwags po lha rje ba// rang sems stong nyid rtogs tsa na// gcig dang du mar ma sbrel zhig /chad pa'i stong nyid du 'gro nyen yod// bu spros pa med pa'i ngang du zhog /de go'am dbus pa ston pa ba// de go'am dwags po lha rje ba// phyag rgya chen po sgom dus su// lus ngag gi dge sbyor ma brtson zhig

/mi rtog ye shes yal nyen yod// bu ma bcos gnyug ma'i ngang la zhog /de go'am dbus pa ston pa ba// de go'am dwags po lha rje ba// rtags dang lung bstan byung dus su// dga' rlom ched du ma 'dzin cig /bdud kyi lung bstan 'byung nyen yod// bu ched 'dzin med pa'i ngang la zhog /de go'am dbus pa ston pa ba// de go'am dwags po lha rje ba// rang sems gtan la 'bebs dus su// mngon shes la 'dod pa ma skye zhig /dga' rlom bdud kyis khyer nyen yod// bu re ba med pa'i ngang la zhog /de go'am dbus pa ston pa ba// de go'am dwags po lha rje ba// zhes gsungs so// yang bla ma lha rjes bar do'i gdams ngag zhus pa la gsungs pa/ ༈ rje bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// sgos bka' drin can la skyabs su mchi// bu khyod kyis gsol ba btab pa'i ngor// da bar do 'di la dbyangs shig len// spyir khams gsum 'khor ba'i sems can dang*// mya ngan las 'das pa'i sangs rgyas gnyis// dngos po gshis la gnas lugs gcig /lta ba'i bar do de la mdzod// sna tshogs su shar ba'i dkar dmar dang*// brjod du med pa'i sems nyid gnyis// dbyer med gnyug ma'i ngang du gcig /sgom pa'i bar do de la mdzod// sna tshogs su snang ba'i 'khrul snang dang*// rang sems skye ba med pa gnyis// gnyis med lhan cig skyes par gcig /spyod pa'i bar do de la mdzod// mdangs sum nyal ba'i rmi lam dang*// sad nas brdzun du shes pa gnyis// sgyu ma lta bu'i ngang du gcig /rmi lam gyi bar do de la mdzod// ma dag phung po rnam lnga dang*// dag pa rgyal ba rigs lnga gnyis// mi rtog rdzogs rim ngang du gcig /lam bskyed rdzogs kyi bar do de la mdzod// thabs las byung ba'i pha rgyud dang*// shes rab las byung ba'i ma rgyud gnyis// dbang gsum lhan cig skyes par gcig /gnad kyi bar do de la mdzod// rang don chos sku 'gyur med dang*// gzhan don gzugs sku 'gag med gnyis// dbyer med gnyug ma'i ngang du gcig

/sku gsum gyi bar do de la mdzod// ma dag sgyu lus kyi mngal sgo dang*// dag pa lha yi rnam pa gnyis// bar do 'od gsal gyi ngang du gcig /'bras bu'i bar do de la mdzod// ces gsungs nas/ rje btsun yar byon nas slob ma thams cad bsags nas lha rje ston pa des sems can mang po la phan thogs pa 'dug /mdangs nga'i rmi lam na nga'i rtsa nas bya rgod po zhig dbus su 'phur nas song*/ de ri chen po zhig gi rtse la babs te phyogs phyogs nas ngang pa'i 'khor mang po 'dus te dar cig nas so sor gyes te song*/ ngang pa re re la'ang ngang g.yog lnga brgya tsam 'dus nas 'dug ste lung pa'i gshis thams cad ser nyog gis song ba rmis/ kho bo rnal 'byor pa yin pa la kho bo'i rjes su rab tu byung ba mang po 'ong bar 'dug /lha rje ston pa des sems can dpag tu med pa la phan thogs par 'dug /kho bos kyang sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la bya ba byas par 'dug gsung ngo*// de nas dwags po dbus su byon te dge bshes snyug rum pa'i sar byon pas khong gi zhal nas khyod rnal 'byor pa la yon tan ci yod gsungs pas/ rlung phyi nang du mi rgyu/ rtogs pa nam mkha' dang mnyam gsung*/ de nas gnyal du bzhugs tsa na bla ma'i gsung dran nas/ rgya pa gser re la gser zho bcu gnyis bskyis nas ras sgom ras pa bya ba grogs su 'khrid nas byon pas yar klung mdor sleb tsa na gtsang gi bong 'tshong ba dang phrad pas rje btsun rta zla ba'i tshes bcu bzhi la gshegs zer nas phyag 'khar dang na bza'i ras shig mchod pa'i rten du bskur 'dug pa yang sprad/ der spyan chab mang po yang shor/ dran med du brgyal nas song bas/ rtsa na yod pa kun gyis phyag zhabs la bsku mnye phul zhal ras la chu mang po btab pas dar cig na dran pa rnyed de/ gser srang gang brin gyi phyogs su gtor te bla ma la gsol ba 'debs pa'i mgur 'di phul lo// ༈

rje gangs dkar gyi rtse la gshegs pa'i tshe// seng ge dkar mo'i spyod dang mtshungs// gzhan snang zil gyis gnon pa'i rnal 'byor pa// rje nags ma'i khrod la gshegs pa'i tshe// rgya stag khra bo'i spyod dang mtshungs// re dogs bral ba'i rnal 'byor pa// rje brag dkar gyi rtse la gshegs pa'i tshe// thang dkar rgod po'i spyod dang mtshungs// phyi rgya rlabs kyis chod pa'i rnal 'byor pa// rje phyogs med kyi ri khrod 'grims pa'i tshe// ri dwags yongs kyi spyod dang mtshungs// rdos thag chod pa'i rnal 'byor pa// rje 'khor gyi nang du bzhugs pa'i tshe// rdo rje 'chang gi spyod dang mtshungs// nged skal ldan 'dren pa'i rnal 'byor pa// rje glang po lta bu'i spyod dang mtshungs// mnyam bzhag rjes thob med par nges// rje bu chung lta bu'i spyod pa de// nang na gza' gtad med par nges// rje blo dang bral ba'i spyod pa de// de nyid thugs su chud par nges// rje mngon shes dag dang ldan pa'i tshe// nang gi sems nyid gsal bar nges// rje zas skom gyi 'du shes chung ba de// ting 'dzin zas su gsol bar nges// rje nor bu dbang gi rgyal po bzhin// dgos dgu rang la 'byung ba khyed// rje skar tshogs dbus na zla rgyas bzhin// mang po'i nang na mdzes pa khyed// rje 'dam gyi nang na padmo bzhin// 'khor ba'i skyon gyis ma gos khyed// 'gro ba yongs la drin re che// bka' brgyud rnams kyi re ba 'grub// khyod kyi yon tan dpag med la// bdag gis cung zad bstod pa la// thugs rjes dgongs shing rjes su zungs// dngos po'i bsnyen bkur ma mchis kyang*// sgrub pa nyams su len lags kyi// chos sku gcig tu ma gyur bar// byin rlabs kyi chu rgyun ma gcod cig /thugs rje'i lcags kyus ma btang zhig /de bstod pa yi bsod nams kyis// rje btsun nyid dang mjal bar shog

/mjal nas byin gyis rlob par shog /ces gsungs so// yang nub gcig rmi lam na bu gcig 'dug pa de'i rke bcad nas skye rgyud bcad do byas ro rbab la btang ba zhig rmis/ de phyin chad rmi lam ye mi yong bar 'dug ste/ 'od gsal du 'gro bar 'dug gsungs nas de'i dus su mgur 'di gsungs so// ༈ bde chen chos dbyings kyi ngang nas dbyangs shig len// ye shes kyi ngang du tshig gcig 'debs// gnyis med kyi don 'di gtan la 'bebs// gzhan phan snying rje zhen med 'di// thabs kyi mchog tu gtsir gyis bzung*// lhan cig skyes pa'i rnam shes 'di// ye shes yin par gtsir gyis bzung*// nges shes skyes na de nyid yin// mtshan mar 'dzin pa'i rnam rtog 'di// chos sku yin par gtsir gyis bzung*// nyams su myong na snying po mthong*// btags pa'i bag chags snang grags 'di// don dam yin par gtsir gyis bzung*// nges shes skyes na de nyid yin// mtshan mar skyes pa'i rnam rtog 'di// brtan pa thob na bden pa mthong*// de yi don zhig rtogs 'dod na// chu bo'i rgyun bzhin nyams su long*// bcas bcos ma mang lhug par zhog /lta nyul ma byed rang sor zhog /yid la ma byed rang gar zhog /nyams dang rtogs pa gcig tu mchis// rgyun chad med par rtogs na yin// nam mkha' lta bur mnyam na yin// rang sems sangs rgyas su mthong na yin// chos nyid mngon sum du rtogs sam snyam// mtshan ma rang sar grol lam snyam// ma bsam lhun gyis grub bam snyam// phal dang phal gyi spyod yul min// thos pa che bas go ba min// shes rab che bas shes pa min// rtog pas btags pa'i spyod yul min// byin rlabs kyi lam la gnas pa yin// bla ma'i gsung la bsten pa yin// dad pa can gyis rtogs pa yin// de ltar rtogs sam sgom chen kun// kun la smra ba'i rigs ma yin// zhes gsungs so// lar nga la ni sgom rgyud la skye ba dka' las chen po dgos pa byung*/

da khyed rnams la tshegs med du skye bar 'dug ste/ gdams ngag thabs lam 'di zab pa'i steng du bka' brgyud 'di la byin rlabs kyi bka' babs gzhan dang mi mnyam pa zhig yod gsungs/ de thams cad dwags po'i zhu lan gyi skor ro// ༈ na mo gu ru/ de yang zab mo stong pa nyid mtha' dang bral ba thugs su chud pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i mdo sde mang po nas lung bstan pa'i mgon po klu sgrub de nyid snyigs ma'i dus su sgom pa'i dge slong bsod snyoms pa rin chen dpal zhes pa'i mtshan 'dzin pa/ rje 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po 'bri gung pa de nyid 'bri se ba byang chub kyi gling du bzhugs pa'i tshe/ sa phyogs der than pa chen po byung ste yon bdag grwa ris kun gyis gsol ba btab pas/ bdud rtsi zhig po 'dir shog /nga'i glu 'di rang re'i dgon ltag gi chu mig gi rtsar thon dang char 'bab tu 'ong gsungs te mgur 'di gsungs pa/ ༈ na mo gu ru/ dpal chos dbyings kyi nam mkha' yangs pa la// chos mtha' dbus med pa kun la khyab// chos sku rdo rje 'chang chen yang yang dran// sems rtse gcig gdung bas gsol ba 'debs// bla ma khyed rang lta bur byin gyis rlobs// shar za hor yul du lho sprin 'thibs// byin rlabs ban ma bun ma byung*// tai lo shes rab bzang po yang yang dran// sems rtse gcig gdung bas gsol ba 'debs// bla ma khyed rang lta bur byin gyis rlobs// byang puṣpa ha rir glog dmar 'khyug /chos phyir dka' ba bcu gnyis spyad// mkhas pa nā ro paṇa chen yang yang dran// sems rtse gcig gdung bas gsol ba 'debs// bla ma khyed rang lta bur byin gyis rlobs// lho gro bo lung du g.yu 'brug ldir// sum rgyud kyi gdams pa bod du bsgyur// sgra bsgyur mar pa lo tsā yang yang dran// sems rtse gcig gdung bas gsol ba 'debs// bla ma khyed rang lta bur byin gyis rlobs// 'brog la phyi'i gangs la sbrang char 'bab// snyan brgyud kyi gdams ngag mtsho ltar 'khyil// dpal bzhad pa rdo rje yang yang dran// sems rtse gcig gdung bas gsol ba 'debs// bla ma khyed rang lta bur byin gyis rlobs// shar dwags lha sgam por dog sa brlan// 'od gsal gyi chab la rgyun chad med// rje sman pa'i rgyal po yang yang dran// sems rtse gcig gdung bas gsol ba 'debs// bla ma khyed rang lta bur byin gyis rlobs// gnas phag mo gru ru myu gu 'khrungs// zab mo gsang sngags kyi gter kha bye// rje rang byon sangs rgyas yang yang dran// sems rtse gcig gdung bas gsol ba 'debs// bla ma khyed rang lta bur byin gyis rlobs// byang 'bri gung phyogs su 'bras drug smin// 'bras drug gis 'gro drug yongs la khyab// drin can chos rje khu dbon yang yang dran// sems rtse gcig gdung bas gsol ba 'debs// bla ma khyed rang lta bur byin gyis rlobs//

༈ rje btsun lo ras pa de nyid phye gal ta gang khur te byang gi gnam mtsho se mo do la byon pa las/ mtsho'i dar zhig nas 'dug cing nya pa mang po gda' ba'i rtsar bzhugs pa la/ zhe bcad drag po ni sngon du song*/ mtsho'i dar zhig nas do la 'byon thabs ni ma byung bar bla ma la gsol ba 'debs shing bshums pa las/ nya pa'i bu tsha gcig na re/ btsun chung khyod ci la ngu zer bas ngas do 'di la bsgom pa'i dam bca' yod pa la dar zhig nas 'dug pas sgrub pa'i bar chad du gyur/ des sems skyo ba yin gsungs pas bu tsha de na re/ khyod la 'di tsam gyi dad pa yod pa ngo mtshar che/ ngas do 'di la skyel ba yin zer ba la bu tsha de'i pha na re/ mtsho 'di yang ba tshwa can yin pas dka' thub kyi chu mi nyan/ mtsho rul na lo gnyis kyis brgyags 'di yang nyung nas 'dug /dpal rgwa lo dang slob dpon padma min pa'i gang zag re re bzhugs pa'i srol yang mi 'dug /nga'i bu 'di yang bu gcig po yin pas gtong mi phod/ mtsho 'di'i rgyus kyang nga rang che/ stobs kyang nga rang che/ khyod la 'di 'dra'i dad pa yod pa 'or che/ da 'o skol gnyis tshe'i dus e'u byed/ byed kyang nga la nya mang po bsad pa'i sdig pa yod pas khyod kyis e ma 'drong zer nas shing gsum ku ru res su bcings/ de'i 'og tu rkyal pa phu ther byas pa gsum btags/ steng du thag pa dang shing gi drwa ba byas/ de'i gru gcig tu phye ya gang po bzhag /gru gcig tu nya pa bsdad/ gru gcig tu chos rje nyid bzhugs/ tshes bcu gcig gi skar ma rdzogs pa dang*/ gzings chu la btang bas/ nam phyed du song ba la mtsho 'ur ba dang bshang ba la sogs pa'i sgra chen po byung*/ mtsho rlabs kyang mi langs pa tsam byung*/ nam mkha' la glog dang ser ba chen po yang byung*/ sbal pa re'u tsid tsam gzings la mchongs nas byung bas mnyan pa shin tu bred nas khyod phyi do sgoms byas pas ma nyan/ da 'o skol gnyis ka 'chi bar 'dug pas khyed la bla ma bka' brgyud 'dra ba yang med dam gsol ba thob zhig bdag la yang bden pa 'dor zer ba la mos pa'i gdung shug drag pos bka' brgyud kyi bla ma la ra mda' zhu ba'i gsol 'debs bka' rgya ma 'di gsungs so//

༈ chos sku kun bzang yab yum dbyer med bla ma rdo rje 'chang*// de yi sprul pa tai lo bla ma 'gro ba'i mgon// skyon dag yon tan rdzogs pa'i bla ma nā ro pa// bde chen chos kyi dbyings nas sems can la bskyab tu gsol// mar ston chos kyi blo gros bla ma bka' drin can// rnal 'byor dbang phyug chen po bla ma mi la ras// stong nyid snying rje'i don rtogs bla ma lha rje'i zhabs// zag med gsal stong dbyings nas sems can la bskyab tu gsol// thams cad mkhyen pa'i 'gro mgon bla ma badzra rgyal// che mchog he ru ka dpal bla ma gling chen ras// sku bzhi'i bdag nyid chos rje 'gro mgon 'brug pa'i zhabs// dmigs med snying rje'i thugs kyis sems can la bskyab tu gsol// bdag gzhan don gnyis 'grub pa'i mtshan ldan chos kyi rje// thugs rjes 'gro don mdzad pa'i drin can rin po che// thugs rje thabs la mkhas pa'i drin can bla ma'i zhabs// bskal pa snyigs ma'i sems can la bskyab tu gsol// zhes gsol ba btab pas se mo do'i thad ka nas 'od kyi phung po 'ja' gur phub pa ltar gzigs te de'i dbus na gtsang pa rgya ras longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku'i cha byad kyi rnam pa can phyag na 'chi med tshe'i bum pa bsnams pa zhig zhal gzigs pas yang gsol 'debs 'di gsungs so// ༈ bla ma dus gsum rgyal ba sras bcas rnams// mi bdag gi snying gi 'o dod gsan du gsol// bla ma rdo rje spun tshogs mched dang lcam dral rnams// bla med byang chub sgrub pa'i sgom mkhas btsun pa rnams// bstan pa'i sgo ru zhugs pa'i chos mdzad bsam shes rnams// thams cad thugs dgongs bsdus la sems can la bskyab tu gsol// 'khor ba me 'obs dang 'dra ba'i 'jigs su rung ba 'dir// bsam rlag phye leb dang 'dra ba'i sems can la bskyab
