tu gsol// 'khor ba rgya mtsho dang 'dra ba'i mtha' yas gting med 'dir// nyam chung ba thag dang 'dra ba'i sems can la bskyab tu gsol// 'khor ba mun nag dang 'dra ba'i g.yang sa chen po 'dir// mig bral lam dor dang 'dra ba'i sems can la bskyab tu gsol// 'khor ba btson dong dang 'dra ba'i thar med chen po 'dir// mgon med sha btson dang 'dra ba'i sems can la bskyab tu gsol// 'khor ba dug 'obs dang 'dra ba'i sdug bsngal chen po 'dir// dmus long smyon pa dang 'dra ba'i sems can la bskyab tu gsol// 'khor ba smig rgyu dang 'dra ba'i snying po med pa 'dir// tsha gdung ri dwags dang 'dra ba'i sems can la bskyab tu gsol// rmi lam sgyu ma dang 'dra ba'i 'khor ba bden med 'dir// ma rtogs sdug yun ring ba'i sems can la bskyab tu gsol// mtho dman kun gyi skyabs gyur mgon po chos kyi rje// bka' drin chen po dran mchog sems can la bskyab tu gsol// bla ma rgyal ba sras bcas zhi khro rab 'byams rnams// dkar po'i phyogs la dga' ba'i dam can srung ma rnams// bar chad bdud dpung choms la sems can bde la 'khod// bla ma khyed la sangs rgyas dang sems can la sogs pa'i// tha dad du 'dzin pa'i rtog pa mi mnga' yang*// sdug bsngal myong ba'i sems can la bskyab tu gsol// bar chad zhi zhing yon tan rdzogs pa dang*// bstan pa dar zhing zhing khams dag par mdzod// ces gsol ba btab pa'i byin rlabs kyis cho 'phrul rnams skad cig la zhi/

rtsol med du skam sar chod pas nya pa de chos rje la sangs rgyas dngos su mthong zhing phyag dang bskor ba byas byin rlabs zhus nas ldog khar chos rje'i zhal nas blo snying brang gsum dkon mchog la gtod cig mi bslu nges pa yin zhing bu dang yang bar chad med par bde bar phrad gsungs/ nya pa de ltar phar khar bde bar phyin no// der chos rje nyid kyis gnas de'i mtshan nyid gzigs pas mtsho de rang bzhin gyis dwangs pa'i baiḍūrya'i mdog lta bu/ nyi ma shar ba dang nub pa yang mtsho'i gting nas shar ba dang nub pa lta bu/ jo mo rdo rje kun grags ma'i pho brang du gyur pa/ mtsho de'i dkyil thang rgya mi che ba lag mthil ltar mnyam pa/ de'i dbus na rin po che spungs pa lta bu/ g.yas g.yon gyi ri bya rgod gshog pa brgyangs pa lta bu/ de'i lho 'dabs la klu khang phug dang dkyil 'khor phug dwangs shing gtsang la rang bzhin gyis yid chags shing ting nge 'dzin skye ba/ 'du 'dzi dang g.yeng ba'i gnas las 'das shing nyams myong dang rtogs pa zla ba yar gyi ngo bzhin du 'phel ba'i sgrub gnas de gzigs pa dang thugs rab tu mnyes par gyur te/ phye gal ta gang po de'i phyed sang res kyi thes su bzhag /phyed da lo'i brgyags mdzad de/ lha bshos dang gtor ma rnams ma chags par mdzad/ lha bshos bra ba'i rna cog tsam/ gung gtor lug ril tsam/ brgya rtsa bra ril tsam/ de rnams kyi gtor chu skya tsam la skyo tsha'i gdan byas pas de'i lo las skyid pa yong ma myong gsung*/ nyi shu lnga'i mchod pa nam byung la bur dkar rdog po gcig yod pa ting chung zhig yod pa'i nang du sbyangs shing bde mchog gi sgrub mchod rgyas pa re mdzad pas yid tshim pa re byung gsungs/ de'i dus gnyan chen po thang lha sngags pa gzhon nu'i cha byad can/ jo mo rdo rje kun grags ma yang btsad po'i bu mo'i cha byad du byas nas de la mtsho sman dang yul lha'i tshogs mang pos bskor nas skabs skabs su chos nyan pa dang mgur nyan pa la yong ngo*// lar lha 'dre kun mgur la dga' bas mgur byed res kyis 'tshogs cing rnal 'byor pa yang na glu long yang na chos shod zer/

chos bshad mgur yang mang du gsungs so// nyin cig gzigs mo la byon pas phar khar nya pas nya'i phung po dang nya gcal du bkram pa gzigs nas snying rje bdun gyi mgur yang gsungs/ de nas de'i phyi lo de phyi do la 'bri stag pa'i ri pa yod pa rnams na re/ na nyin 'brug pa'i btsun chung gcig brgyags med par se mo do la song yod pa de shi'am ma shi lta zer gnyis kyis ltar phyin pas/ chos rje sgrub khang phug na gsol ba 'debs pa'i skad tshor nas/ smyo nas yod pa 'dug zer zhing phyin pas/ chos rje ni phye gal ta gang po de'i phyed las ma zad par 'dug sku mdangs rgyas shing thugs dam 'phel bar mthong nas dad cing ya mtshan par gyur/ da phyi do la gshegs par zhu zhus pas/ da dung phye gal ta phyed yod pas 'di ka rang du sdod pa yin gsung lo hril pa gcig bzhugs/ de nas dgun mtsho la dar chags dus zhwa mo do la 'byon dgongs pa la gzhi bdag mos sdig pa rwa can du byas nas rwa gcig ya them la rgyab rwa gcig ma them la brgyabs nas bkag pa la blo las 'das tshul thag chod dgu'i mgur gsungs pas bu mo lo nyi shu lon pa gcig tu byas nas phyag btsal nas khyed la snying thag pa nas tho 'tshams pa ma lags thegs pa la ma dga' ba yin/ da khyed la bshol thebs par mi 'dug /zhwa mo dor bzhugs dus zhabs tog sgrub zer mi snang bar song*/ de nas chos rje zhwa mo dor byon nas bzhugs pa las/ dus nam zhig na yab yum gnyis kyis 'gro mgon gtsang pa rgya ras kyi drung du phyin nas/ nye gnas dge 'dun dar lam sna gnang byung ba dang bsdongs nas byang la slebs/ mtsho la dar chags 'dug pas zhwa mo dor chos rje dang mjal/ yab yum gnyis kyis chos rje la 'jus nas ngus/ dga' che na ngu che zer ba der byung*/ zhag 'ga'i bar du chos dang gsung mgur dang rdzu 'phrul gyis tshim par mdzad/ de nas yab yum bod du brdzangs/ dge 'dun dar brag phug shar mar sdod tsha ba'i g.yos dang sgrub pa gyis/

nga'i brag phug sgo brtsigs gsung 'dag sbyar la bzhugs/ dge 'dun dar gyis gsol ba zhus pa'i bshos kyi rtse tog tsam re gsol/ lhag ma bskams nas bzhag /lo bdun song nas rtsam pa ther zad/ mtsho la dar ni ma chags/ chos rje la zhus pas zan skam rnams gnang nas 'di la thug pa gyis la nga la drongs/ khyed rang 'thung gsung*/ nye gnas kyis de ltar byas nas zhus/ chos rje'i thugs dgongs la da dung dar ma chags na dgongs nas thug pa'i bsnyigs ma rnams bsags bskams nas bzhag /yang zan skam zad zhus pas 'di rnams tshos gsung*/ thug bsnyigs gnang nas de la thug pa gyis la nga la drongs/ khyed rang yang 'thung gsung*/ yang de yang zad dar ni ma chags zhus pas/ khug ma rnams sprug dang gsung*/ zan du dril gsung dril bas mthe bong tsam byung ba la chos rjes tshogs 'khor dang dmigs pa mdzad pas/ gzhi bdag gis sha ba'i ro gcig chu 'gram na bskyal pa mkhyen nas dge 'dun dar mtsho 'gram na dngos grub gcig 'dug gsung*/ phyin pas sha ba'i ro gcig 'dug pa lag 'bras thon par byas/ chos rje la zhus khong rang gis kyang nyung zad re bzhes pas lo brgyad tsam thub/ yang sha yang zad zhus pas/ nga'i lh+wam dang sgom sked/ khyed rang gi lh+wam dang sgom sked/ phye rkyal rnams tshos gsungs nas skyur byung bas nye gnas la sdug bsngal dpag med byung*/ de rnams legs par btsos nas zhus/ de yang zad pa dang*/ da nga rang shi nas bla ma'i sku 'tsho ba byung na snyams nas bla ma lags chu 'gram ma gi na mi ro gcig 'dug pa bzhes su rung ngam zhus pas rung gsung*/ de nas nye gnas kyis ske rags kyi sne gcig shing spa ma gcig la btags/ sne gcig mgul du btags nas lcebs grabs byed pa chos rjes mkhyen nas myur du byon phyag gis bzung nas yar 'khrid de bu blo nyes de 'dra byed mi dgos/ nga shi yang mi 'gyod chos phyir dka' ba spyad pa yin gsungs 'gyod med bzhi'i mgur gsungs/

de nub chos rje'i mnal lam du 'gro mgon gtsang pa rgya ras mtsho 'gram na gur dkar po gcig phub 'khor mi ma yin mang pos bskor nas byon 'dug pa rmis/ tho rangs nam mkhar ḍā ma ru'i sgra zhig byung de ci yin dgongs gzigs pas ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro sde lnga zhal gzigs/ mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis ming po khyod yun ring la dos drag pa song*/ da bod du gtong bas dar thog la phebs par zhu zer 'ja' yal ba ltar song*/ dge 'dun dar yar longs dang nga'i rmi lam ltas dang sbyar na mtsho la dar chags srid pa 'dug ltos dang gsung*/ dge 'dun dar gyi bsam pa la bod la e thon dgongs yod 'dug ste/ mtsho rul nas lo dgu song*/ dgun rta ri rta 'khyags kyi zla ba la mtsho la dar mi chags par nam zla dbyar kha dar chags mi srid/ 'on kyang bla ma'i gsung yin bsams bltas pas mtsho la dar zhing mda' gang tsam 'phang la khru gang tsam yod pa steng na kha ba ri tsam bab pa la wa mo'i rjes shig 'dug pas dga' drag chos rje la dad gus dpag med skyes/ dar chags gda' gshegs par zhu lags zhus pas/ drwa ba'i nang du dpe cha dang phru chung chug 'khur 'gro gsungs nas byon/ dge 'dun dar sngun la song gsung thon khar dge 'dun dar gyis chos rje 'byon e yod snyam phyi mig gcig bltas pas mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis dar thag bsdus nas chos rje'i sku smad bangs/ khyod kyis phyi mig ma bltas na legs te/ gzhi bdag de la mthong dug yod pas tshe thung gsungs/ ngas rten 'brel byas na tshe ring ste phyi ma dang mi 'phrad par 'dug /bu rang tshe ring bar dga' 'am phyi ma nga dang 'grogs pa dga' gsung*/ tshe 'di ci dga' ba gyis phyi ma bla ma dang 'grogs pa dga' zhus pas/ tshe thung zhing phyi ma rdza mkhan gyi bur skyes bla ma dang mjal lo// chos rje dpon slob mtsho dkyil du phebs dus rdzi bo bu tsha gsum yod pas mthong lugs mi 'dra ba re mthong nas ya mtshan te/

mtsho 'gram du phyin phyag btsal 'dzar zan dang sgog pa re phul nas khyed dpon slob gnyis kyis grub pa thob par mdzad/ nam zla da lta chu la 'byon pa ngo mtshar che/ nged tsho la chos shig zhu zhus pas/ bu tsha rnams la zhing khams snga ma'i mgur gsungs/ bu tsha rnams na re/ ri 'di thon pa na nged tsho'i ru ba yod pas der byon/ nged tsho yang phyugs lug snga bar bskor nas yong zer/ dpon slob gnyis kyis de ltar byon pas gyang pa bya ba'i ru ba tshan che ba 'dug /ru ba dang rgyang nge ba'i na kong zhig tu bzhugs nye gnas kyis ru gseb la 'byon zhus pas ltogs na ni zan dang sgog pa zo dge sbyor gyis gsung*/ chos rje mi phebs kyang nga 'gro zhus pas spus kyis 'gro na zhwa mo do nas yongs ma zer gsungs/ nye gnas kyi phar phyin pas khyi mang po byung*/ gzhon pa krog krog tshos khyod gang nas yin/ 'dri ba la kha rtab rtab cig la zhwa mo do nas yin zer ba shor pas/ khong tsho na re/ mtsho rul nas lo mang po song 'di ar jag pa'i mgo tsho yin zer brdung 'thag gcig btang*/ tshur log chos rjes bsod snyoms e byung gsung*/ bsod snyoms ma rnyed rdung 'thag rnyed zhus/ ngas da ci nas sdod la dge sbyor gyis byas/ da dge sbyor gyis gsung*/ der nyi ma brgal mtshams su bu tsha gsum po sleb pa pha ma la skad cha bshad nas spyan 'dren du byung*/ ru bar phebs zhabs tog zhus/ da ci chos rje'i nye gnas yin pa ngo ma shes bzod par gsol zer/ zhag bdun brgyad tsam bzhugs/ chos zhus slar yon bdag rnams na re/ kha sang nas chos nur mar shugs kyis gsungs lags kyang*/ nged 'brog par song bas cher mi go ba 'dug /dam chos mgur rta la bskyon pa zhig gsung bar zhu zhus pas mi rtag pa rgyud la skyed byed sgom gshegs drug gi mgur 'di gsungs so// ༈ blo las su rung ba'i sems rgyud 'di// gangs dkar po stongs kyi na bun 'dra// na bun nam yal mi shes sgom la gshegs// 'di yal bar nges so dam pa'i chos la gshegs// lus 'byung bzhi 'dus pa'i sgyu lus 'di// shing sdong rtsa ba rul ba 'dra// shing sdong nam 'gyel mi shes sgom la gshegs// 'di 'gyel bar nges so dam pa'i chos la gshegs// pha mes 'gran sems can gyis brtsigs pa'i sa mkhar 'di// sgyu ma mkhan gyi mig 'phrul 'dra// sgyu ma nam 'jig mi shes sgom la gshegs// 'di 'jig par nges so dam pa'i chos la gshegs// ser snas bsags pa'i nor rdzas 'di// sbrang mas bsags pa'i sbrang rtsi 'dra// sbrang rtsi sus spyod mi shes sgom la gshegs// 'di gzhan gyis spyod par nges so dam pa'i chos la gshegs// mdza' shing mthun pa'i nye 'brel 'di// tshong dus tshogs pa'i mgron po 'dra// mgron po nam 'gyes mi shes sgom la gshegs// 'di 'gyes par nges so dam pa'i chos la gshegs// rang gi sha nas chad pa'i bu tsha 'di// lo brgya lon pa'i rgan gog 'dra// 'dis phan e thogs mi shes sgom la gshegs// phan mi thogs par nges so dam pa'i chos la gshegs// zhes pa'i mgur ma de ltar du gsungs pas yon bdag rnams dad pa cher skyes nas/

chos rje rin po che gar bzhugs rtsad bcad nas cis kyang chos byed zer/ dus phyis chos rje byang dbu ri na bzhugs pa'i dus su yon bdag mo dkar legs zer ba dang phyugs rdzi'i bu tsha gsum la sogs pa kha shas slebs byung ba skra bcad ming bsgyur rab tu byung chos zhus sems ngo sprad/ khyad par dam chos phyag rgya chen po lta ba stong nyid dri med 'od gsal gyi sgom phog pas khong rnams la rol pa 'gag med kyi nyams shar/ de la nyams len kho na byas pas kun gzhi'i ye shes la brtan pa thob pa'i rtogs ldan ri khrod phyogs med 'grim pa'i pho mo 'ga' thon no// ༈ kha rag sgom chung gi tho chos ni/ ༈ na mo gu ru/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po pu to ba dang kha rag sgom chung ba gnyis 'phan yul gyi dgon pa brag rgyab yas mar du bzhugs pa'i skabs su/ dge bshes pu to ba'i thugs dgongs la kha rag sgom chung 'di la sgom gyi gnad ni cher med pa blun sgom la sgom sran ni che bar 'dug /de bas nga la sgom zhig zhus na chos chos su 'gro ba zhig 'ongs te dgongs pa zhig byung bas/ lan cig tshogs gral zhig tu mjal bas/ pu to ba'i zhal nas/ khyed sgom sran che nyams rtogs kyi rim pa ji ltar byung lags gsungs pas/ kha rag sgom chung ba'i zhal nas/ bdag gis dal 'byor rnyed par dka' ba dang 'chi ba mi rtag pa bsgoms pas 'jig rten 'di la blo log par go lags/ las rgyu 'bras dang 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs bsams pas srid pa'i bde ba dang*/ 'dod yon la blo log par go lags/ gnas gang du skyes kyang bde skabs med par bsgoms pas khams gsum 'khor ba la blo log par go lags/ byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems bsgoms pas rang zhi bde don gnyer las blo log par go lags/ chos thams cad rang bzhin skye ba med par bsgoms pas gzung 'dzin mtha' dag la blo log par go lags zhus pas/ pu to ba'i thugs dgongs la pha gi sgom chung du mi 'dug sgom chen du 'dug dgongs nas sngar co 'dri byas pa la bshags pa mdzad de/

sang chos kyi gsung gleng byed pa la yong bas khyod kyis bsgoms pa'i nyams rtogs rnams yi ger bkod pa zhig zhu gsungs nas sang nyin dge bshes pu to ba de nyid kyis mjal bar byon pas kha rag sgom chung ba sku mtshams la bzhugs 'dug /phyogs bzhi la tho bzhi brtsigs nas/ shar gyi tho la ni/ ༈ nyam chung bdag la rkyen ngan gnod pa mang*// brtan pa thob na rkyen ngan grogs su 'char// nags kyi me dang me stag ji bzhin no// gcig pur sdod pa kho bo'i dam bca' yin// lho yi tho la ni/ ༈ 'chi bdag bdud ni mi sngon tshur tshur yong*// de la 'bros pa'i thabs ni gcig kyang med// da lta gnyid dang g.yeng bas ma dran pas// ci 'dra'i dus shig bdag la nam yong ang*/ nub kyi tho la ni/ ༈ tshe 'di'i lto gos da ltar byas kyang phyid// byang chub dam pa phyi nas btsal thabs med// dgra gnyen nye ring kun la ma chags par// phyi ma'i don du byang chub sgrub par rigs// byang gi tho la ni/ ༈ tha snyad tshig la mi zad thug pa med// de bas rgyal ba'i dgongs pa long mdzod la// gong ma'i gdan sa dben gnas dam pa yin// bse ru bzhin du gcig pur gnas par gyis// sgo'i ya them la ni/ ༈ so nam ma byas yo byad ma bsags kyang*// sgom chen 'khyags sam ltogs nas shi ba dag /mthong ngam thos sam su la cha yod dam// snying po'i rnal 'byor sgrub pa brtson par gyis// sgo'i ma them la ni/ ༈ snying ring bka' blo mi bde rang 'dod mkhan// zag pa 'phel ba'i 'khor g.yog med na legs// kho bo'i nye gnas shes rab brtson 'grus yin// 'dod pa'i don rnams sgrub la skyo ngal med// ༈ na mo gu ru/ bkra shis bde legs phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan par gyur cig /da lan skabs la babs pa'i chos mgur 'di mtshungs med skyes mchog bsam gtan dpal le de nyid kyis rgya brag sprul sku ye shes gzhon nu de nyid kyi snyan pa dang grags pa gsan pas yid g.yos nas dge bshes gzhon rin dang 'grogs nas lan par mjal du byon pa'i tshe/

mjal glu ring mor grags pa 'di gsungs so// ༈ chos rje'i snyan pa rgyang nas 'khums// mos gus gdung shugs drag po yis// yid g.yos dge bshes gzhon rin dang*// 'grogs nas lan par mjal du byon// lan pa'i mda' ru sleb tsa na// sngar ma tshor ba'i dri mchog zhig /khyad par can zhig tshor ba la// kho la ci yin dris pa las// se ba'i dri ma yin 'ong zer// de nas yar la byon tsa na// sngar bzhin byung bas khong na re// bla ma'i tshul khrims dri bsrung yin// ngas ni ci yang ma tshor te// khyed rang snang ba dag pas gsung*// de nas gzims khang mthong ba yis// dad pa skyes nas yid g.yos pas// mos pa'i sems kyis mchi ma byung*/ skad cig de yi mod la ni// dung dkar po'i rgyang grags skad thos pas// shin tu dad pa'i spro ba skyes// tshogs pa kun la dag snang 'byongs// 'khar gsil lhung bzed la sogs pa'i// yo byad dpyad po phyogs gcig bzhag /bsam pa dag pa'i phyag rten bton// skad cig de yi mod nyid la// spos dud chen po khyer nas byung*// zhal sngar ma mthong ba'i gzi mdangs can// stong gsum khyab pa'i snyan pa can// byin rlabs kyi na bun 'thul ba de// nga rang dbang med pa'i mos gus skyes// ngo tsha med pa'i smre sngags bton// byin rlabs can gyi bla ma de// bzhugs 'bol steng du bzhugs pa'i tshe// mos shing gus pas phyag rten phul// dad cing gus pas snyun rmed zhus// bu byon nam sku khams dgyes sam gsungs// de nas gral la bsdad tshe yang*// byin rlabs stobs mchog rin po che// mthong ba tsam gyis mchi ma g.yos// bdag 'dra dman pa'i sems can la// thugs rjes zung zhes gsol ba btab// de nas bzung ste rin po che'i// byin rlabs bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun la// rtse gcig gdung bas 'thung ba yin// pha sku drin che yo rgya brags la// drin sgrub pas mchod do rin po che// don gnyis phun tshogs kyi rten 'brel zhu/

zhes gsungs/ ༈ na mo gu ru/ pho mdo med kyi sprang po bsam gtan dpal// las zin med kyi bya ba rgyab tu bzhag /sems zin med kyi mi sems ma bzung bar// skyabs gtan legs kyi bla mas rjes su bskyabs// gtan 'dun legs kyi 'khobs su tshud pa des// ci bde spyod lam yan pa 'dis// gang spyad kyang de nyid kyi klong na bde// phyogs ris med pa shes pa los kyang bde// gtan brgal dka' 'khor ba'i chu las thar// rje sa mkhan gyis thar pa'i srang du bcug /snang srid la mtha' gnyis spangs pa de// lam gol bdud kyi 'phrang las grol las che// yengs ma yengs kyi bar lag 'gyel ba des// sgom thob shor gyi bdud las rang sar grol// da bying rgod kyi mtshan ma sgom du shar// da chos sku la phyogs ris med las che// rtog pa dang gnyen po ngo mnyam rig /da rol pa'i klong du chud pa des// mnyam rjes kyi mtshan ma rang sar zhi// gnyis 'dzin gyi spu ris yal las che// rang rig gi ngo bo gang snang las// bcos bsgyur gyi 'dod blo ma 'tshal bas// ji bzhin des rang sar chog pa las// 'dod blo'i dri ma kun dag las che// bde skyid 'dun ma btang ba des// tshe 'di gang gi lam las byas pa bde// spang blo dang 'dod blo ma zhugs pas// gang byung kun lam du tshud las che// las chung don chen 'grub pa'i gsang lam 'di// byin rlabs drod tshad phebs pa'i rgyud ldan pa// mchog don rtogs pa'i ri khrod bsam gtan dpal// lam 'tshol skyes bu'i don du brtse bas bkod// ces gsungs so// ༈ na mo gu ru buddhā ya/ rgyu ci yod phul kyang drin mi 'khor// las mdo can btang ba'i bka' drin che// sems mi srun thul bas lan ma 'khor// mtha' med 'khor ba'i thog tha bcad// dus yab cig la gtan gyi bya ba zin// pho mdo med 'ga' la che sar bzhag /'khor 'das kun 'dun stangs skad cig bcad// pha yang yang dran pas mchi ma shor// drin 'khor thabs med pa sems la gcags// phyogs med thos pa skad cig byas// don bya ba che chung khyed kyis bsgrubs// bde skyid la bskyangs pas bka' drin che// sngon sbyangs las la ma ltos par// bdag tha mal sems la sangs rgyas byas// log pa'i bsam pa chu la pho// drin 'khor med kyi bla ma spyi gtsug bzhugs// dus rgyun chad med par byin gyis rlobs// drin 'khor thabs med pas sems gnong la// re ltos bcas pa khyod las med// yi dam sgom pa bla ma la// chos skyong phrin las bla ma la// ltos pa thams cad rje rang grub// sgrub pa'i mchod pas mchod pa 'bul// dbang bzhi bde chen dbang bskur gsol// zhes gsungs so//

༈ sgo mo ba'i dam tshig bzhi ma'i gsung mgur ni/ ༈ spros pa'i mtha' dang bral ba'i chos sku dang gcig /mtshan dpes rab tu brgyan pa'i longs sku dang gnyis// sna tshogs gang 'dul ston pa'i sprul sku dang gsum// sku gsum dbyer med 'phreng yag rje la 'dud// snang rtag ltar ma song ba'i dam tshig dang gcig /stong chad ltar ma song ba'i dam tshig dang gnyis// zung 'jug gnyis snang bral ba'i dam tshig dang gsum// lta ba'i dam tshig gcig lags so gsum lags sam// snang thog tu ma yengs pa'i dam tshig dang gcig /stong thog tu mi sgom pa'i dam tshig dang gnyis// dbye bar mtshams med pa'i dam tshig dang gsum// sgom pa'i dam tshig gcig lags so gsum lags sam// zhib grim ched du ma song ba'i dam tshig dang gcig /rtsing lhod por ma song ba'i dam tshig dang gnyis// blang dor tho cho bral ba'i dam tshig dang gsum// spyod pa'i dam tshig gcig lags so gsum lags sam// bzang zhi bde la mi re ba'i dam tshig dang gcig /ngan srid pa la mi dogs pa'i dam tshig dang gnyis// don gnyis phyogs lhung bral ba'i dam tshig dang gsum// 'bras bu'i dam tshig gcig lags so gsum lags sam// dpal ldan 'phreng yag chos rje'i bka' drin gyis// pho mdo med kyi sprang po ye dpal gyis// gnas chen du grags pa rdza dkar ri khrod du// lta sgom spyod 'bras dam tshig mgur 'then no// zhes gsungs so// ༈ dpal stag lung thang pa dang chos kyi rje dus gsum mkhyen pa'i slob ma grub thob snye mo ba dngos grub rgyal mtshan gyis gsung mgur ni/ ༈ na mo gu ru/ sems nyid gzhi rtsa chod pa'i rnal 'byor pa// rnam rtog ni rgya mtsho'i rba rlabs dang 'dra// skyes kyang ni kho rang gi ngo bos stong*// skyes pa skye med 'di dang re spro na// a la la grub thob snye mo ba'i ya mtshan la// a la la g.ya' ri gangs ri'i skyid pa la// mnyam par bzhag pa'i sems nyid 'di// sprin thag chad pa'i nam mkha' 'dra// mtha' dbus med pa ngo bo stong*// ma skyes skye med 'di dang re spro na// a la la grub thob snye mo ba'i ya mtshan la// a la la g.ya' ri gangs ri'i skyid pa la// blo chos su song ba'i sems nyid 'di// rgyud gtan du sbyangs pa'i bal thul 'dra// gnas gang na sdod kyang 'bol le ba// ma bde med pa 'di dang re spro na// a la la grub thob snye mo ba'i ya mtshan la// a la la g.ya' ri gangs ri'i skyid pa la// nor gsog 'jog spangs pa'i rnal 'byor pa// nor rdzas 'di lung stong gi sha rgod 'dra// yod kyang chog la med kyang chog

/zhen pa nang nas bral ba 'di dang re spro na// a la la grub thob snye mo ba'i ya mtshan la// a la la g.ya' ri gangs ri'i skyid pa la// rang gcig pur ri khrod 'grim tsa na// snang ba 'di bsam yas kyi dbu rtse dang 'dra// phyogs ga nas bltas kyang ltad mo ru che// yul snang stong du 'char ba'i 'di dang re spro na// a la la grub thob snye mo ba'i ya mtshan la// a la la g.ya' ri gangs ri'i skyid pa la// blo las su rung ba'i sems nyid 'di// bya rgod po nam 'phang gcod pa 'dra// rten 'brel du chos nyid kyi klong nas 'phyo// blo re dogs dang bral ba 'di dang re spro na// a la la grub thob snye mo ba'i ya mtshan la// a la la g.ya' ri gangs ri'i skyid pa la// rang dben ma'i gnas su 'dug pa'i tshe// tshogs drug yul gyi snang ba 'di// nags la me chen mched pa 'dra// kun grogs su 'char ba 'di dang re spro na// a la la grub thob snye mo ba'i ya mtshan la// a la la g.ya' ri gangs ri'i skyid pa la// sems nyid stong pa'i ngo bo la// brjod bya'i tshig gis ma bslad pa'i// yul snang stong du ma zhen chu zla dang 'dra// 'khrul med rang gsal du 'char ba 'di dang re spro na// a la la grub thob snye mo ba'i ya mtshan la// a la la g.ya' ri gangs ri'i skyid pa la// a la la gangs kyi khyi'u chung nga'i dga' ba la// zhes gsungs so// ༈ na mo gu ru/ bka' brgyud rtsod pa med pa rdo rje 'chang tshe gcig la sgrub pa'i nye lam rnal 'byor chen po gtsang pa rgya ras pa'i sras kyi thu bo/ rgod tshang pa mgon po rdo rje de nyid/ brag rgod tshang can du tha mal gyi rnam rtog gtad med hrul por btang ste bsgoms pas/ snang 'dzin rang gar zhig ste/ bden med nyams su shar ba'i rdo rje'i nyams dbyangs snang ba zang thal mar grags pa'i mgur bzhengs pa/ ༈ chos sku drug pa rdo rje 'chang chen la gsol ba 'debs// snang ba 'di kun zab ta zob tar 'dug go

/kun rdzob 'di sgyu ma'i 'khrul 'khor du 'dug go /rgyab brag 'di zang nge thal le ru bdug go /tai lo shes rab bzang po la gsol ba 'debs// snang ba 'di= kun rdzob 'di= rgyab brag 'di= mkhas pa nā ro paṇa chen la gsol ba 'debs// snang ba 'di= kun rdzob 'di= rgyab brag 'di= sgra sgyur mar pa lo tsā la gsol ba 'debs// snang ba 'di= kun rdzob 'di= rgyab brag 'di= dbang phyug bzhad pa rdo rje la gsol ba 'debs// snang ba 'di= kun rdzob 'di= rgyab brag 'di= chos rgyal dwags po lha rje la gsol ba 'debs// snang ba 'di= kun rdzob 'di= rgyab brag 'di= bde gshegs phag mo gru pa la gsol ba 'debs// snang ba 'di= kun rdzob 'di= rgyab brag 'di= grub thob gling chen ras pa la gsol ba 'debs// snang ba 'di= kun rdzob 'di= rgyab brag 'di= 'gro mgon gtsang pa rgya ras la gsol 'debs// snang ba 'di= kun rdzob 'di= rgyab brag 'di= sangs rgyas mi bskyod rdo rje la gsol ba 'debs// snang ba 'di= kun rdzob 'di= rgyab brag 'di= rgyal ba dkon mchog yan lag la gsol ba 'debs// snang ba 'di= kun rdzob 'di= rgyab brag 'di= rje btsun dbang phyug rdo rje la gsol ba 'debs// snang ba 'di= kun rdzob 'di= rgyab brag 'di= gar dbang chos kyi dbang phyug la gsol ba 'debs// snang ba 'di= kun rdzob 'di= rgyab brag 'di= rgyal mchog chos dbyings rdo rje la gsol ba 'debs// snang ba 'di= kun rdzob 'di= rgyab brag 'di= rgyal ba ye shes snying po la gsol ba 'debs// snang ba 'di= kun rdzob 'di= rgyab brag 'di= mtshungs med ye shes rdo rje la gsol ba 'debs// snang ba 'di= kun rdzob 'di= rgyab brag 'di= dpal chen chos kyi don grub la gsol ba 'debs// snang ba 'di= kun rdzob 'di= rgyab brag 'di= rgyal ba byang chub rdo rje la gsol ba 'debs// snang ba 'di= kun rdzob 'di= rgyab brag 'di= yi dam rdo rje phag mo la gsol ba 'debs// snang ba 'di=

kun rdzob 'di= rgyab brag 'di= chos skyong ma mgon lcam dral la gsol ba 'debs// snang ba 'di= kun rdzob 'di= rgyab brag 'di= dam chos phyag rgya chen po la gsol ba 'debs// snang ba 'di= kun rdzob 'di= rgyab brag 'di= mched grogs rdo rje spun tshogs la gsol ba 'debs// snang ba 'di kun zab ta zob tar 'dug go /kun rdzob 'di sgyu ma'i 'khrul 'khor du 'dug go /rgyab brag 'di zang nge thal le ru 'dug go /zhes gsungs so// ༈ rje sgom pa tshul khrims snying po'i sras kyi thu bo/ zhang rin po che zhes bya ba/ skyid shod kyi tsha ba grur 'khrungs/ dar ma grags su mtshan gsol/ 'khor ba'i rang mtshang gzigs te rab tu byung*/ bsnyen par rdzogs nas mtshan brtson 'grus grags par btags/ dpal rgwa lo/ mal yer pa ba/ dngul chu bai ro pa/ sgom tshul te yin nged kyi bla ma bzhi bsten nas smin grol mthar phyin/ rgyal khrims med pa'i bod khams 'bangs sil bur yod dus ri rgyal klung rgya mdzad/ gung thang gi lha khang bzhengs/ rgya 'og tu ma 'dus pa rnams sprul pa'i dmag gis btul te/ dbon dar ma gzhon nu sogs 'khrugs gral du lha yi zhal mthong ba dang phyag chen gyi rtogs pa skyes pa mang du byung*/ g.yul las rgyal ba'i tshul gyis rdo rje'i glu bzhengs pa ni/ ༈ ang gi phug ron sngon chung ma/ khyod nyi ma shar gyi phyogs su 'gro mi 'gro// khyod nyi ma shar gyi phyogs su 'gro zer na// shar rdo rje sems dpa' la 'phrin cig skyol// bla ma zhang 'khrug pa yang rgyal 'dug gyis// sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar 'dug gyis// dge 'dun gyi dbu 'phang mtho 'dug gyis// sems can la bde skyid byung 'dug gyis// khyod nyi ma lho yi phyogs su= khyod nyi ma lho yi phyogs su= lho rin chen 'byung ldan= bla ma zhang 'khrug pa= sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa = dge 'dun gyi dbu 'phang = sems can la bde skyid =

khyod nyi ma nub kyi phyogs su= khyod nyi ma nub kyi phyogs= nub snang ba mtha' yas = bla ma zhang 'khrug pa yang = sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa= dge 'dun gyi dbu 'phang mtho= sems can la bde skyid byung = khyod nyi ma byang gi phyogs su= khyod nyi ma byang gi phyogs su= byang don yod grub pa= bla ma zhang 'khrug pa= sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa= dge 'dun gyi dbu 'phang = sems can la bde skyid= khyod nyi ma dbus kyi phyogs su 'gro mi 'gro// khyod nyi ma dbus kyi phyogs su 'gro zer na// dbus rnam par snang mdzad la 'phrin cig skyol// bla ma zhang 'khrug pa yang rgyal 'dug gyis// sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar 'dug gyis// dge 'dun gyi dbu 'phang mtho 'dug gyis// sems can la bde skyid byung 'dug gyis// zhes gsungs so// ༈ sgo mo ba bsam gtan dpal le de nyid dgos pa zhig gis nya mgo gru khar byon/ mnyan pa la gru thong gsungs pas gru btsas ster rgyu med pas gtong du ma 'dod/ der chos rjes gtsang pa'i sting du gding ba bting*/ spa 'khar skya ba'i tshul du mdzad de mnyan par sogs gdul bya 'dul ba'i don du rdzu 'phrul gyi bkod pa bstan nas rdo rje'i glu 'di bzhengs pa/ ༈ nga yi bla ma ni skyes mchog chos rje// sprang po'i bla ma ni dus gsum sangs rgyas// chu bo g.yas nas 'bab pa yar klung gi sham chu// chu bo g.yon nas 'bab pa skyid chu yi sngon mo// chu bo dbus nas 'bab pa yar chab kyi gtsang po// chu bo de gsum 'dzom pa nya mgo yi gru kha// nya mgo gru kha 'di sgo mo chos lding dang 'dra yo// gru shan rta mgo ni bla ma'i gzim khang dang 'dra yo// mnyan chen bag dro ni skyes mchog chos rje dang 'dra yo// gru skya skya chung 'di bla ma'i gdams ngag dang 'dra yo// phar sgrol tshur sgrol ni thar lam snyegs pa dang 'dra yo// bya btang skyes bu nga 'byung ba'i chu bo las sgrol dang*// gnyan chen bag dro khyod 'khor ba'i chu bo las bsgral gyi// gcig drin gcig la e che bsam blo legs par thong*// zhes gsungs so//

༈ rje sgam po pa dang khams pa mi gsum gyi zhu lan sho mo yar shog gi mgur bzhugs/ ༈ na mo gu ru/ gnas dang gang zag gnyis ka rgyal bas lung bstan pa/ ri brag tshang tshing can dwags lha sgam por/ dge slong 'tsho byed ces bya ba mnyam med dwags po lha rje de nyid la/ 'khor dbus gtsang khams sogs nas 'dus pa'i las can gyi slob pa dgra bcom pa lta bu lnga brgya dang*/ gzhan yang phyi 'dul khrims dang*/ nang rim gnyis kyi rnal 'byor la gzhol ba lnga khri chig stong drug brgya 'dus pa'i nang nas che mchog tu gyur pa'i grub thob khams pa mi gsum pha wang rta 'dra g.yag 'drar bzhugs dus/ gsal stong sho skom na re/ 'o skol nā ro pa'i brgyud pa 'di tshes bcu la brtson dgos pa yin/ rdo rje phag mo'i tshogs 'khor zhig byas pa drag gam gsungs pa la/ khams pa rdor rgyal na re/ 'dir chang khrims dam pa dang bcas chos khrims pas tshor na chad pa 'ong gsungs kyang sho sgom ma nyan/ der dbyar zla ra ba'i tshes bcu mdzad par bgros te/ bla ma rin po che la nas ka pā la gsum gyi tshogs chang zhig byas chog pa'i dgongs pa re re zhus pas nas ka pā la dgu byung ba des chang btsos/ rdor rgyal gyis sgam po rgyab nas shing sna tshogs 'ur ded byas/ dbus ses drwa ba'i nang du chu blangs/ sho sgom gyis rlung lag sor la drangs te me bus/ tshogs kyi yo byad gzhan yang btsal te rdo rje phag mo'i sgrub mchod byas pa'i nub mo thugs nyams 'bar te glu gar gyi mchod pa mang du phul zhing*/ gzhan yang bka' brgyud bro mo che zhes yongs su grags pa'i gsung mgur gsol 'debs bka' rgya ma ni 'di lta ste/ ༈ skabs der gsol ba zhig thob dang rdo rje'i spun// gsol ba gsha' ma zhig thob dang byin rlabs 'jug /gnas spyi gtsug nyi zla'i gdan steng na// drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma la gsol ba 'debs// gnas 'og min chos kyi pho brang na// chos sku rdo rje 'chang chen la gsol ba 'debs// shar za hor nor bu'i dgon pa na// tai lo shes rab bzang po la gsol ba 'debs// byang puṣpa ha ri'i dgon pa na// mkhas pa nā ro paṇa chen la gsol ba 'debs// lho dro bo lung gi dgon pa na// sgra sgyur mar pa lo tsā la gsol ba 'debs// 'brog la phyi gangs kyi ra ba na// dbang phyug bzhad pa rdo rje la gsol ba 'debs// shar dwags lha dpal gyi sgam po na// chos rgyal dwags po lha rje la gsol ba 'debs// gnas nub phyogs o rgyan gyi gzhal yas na// yum rdo rje phag mo la gsol ba 'debs// gnas bsil ba tshal gyi dur khrod na// chos skyong ma mgon lcam dral la gsol ba 'debs// rkyen phyi nang gi bar chad mi 'byung zhing*// mchog thun mong gi dngos grub stsal du gsol// de skad ces gsol ba btab cing zhabs bro mang du 'khrabs pa chos khrims rtags brgyad kyis tshor nas 'ong ste/

khyed gsum gyis dge 'dun spyi'i bya ba dang mi mthun pa'i las glu blangs shing bro 'khrabs pa 'di kun gyi mig srol la gnod cing chos kyi khrims dang 'gal bas gnas 'dir ma 'dug par da lta rang song zhig zer dbyug pas brdungs/ rdor rgyal gyis/ gzhi mnyam pa nyid kyi zhing las// zhes sogs chang 'thung lugs kyi mgur gsungs kyang ma nyan/ do nub zhog byas pas/ 'o na nang par lam mthong ma khad rgyug cig zer/ nang par khong gsum bla ma la phyag 'bul ba dang dgongs pa zhu ba'i long skabs kyang med par rang rang gi ka cha phran bu yod pa bsnams nas spang lung na rgyugs pa zing nge 'gro ba'i tshe/ yang dgon se ba phug na rje sgam po pa bzhugs pa'i bka' las/ mdangs gling seb 'di na ltas dang cho 'phrul che/ dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rnams kyang da nang 'gro ba'i chas byed 'dug /sgom tshul la lta rtog gyis gsung*/ rje sgom tshul gyis gzigs pas/ bya bye'u rnams kyang sngar bas ca co che zhing thur du 'phur ba dang*/ shing gi rtse mo rnams kyang lhor bstan pa 'dra ba zhig byas/ khams pa mi gsum phyag 'tshal sgang nas phyag re 'tshal/ gsol bar re 'debs kyin thur du 'gro ba mthong nas bla ma rin po che la de ltar gda' zhus pas/ bla ma'i zhal nas de ma bzang*/ khams pa mi gsum po de la chad las shig phog yod par 'dug /de tsug byed dgos pa min/ khong gsum gyis bskal pa mang por tshogs bsags shing sgrib pa sbyangs pa yin pas/ dge sbyor nyams mtho dman dang*/ spyod lam gyi bya ba sna tshogs la su yin gyis dpag par dka'/ khong gsum re zhig 'dir sdod dgos rgyu la chos khrims pas phud 'dug na kho bo yang mnyam du 'gro 'dod de/ 'on kyang khong rnams yar la slog pa'i rjes bsnyags pa la 'gro gsung*/ yang dgon se ba phug nas mar la byon/ de'u nub kyi rgyab spang lung mdo'i phyi zur shar lho ngos su byon pa dang*/ khong gsum kyang de 'og gi brag rang rong can na 'dug pa gzigs so// der bla mas kyang phebs sa der pha wang zhig 'dug pa'i steng du byon/

na bza' chos gos kyi grwa nas phyag gis bzung ste yar la log shog pa'i brda mdzad cing sho mo yar shog tu grags pa'i mgur 'di gsungs so// ༈ kwa ye nyon dang snying gi bu mchog gsum// bu phyi phyir ma 'gro yar la shog /sngon skye ba mang po'i gong rol nas// las 'brel pa zab mo 'di ltar yod// rje rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das// mgon shākya thub pa'i spyan lnga ru/ bdag zla 'od gzhon nur gyur pa'i tshe// mdo ting 'dzin rgyal po zhus shing gnang*// khyed rdo rje'i spun gyis gtso byas pa'i// 'khor khri phrag mang po 'dus rnams la// khong de bzhin gshegs pas 'di skad gsung*// dus ma 'ongs snyigs mar gyur pa'i tshe// chos zab mo ting 'dzin rgyal po 'di// don rgyas par byed pa su zhig yod// de dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyi sras// nad nyon mongs kun sel sman pa'i mchog /yongs rgyal bas bsngags pa brjod mi lang*// zhes kun la yang yang bka' stsal tshe// mi kho bos spel bar khas blangs pas// der 'dus pa'i 'khor rnams kun gyis kyang*// grogs bgyid par dam bcas smon lam btab// sngon smon lam bzang pos dus 'dir 'dzoms// de las dang bsod nams skal bar ldan// chos zab mo'i gnas rnams legs par bstan// da phyir mi ldog pa'i sa la bkod// bu phyi phyir ma 'gro yar la shog /gnas bzang po lha ri sgam po 'di// lha yi dam rgya mtsho pho brang yin// gnas 'di ru sgom pa'i sgom chen la// mchog thun mong gi dngos grub myur du thob// bu phyi phyir ma 'gro yar la shog /pha bla ma snye ba sgom chen nga*// don blo gtad thub pa'i bshes gnyen yin// mi bdag la brten pa'i bu slob rnams// chos phyag rgya chen po myur du rtogs// bu phyi phyir ma 'gro yar la shog /bka' tshul bzhin sgrub pa'i slob 'bangs la// tshe 'di phyi'i don chen 'byung bar nges// blo the tshom mi dgos gdengs dang ldan// sems yid ches skye'o skal ldan kun// bu phyi phyir ma 'gro yar la shog

/grogs bzang po gsang spyod brtul zhugs dang*// dus thun bzhir nyams len skyong bzhin du// yid mos gus kyi gdung shugs byed pa 'di// lam myur du bgrod pa'i grogs mchog yin// bu phyi phyir ma 'gro yar la shog /lar rdo rje'i spun gyi grogs 'di rnams// chos tshul bzhin byed pa'i gang zag yin// don theg chen nyams su len pa la// grogs 'di las bzang ba gang na'ang med// bu phyi phyir ma 'gro yar la shog /chos zab mo phyag chen chos drug 'di// bka' mdo rgyud yongs kyi snying po yin// gnad 'di las lhag pa'i gdams pa zhig /gzhan thar 'dod yongs la yod mi srid// bu phyi phyir ma 'gro= /don ma nor nyams su len shes na// 'dis sa lam thams cad cig car bgrod// tshe 'di la 'bras bu mngon sum ston// dus phyi mar mi 'gyang blo re bde// bu phyi phyir ma 'gro= /khyed gnas dang bshes gnyen grogs bzang po// lam myur du bgrod pa'i chos dang bzhi// yongs 'di las khyad par 'phags pa zhig /phyogs gang du phyin kyang rnyed mi 'gyur// bu phyi phyir ma 'gro= /lam 'di bzhi bor nas gang du 'gro// da rten 'brel bzang zhing 'dzom dus 'dir// yid re dogs bsam mno ma mang bar// gnas 'di ru sgom yun srings dang dge /bu phyi phyir ma 'gro= /gnas 'og min chos kyi pho brang nas// chos sku rdo rje 'chang chen gyi bka' yod yar yar shog /ces gsungs shing pha wang de'i steng du zhabs zung dang phyag 'khar gyi rjes bzhag /ma 'ongs lung bstan kyang mdzad do// de nas khams pa mi gsum gyis bla ma byon nas phyag gis brda mdzad pa mthong zhing mgur gsungs pa rnams gsal bar thos pas shin tu dga' ches nas phyag mang du btsal/ pha wang rang rong rnams kyi steng nas dga' skyid kyi glu gar sho mo yar 'gro ru grags pa 'di mchod par phul lo// ༈ gnas 'og min chos kyi pho brang na// gnas de na bzhugs pa rdo rje 'chang chen// skabs der gsol ba zhig thob dang rdo rje spun tsho// bla mas yar shog gsungs gin yar yar 'gro// mtho ris them skas 'dzegs shing yar yar 'gro// ngan song rdog pas gnon zhing yar yar 'gro// sho mo nyams bzang la dga' yo dang re spro na// shar za hor nor bu'i dgon pa na// gnas de na bzhugs pa tai lo yi sher bzang*// skabs der gsol ba =

bla mas yar shog= mtho ris them skas= ngan song rdog pas= sho mo nyams bzang= byang puṣpa pa ha ri'i dgon pa na// gnas de na bzhugs pa'i nā ro paṇa chen// skabs der gsol ba = bla mas yar shog= mtho ris them skas= ngan song rdog pas= sho mo nyams bzang= lho dro bo lung gi dgon pa na// gnas de na bzhugs pa'i mar pa lo tsā// skabs der gsol ba = bla mas yar shog= mtho ris them skas= ngan song rdog pas= sho mo nyams bzang= 'brog la phyi gangs kyi ra ba na// gnas de na bzhugs pa mi la ras chen// skabs der gsol ba = bla mas yar shog= mtho ris them skas= ngan song rdog pas= sho mo nyams bzang= shar dwags lha dpal gyi sgam po na// gnas de na bzhugs pa dwags po yi lha rje// skabs der gsol ba zhig thob dang rdo rje spun tsho// bla mas yar shog gsung gin yar yar 'gro// mtho ris them skas 'dzegs shing yar yar 'gro// ngan song rdog pas gnon zhing yar yar 'gro// sho mo nyams bzang la dga' yo dang re spro na// zhes gsungs shing zhabs bro mang du 'khrabs pas zhabs rjes kyang dpag tu med pa byung ngo*// de nas dpon slob lhan du yar phebs/ rje sgam po pa yang dgon se ba phug tu bzhugs/ khams pa rdor rgyal khyung lding phug tu bzhugs/ dbu se yang rtse dkar phug tu bzhugs/ gsal stong sho sgom chu mig nag por bzhugs/ rnal 'byor chos g.yung sogs grub thob rnams dang grub rtags kyi rtsal 'gran par mdzad pa sogs sgrub brgyud kyi bstan pa dar zhing rgyas par mdzad do// ༈ oṃ swa sti/ rdo rje 'chang dbang mkha' dbyings yangs pa las// thugs rje rmad byung grub pa'i snying po ni// tilli pa zhes grub pa'i gtsug rgyan shar// de sras mar me gcig las gnyis mched bzhin// gnyis su med pa'i ye shes thugs brnyes pa'i// grub dbang nyi ma bzhon nu'i phreng ba ni// tshar du dngar ba rim par byon pa la// bka' brgyud nor bu'i phreng zhes yongs grags pa'i// rdo rje nā da mi shigs sgra dbyangs kyis// chos kyi 'khor lo mkha' ltar klas pa las// srid pa'i mun sel gsung gi zegs ma tsam// yi ge'i phreng bar spel 'di rmad du byung*// ci phyir zhe na rgyal ba sras bcas kyang*// dpal ldan bla ma nyid la brten pa dang*// rgyal kun mchod las bla ma gcig mchod pa// bsod nams che bar rgyal ba nyid gsungs phyir// tshangs pa'i gnas su bla ma mchod byas nas// de yi ye shes chen po'i byin rlabs bcud// snying gi thig ler myur du gzhug pa'i phyir// rdo rje'i glu rnams dbyangs su len pa dang*// gsung gi don gyi ro mchog myong byed cing*// bzod med mos gus drag pos gsol 'debs pa// 'di ni dpal ldan dwags po'i bka' brgyud che'i// bka' srol 'chug med khyad par 'phags pa ste// de la 'bad pas rdo rje ye shes mchog

/'pho ba'i dbang bskur 'bad med nyid du thob// byang chub lam gyi mi mthun phyogs kun zhi/ /sa dang lam gyi yon tan ma lus rdzogs/ /chos dbyings gnyug ma'i rgyal sar dbang 'byor nas/ /bla ma rdo rje 'chang dbang 'grub 'gyur na/ /nad gdon zhi dang tshe bsod 'phel ba sogs/ /thun mong dngos grub 'grub pa smos ci dgos/ /'dir 'bad dge bas mkha' mnyam sems can rnams/ /bla med rdo rje theg pa'i lam zhugs nas/ /mos gus mthar phyin gnyug ma'i rang zhal mthong*/ /sku gsum bla ma'i go 'phang myur 'grub shog /ces pa'ang bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa ste bstan pa'i nyin byed kyis so// ༈ bdag sogs dge ba 'dis mtshon 'khor 'das dus gsum bsags yod kyi dge ba 'di thams cad dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rje btsun rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mi bskyod rdo rje la sogs pa phyogs bcu dang*/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi thugs kyi bzhed pa ji lta ba de ltar sems can thams cad sangs rgyas thob pa'i phyir du bsngo bas myur du thob par gyur cig// /oṃ swasti siddhi rastu/ deng 'dir gsung rab rin chen 'phrul par du// bzhengs dges legs byas 'dis mtshon dus gsum du// bgyis pa'i dge tshogs dri ma med pa rnams// gcig tu bsdoms te mthun rkyen sgrub rnams dang*// bstan pa'i sbyin bdag tshe ring 'byor ldan zhing*// ma gyur nam mkha'i mtha' mnyam 'gro ba kun// sgrib gnyis byang zhing tshogs gnyis myur rdzogs te// bla med rnam grol thob pa'i rgyu ru bsngo// bstan 'dzin dam pa gang na su bzhugs rnams// sku tshe'i rkyen gegs tha dag rab zhi nas// bstan 'gro'i don chen bla med mdzad bzhin du// dam chos bdud rtsi'i sbrang char 'bebs gyur cig /yangs pa'i rgyal khams kun tu lo legs shing*// nad mug 'khrug rtsod thams cad zhi ba dang*// mi mthun rgud pa'i ming yang mi grags par// rdzogs ldan dang po'i lang tsho 'char bar shog

/de'i mthus kha ba ris pa'i skye dgu'i yid// rnam dkar dge ba'i las la phyogs pa dang*// mthun rkyen legs tshogs gong nas gong 'phel te// dam chos 'dzin pa'i snod du rung bar shog /'jig rten dbang phyug phyag na padmo yi// zhabs pad bho ṭa'i ljongs 'dir myur bkod de// zhi bsil chos kyi bdud rtsi'i zil mngar ror// longs su spyod pa'i skal bzang myur 'char shog /khyad par bstan pa'i snying po sgrub brgyud kyi// ring lugs dri med sa chen yongs khyab ste// bstan pa 'dzin pa'i skyes bu dam pa rnams// sku tshe mi 'gyur tshe lha'i ngo bor brtan// phrin las mi zad nyi zla'i 'od dang sdeb// 'dus tshogs dge 'dun bgrang yas rgyu skar la// zab rgyas chos kyi gru char 'bebs par shog /lha rnams mkha' la shis pa'i glu dbyangs len// 'gro rnams bde zhing skyid pa'i yun du 'tsho// klu rnams dga' bas nor 'dzin dbyig gis bkang*// mthar thug sangs rgyas ye shes thob par shog /ces pa'ang 7rgyal dbang karma pa o rgyan phrin las rdo rje mchog dgung grangs bcu gsum steng*/ 'og min mtshur phu'i gdan sar ljags rtsom gnang ba'i rten gsum gsar bzhengs kyi dge bsngo'i smon tshig byin rlabs can no// ༈ //spyi lo 2007 gyi lor bal yul karma legs bshad gling dpe bskrun khang nas pod grangs 3300 tham pa chos sbyin du spel ba 'di nyid/ slar yang dpe bskrun ched du blo ldan mang pos yang yang bskul ba la brten nas spyi lo 2010 laur/ pod grangs 1000 tham pa dpe bskrun bgyis pa 'dis kyang bshad grwa 'di nyid kyi sbyin pa'i bdag po rnams kyis gtsor byas 'brel thogs kyi sems can thams cad/ 'phral dang yun gyi 'gal rkyen zhi zhing mthun rkyen legs tshogs 'phel ba dang*/ mthar thug bka' brgyud grub thob rgya mtsho'i tshom bur 'god pa'i thugs smon brtse gzigs gsol ba 'debs pa lags na de de bzhin du 'grub par shog// /sarba maṅga laṃ/
